24 Shinobi Axe of the Monkey x1

![](images/0ce7fe9d7ba2019cd4cc7db9ce8a33dfe5c5cd4b667662a5d8469e57f44f47cb.jpg)

Jump on the wall here and you can run along it to reach the second housing area, avoiding the enemies on the main path and getting around the first group of buildings. There are many such walls throughout the area, and they can always be easily identified by the white lip at the top that you can grab onto.

![](images/a6416825596a5b4613a3be0a7966f8883f2c418af1445b3262f2b606943cf6b7.jpg)

![](images/63ad747328af7e2111326ffc03e1b12538e5d9989df2874c608b54323863f51f.jpg)

Rather than heading up the main path and engaging the group of Bandits at the opposite end, you can grapple up to the watchtower here and access a secluded section of the grounds that will allow you to sneak around them.

![](images/d27b4e4d81b2929dd6fc2caea8424913f79051c6f4c6eea4029edcb4921abf1b.jpg)

![](images/ff43afb7c340b83cb878fc16edd8a1ac9754b6a196a03a79dbbdee7739643430.jpg)

When you reach this location, you can wall jump up to the wall, and then drop down on the other side and Backstab Deathblow the nearby Bandit archer. Jump back on top of the wall afterwards and follow it along until you're above the other two Bandits on the main path. Plunging Deathblow one of them and finish off the other with basic attacks.

![](images/15925b799af5cf690447f57751c66b0cf7b6b089698434f2143a5b30480abb38.jpg)

![](images/87648601000cdde43ba35a3b9ff743d6ba3b9c97ff8024e4ff96e69213cdd176.jpg)

The enemies in the courtyard beyond this point are keeping a close eye on the large hole in the wall, so approaching through there is not recommended. Jump on top of the wall here, and then jump across to the rooftop of the building ahead to slip past them.

![](images/997f46e86c09c0904a3df8d3d0e805b15463f1289374071a207e27a0e61c7f54.jpg)

Drop down off the opposite end of the roof and hug the corner of the wall, so that you can see into the house. When the patrolling Bandit comes into view, throw a Ceramic Shard at him to lure him towards you for a Wall Hug Deathblow.

![](images/aa54529c867dd2297dc6b6a1674a0f4c47ec22a8f70da7915be68516e9c2b588.jpg)

![](images/62e21ceb773e197c6ca357983770529480ded681d261d2365ebcd8537cad470e.jpg)

Jump from the wall back onto the roof and make your way around to this point. There are three Bandits in the area below, with the armored, axe-wielding one posing the greatest threat. Get into position so that you can use a Plunging Deathblow on him, and then quickly turn and kill the archer before he can get a shot off. The remaining Bandit will usually attempt to draw the attention of other enemies, but since there's none around, there's nobody to stop you finishing him off.

![](images/38212c079d75c14e54f88f9eaa51b689ccaf2efe9f0e2f1ee3a74b417ef8d03f.jpg)

![](images/7794761ff7727ccde08004f89880b94760bad403d1f5c750fd9190c0542f737b.jpg)

Hug the corner of the building here after jumping over the wall, and then wait for the patrolling Bandit and Hound to walk around the corner ahead. When you have a clear shot, use a Shuriken to kill the Hound, and then throw a Ceramic Shard at the Bandit so that he walks over and you can use a Wall Hug Deathblow. A second Hound from further up the path will usually come down to investigate the death of the first one, so hold your position until you see it and take it out with a Shuriken too.

![](images/b001d558e0ee5571dbf1ec89bcb0525288674fc5f203838fd9af6e7e5a594dd7.jpg)

The next threat to dispatch is an archer on the roof of one of the buildings, since he has a commanding view of the area. If you jump onto the building here and crouch down straight away, you can sneak around behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow. Quickly move back away from the edge and you can kill him without being detected.

![](images/6febcf1dc915321f20b47603e940af1488b7f3ee336ca4a29da68e28b3450265.jpg)

![](images/e8931dd549f3bf22ee6ecafdb30753f77f3130ce0f683cc30b7cb970626ee445.jpg)

If you cut through the buildings here you can use a Backstab Deathblow on the sleeping Bandit as he starts to stand up.

![](images/674575de8f07219cf0b0714c4bec5f9ffd21f6cb7b8acf43d16fd68808fda987.jpg)

Continue around the corner and sneak up behind the drunk Bandit relieving himself against the wall so that you can Backstab Death-blow him.

![](images/01026f78b00a8fa99cd4e6e5fc6d31fc49fd4857f65a125db923b1af9c4df009.jpg)

Unless you have the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu, there's no way of taking out the group of enemies around the fire unseen, so you're going to have to get into open combat with some of them. The reward that the Flame Barrel presents makes it worth the risk. The most dangerous foe is the axe-wielding Bandit—you can jump up to the rooftop here and use a Plunging Deathblow to take him out straight away. Other enemies will now start closing in on you, so quickly begin moving back down the path to create some space, allowing you to fight them one at a time.

![](images/105f0a10d8fd6be90c28f05ddf64a0d288fa8e821ce9e076113957f27c28103f.jpg)

Heed the words of the injured samurai here, because he gives you a hint as to the location of a component that can be used to make a powerful tool.

# Hirata Estate

Make sure to open the gate from this side so that you create a direct path through the residential area if you need it.

![](images/feec2cd90a6d9fca7c614d50b49407aa4852a69ca27fb0bad7fec8c38a37ef31.jpg)

Grapple up to the top of the gate here and you'll be able to eavesdrop on two Bandits below as they talk about burning down the temple. The Bandit with the torch will alert an enemy in the house nearby if you don't kill him first, so use a Plunging Deathblow on him, and then fight the other one normally.

# Prosthetic Tool Update

It's highly recommended that you take the Shinobi Axe of the Monkey to the Sculptor straight away and equip it to one of your active slots. There are a lot of enemies with shields throughout the rest of the area, and the axe can make very short work of them.

![](images/919f3febd22c75209163927310ae5b2c8bd2ef6dc2a86dfd41e4c3a6ff84e751.jpg)

# Anayama the Peddler

Outside the house in this area you'll find a familiar face: Anayama the Peddler. He's not quite the merchant he is in the present day, but if you speak with him, he'll give you a handy tip about a great treasure in a three-story pagoda not too far from here. It's also possible to attack him if you choose; making him aggressive leads to some additional dialogue in the present day, but if you kill him here, he will obviously not

![](images/1c5db3f4178e273cdbba5504b228b766fdfcec98e701bffadbae4045d2aaaf84.jpg)

have been alive to set up his shop in the present day. Killing him would mean losing access to an extremely useful merchant, and is not recommended.

![](images/d3b6b8d589507ed1c792d55338d5a05750a921633685e9c6661f7cd468a5317d.jpg)

If he wasn't drawn in by the Bandit with the torch, the Bandit here will have his back to you in the house so you can sneak up on him and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/5aadf4fa0f1da94b1aa1b1cd2d996ddc3304a5d035b999761075bd79b0d552dc.jpg)

The area beyond this gate has been overrun by Gamefowl, so if you don't want to test your blade against their claws, jump up to this spot and Shuriken the majority of them from safety.

![](images/4605a65a2703e7f79579d8e1300b890b74841685b8a2a37abcd2a3ce224fbc7c.jpg)

Jump onto the roof of this small building and you'll be able to jump across to the nearby wall and drop into the garden on the other side.

![](images/d1ee9faa2056b9edbfacf69af5805ce890319a8f38b84925b17cd7f975be1250.jpg)

Grapple over the gate here to reach the item tucked away at the back of the bamboo grove.

![](images/86da6aec22e2c59377df9b200b59636e01aab3fbede3fdd2fe0c9943a241db5f.jpg)

From the rooftop here you can eavesdrop on the two Bandits below as they attempt to bully some of the local residents; put an end to their plans by using a Plunging Deathblow on one and cutting down the other.

![](images/8f6f39813b7f0583310b20ad1fa253e473b9dfeb20e5a36fbc6ec518e752e385.jpg)

Approach the illuminated windows in this area and you'll be able to speak with some of the villagers and glean additional information about what's happening. One of them will give you a useful Anti-dote Powder, and you can also eavesdrop on a couple inside one of the houses to learn about a strong enemy nearby.

![](images/34ca3c96ffc5bb09b11b212ba31aa2b757e2325e19fd3eeb93bf66b8fe5b60e1.jpg)

There's no sneaking around this group of Bandits, so run and quickly take out the first one as fast as you can before the two at the back can close in. The remaining two Bandits are carrying shields, which can make a frontal assault with normal attacks pointless. Hit them with the Loaded Axe, however, and it will cleave their shield in two after a single hit and leave them exposed for a Deathblow.

![](images/f8706d5acb55a6035a96faaacb1d7b765c94c9de2f6946e8db5530796bd87193.jpg)

# Hirata Estate

![](images/f8cd3508086102d2429d10d31d4c86bc813ea3871ef5b97b0cbda875cfb6982b.jpg)

# Item Legend

7 Ceramic Shard x2  
8 Ungo's Sugar x3  
9 Fistful of Ash x3  
10 Pellet x2  
Ako's Sugar x1  
12 Fistful of Ash x1  
13 Ceramic Shard x3  
14 Pellet x2  
15 Mibu Balloon of Wealth x1  
16 Flame Barrel x1  
Dousing Powder x1  
18 Gokan's Sugar x1  
19 Ungo's Sugar x3  
20 Light Coin Purse x1  
21 Pellet x1  
22 Bundled Jizo Statue x1  
Light Coin Purse  
24 Shinobi Axe of the Monkey  
25 Pellet x2  
26 Mibu Possession Balloon x1  
29 Dousing Powder x2  
32 Mibu Possession Balloon x1  
33 Mibu Balloon of Soul x1  
34 Pellet x2

![](images/2d06f7ace16d5be19ead13e45047762665168380079b84e8c420bd17f62d5d07.jpg)

You can access the area leading up to the main estate by grappling up the protruding branches along this stretch of river, but until you get the key to unlock the door at the end, there's no real need to go that way. The water is also filled with Man-eating Carp that are beneath the surface. If you go for a swim, they'll be able to bite you, but you won't be able attack them unless you have the Mibu Breathing Technique.

![](images/289ef5f198c212bf08e807f38ff57c54d434e1a447ba096f5bf1722983f53dfd.jpg)

The Shinobi Hunter patrolling around the opposite end of the clearing must be defeated before you can progress any further, so it's a good idea to take out the other enemies before engaging him. Grapple down to the branch here and then jump up on the other side of the watchtower to start.

![](images/3ac1e208187b71e5dcbb41bb6e8006c8600473512ba95ab2ecc340e37b5b9399.jpg)

![](images/580e845b53d10a692924ab472dde5d5e156cff355248720c6e8991cba2a7f637.jpg)

Enshin of Misen

Shinobi Hunter P406

Anayama the Peddler

Estate Path

![](images/d506627cc949d26d024047ea78b55bbc5115bd109bf073bab61835b08a46afad.jpg)

Hug the watchtower wall here and throw a Ceramic Shard at the Bandit. Deathblow him when he gets close enough then immediately crouch and hide to ensure the archer ahead doesn't spot you.

![](images/d0462129c34f0ed571ad98fb408a064feafb46b6f13e645f471c89a61a443c6b.jpg)

![](images/698f6a3c4aaeabb2b8ea17ed260514b964a74bf7bf032f8a594f3cd5a4ed7317.jpg)

Crouch down and follow the patch of tall flowers until you near the Bandit archer and wait there until you see the Shinobi Hunter standing with his back to you near the stairs leading out of the area. You can then use Shuriken to kill the nearby archer without any of the enemies detecting you; three should get the job done. Wait for the Shinobi Hunter to get back into that same position, and then use a Shuriken on the Bandit with his back to you on the opposite side of the area. He'll run and attack you, but none of the other enemies will be alerted. Retreat through the flowers so that you're far away from the other enemies; kill him there to avoid detection.

![](images/81d9c797ea824603f40972d18cc72506d356f2db6c886284987ce60e0d1161ac.jpg)

![](images/0734609d7e52779ff4aa026aa3ca2e5be6597f58050fea406de8e7dd9dc8804a.jpg)

Grapple up to the branch here, and then crouch down into the tall flowers and follow them around until you're in position behind the remaining Bandit. Wait for the Shinobi Hunter to have his back to you on the opposite side of the area, and then Backstab Deathblow the nearby Bandit.

![](images/1d0a155d0963ad04660e4302c6bcfb546d9db45f3f14b4e410f673b08fd25067.jpg)

![](images/6b3e340e4cfc77b3b62e6ff6024ceb4148b21d61963495ffc23b00397286b151.jpg)

Due to the sheer amount of thrusting attacks this enemy possesses, the Mikiri Counter should be considered all but essential if you're going to fight him at the earliest possible point. Provided he has never fully spotted you, there are a couple of places that you can use a Deathblow on him from to get an early advantage. If you're still on the side where the two Bandits were standing, you can wait for the Shinobi Hunter to start walking away from the area below you, and then jump out and Plunging Deathblow him.

You can also work your way round to the opposite side of the area again and Backstab Deathblow him when he gets close to the flowers there. If he detects you while you're still fighting the Bandits, just retreat all the way back across the bridge until he loses interest to reset the encounter. Once the fight begins, try to Step Dodge through his normal attacks to get behind him, where you'll often be able to land consecutive blows to his back while he attempts his backwards stab. Another option is to keep your distance slightly to bait him into using his dashing thrust, which gives ample time to react and Mikiri Counter for massive Posture damage.

![](images/d0bbd9e5d3572c7c1528ec27f86bcf5f88f66b279a69b9359c4aa254d7ed7b15.jpg)

![](images/0a42078d8d9c376bb64a0be6a1ed3f886a5df7613a8e6cbfdd458caa5ac2b1fb.jpg)

# Bamboo Thicket Slope

The Bandits have taken up strong defensive positions along the slope, so if you want to make it to the top, you're going to need to have your wits about you. Going straight up will take you directly into a major battle with many ranged enemies, or alternatively you can take a more round-about

![](images/fdae659b939d59dbe1474bae69bc1329a1c6222fc6ddda63fa559e049b9ab5c3.jpg)

approach along the cliffside that will lead to a fight with single powerful enemy, and a new Tool if you manage to beat him.

![](images/45fc1f14bbb89857b6a6ab288f85cedb67b22bda9b9d21c9b4895496d29cbafe.jpg)

Grapple up to this ledge and use the side of the cliff to hide you from the pair of patrolling Bandits as they walk past you. Once they have their backs to you, jump out and use a Plunging Deathblow on the one with the torch before finishing off the other one. Done correctly, the Bandit archer on the ledge further up the slope should not detect anything.

![](images/61f35b53f07f70cdd6773ad02d38fd21c36e91bdd102420bc62e3213fe712063.jpg)

![](images/1838eeb9782477eaa2b500a142a84d0c5b3f19c5bead1937157df3b2bc3d1583.jpg)

There are Treasure Carp in these waters, but only one of them is on the surface. You won't be able to get the other unless you have the Mibu Breathing Technique.

![](images/f31e7a1b5546e6196e3645858955897ff215f6a81b6b06bb2265497aa087a3aa.jpg)

If you grapple up to the branch here, you'll be able to follow a narrow ledge along to a tunnel that you can access by breaking through some bamboo. At the end of the tunnel you'll need to do a consecutive wall jump to reach the area in front of the three-story pagoda that Anayama told you about.

![](images/ba9eaa3d3a0003242226a21a186db792d298653468a4e341d445d3cd05ce438f.jpg)

![](images/f07f2b929b8352d3305a9466c8d537c5e00ddfaf883a4d95cd3154c43b37ac6a.jpg)

A Lone Shadow will jump down from the rooftop of the pagoda and attack you straight away when you try to approach it. This enemy is highly aggressive and inflicts a lot of damage, so extreme caution is advised if you're coming here early in the game. If you're struggling, you can reset the encounter by jumping off the cliff into the water. Now when you loop back around and go up the wall jump, the Lone Shadow will be facing out over the cliff, and then turn to start walking up to the pagoda. Stay crouched near the hole and wait for him to walk past so that you can sneak up behind him for a Backstab Deathblow. To learn how to defeat this enemy in direct combat, turn to P.406.

![](images/2e3b652bca702c4dfb4b8877b3bded6352f6ac37edb5bdd78e702792c13dded7.jpg)

![](images/a9c8b3477c04ce0d5a0f900e22ae562fef8974e6ef38f6ec452b26d9efe4f2f2.jpg)

A frontal assault on the ledge below here can result in the Bandit archer closest to the bridge running away if you're detected, and he'll return with the group of enemies from across the bridge. From this position on the ledge you can Plunging Deathblow that Bandit, however, and then take on the rest of the enemies without having to worry about any reinforcements. You can also return the way you came and start the fight from the bottom of the slope.

![](images/50e17433f729b107147710028295f3162fca664494377c99403227bb28878c98.jpg)

# Item Legend

25 Pellet x2  
26 Mibu Possession Balloon x1  
27 Contact Medicine x1  
28 Mist Raven's Feathers x1  
29 Dousing Powder x2  
30 Oil x1  
31 Fistful of Ash x1

Bamboo Thicket Slope

![](images/65869f437df9bfe399ae1a8026c5ef9884ed634254a0652662c4d76c28bd683a.jpg)

Grapple across to this branch and you'll be able to jump up to the ledge above and quickly get behind one of the Bandits there for a Backstab Deathblow. Move back slightly before fighting the other one so that the battle doesn't spill out into the middle of the area.

![](images/009aee477bd94f942463cbb2ad29fc7f951bcc9829045404e57770c2508a4841.jpg)

![](images/207dab05d9c7d5251b3fa9c3c8309252d091b269c990388b34c3d6f81bcfa37e.jpg)

If any of the archers up on the top ledge spot you while you're in this area, the first shot with their fire arrows will always be directed at the bales of hay here. The hay instantly catches on fire and a large plume of smoke will fill the air that can limit visibility for both you and the enemy. You can also set the hay alight if you get close enough to use your Flame Vent on it. The smoke will persist even if you rest at the nearby Idol; the only way to reset it is to travel away to a different area and come back.

![](images/1a1762afcfa5ae5029d0725769536439296cbf00485ed3dd0f8acf952531aa82.jpg)

![](images/c454b069bc8ecfa29f5c7ad0af0f938299d39c3239d75c7dcdfe5719e8dc70b6.jpg)

Crouch and sneak through the bushes, and you can make it to the base of the wall below the top ledge undetected. Make sure not to grapple up to the top, or the entire group of enemies will spot you instantly. A better option is to wall jump onto a ledge halfway up the wall, and then wall jump again to grab onto the ledge at the top. You should be directly below one of the Bandits now, so Ledge Hang Deathblow him, and then shimmy along and do the same to the other Bandit nearby.

![](images/0f270b23fb98bce5bd31f5386db366dacad526ee6c76c9718e1cba3f0f0a1d20.jpg)

![](images/0b07ee4b07d6231eb9ae3ebe077190af9699e9b93736f7bc8e54422cc9689683.jpg)

The two Bandit archers further back on the top ledge should be none the wiser that their comrades were just killed, so pull yourself up and quickly kill the one closer to the bridge to the left, before he can run off to get reinforcements, and then kill the other one.

![](images/21580180149b3f9ac66ec75d6dd1d38a3d58ab5bade96df682810875ca531955.jpg)

![](images/e6b5ae177a75952fa595b161ea5a3213424c2f3540c74e043fbe6b22827462d2.jpg)

Both remaining Bandits further down the slope will have their backs to you now, so you can easily sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on each of them.

![](images/acefa89a19ecae2358050433e56bad3e9d3de4a5017f14d6615ff03daff134cc.jpg)

![](images/9aead052b59992c66c8ff8c8cbdc8407724763c7f9e52605e20703ba4bc5518c.jpg)

The Taro Troop enemy on the other side of the bridge will spot you coming, even if you attempt to drop down to the side and grapple across. Your best option is to separate him from the two Bandits by standing here on the bridge so that he sees you and walks over, allowing you to fight him on his own.

![](images/4b9c0b325ca11766f5648bfea86b521dec6a267abd645fbdd75254a6a44615a1.jpg)

![](images/5f004ab8fd290961440aee3490c7fee18d5a6a35bd4391292cfd0dfc969213dd.jpg)

![](images/1700d5a76a83f584e5f525cc5fbfec7d8cdfb5963619252dcd26dd4cc0865200.jpg)

With the Taro Troop gone you can jump off the cliff beside the bridge and grapple across to the other side undetected. Jump up and Backstab Deathblow the first Bandit, and then use your Loaded Axe on the second to deal with him quickly.

![](images/5a0d32090ef5b724cf7a23d48507241d34ab4c974d49856f553ee2100f36f8be.jpg)

After exchanging some words, the Owl will give you the Hidden Temple Key so that you can continue with your attempt to rescue Lord Kuro.

![](images/fc7b9bcf8da15d9f5750b0aabfa302ea4f45b0fe9e70c7256855299cb49d6349.jpg)

The fastest way to reach the path leading to the other side of the main estate is by following a secret route along the cliffs. To access it you'll first need to grapple up to the tree, and then again to the top of this watchtower.

![](images/420becb020a29570c1f75363ffb608a7b668f801f4c7a500e4424be39a8c2fcd.jpg)

Small shrines stand on ledges protruding from the cliffs, and their roofs serve as Grapple Points that you can use to traverse the area by jumping towards one and grappling across once you're within range. While the ropes that connect the cliffside shrines may seem strong enough to run across, if you attempt to do so you'll simply fall into the water below.

![](images/f8c6da5b2c270f26a1a5a072217131666f2e325ba724ccba0e8d9988d06b2f1f.jpg)

When you reach this ledge, either jump straight down to the larger area below, or hug the wall and shimmy around until you can drop down onto the roof of the building.

![](images/f0b2db6f88fb0b7d103aca57105c134b288e2598e7c6953652441b464296cd08.jpg)

Sneak around the back of the lone Bandit here and take him out quietly with a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/52969c1011a1859dafd8da02943d944cf64910379d7be9baec514ad6f4500259.jpg)

Through the opening here you can eavesdrop on the two Bandits near the entrance to the tunnel. Don't advance and engage them from this side or you'll be attacked from behind by the other Bandits.

![](images/0fe654c3afe27852b69fd6c1a2d31d44e83900c9a35d96bcaa412601417470c4.jpg)

While walking down this narrow, bamboo-lined path, keep an eye out for a small opening that you can crawl through—this leads to a clearing with an item in it. From the end of that area you can jump across the water and grapple onto a branch on the opposite cliff to reach the area where you faced Shinobi Hunter—Enshin of Misen.

![](images/dfb51748095eff6f3f623c7813db28a741e42b299e31f577e6a2b4950b71e134.jpg)

![](images/fb590df3dbfd317780ecc2b646c85d81b0f14fbe5311f69f40c7bbee7feb6707.jpg)

![](images/1600c1b820cbdabec7206d40ebfa1ea06b66a4949ccebdf63038c35f1026bfe2.jpg)

The items in this area are being guarded by a pair of dangerous Shinobi Hunters, so make sure your deflecting and Mikiri Counter skills are up to the job if you attempt to face them head-on. If you wait at the bend in the path here, one of the monks will patrol along it, and then turn around and start walking back; when you see that happen, sneak up behind him for a Backstab Deathblow—this way, you'll only have to directly fight the other one. The second monk will drop a Bulging Coin Purse, so the risk is very much worth it.

![](images/d077e1a7396e0b46b61b1f3c032b5b6f2eba6f38a4f0f0b47ee26b367ae97bf5.jpg)

# Hirata Estate

If you hug the outside edge of the area, you can get close enough to the Bandit archer to kill him before he can get a shot off and alert the other enemies.

You can start the fight with this enemy group by using a Backstab Deathblow on the rear Bandit, but after that you'll need to fight the rest in open combat. As soon as the deathblow animation has finished, attack and kill the nearby Bandit before moving backwards to create space in which to fight the other two. They will normally approach at different speeds, allowing you to take them on one at a time.

Defeat the lone Bandit in the small alcove here, and then proceed to the end of the tunnel and use a consecutive Wall Jump to reach the main estate grounds.

![](images/9fed08a3a257d93730f4fd7a2c2352e45e0b09dbb82d5d5fcdd79bf92b01a161.jpg)

![](images/0a882756c232650edd9e984955a6aa201b82cde436e8dc40f9883512a8dd6d30.jpg)

# Hirata Estate - Main Hall

The leader of the Bandits has situated himself at the entrance to the hidden temple, which is where Lord Kuro is said to be located. To reach him you'll either need to battle your way through the Bandit hordes or navigate treacherous burning buildings and hope that you don't get engulfed by the flames. The Bandit leader, Juzou the Drunkard, has several

![](images/000695d1f1441437fefa5a047f0a3b1e409a2aca1265de0401d5f79be17772ff.jpg)

shield-bearers with him, so no matter how you get there, make sure to save some Spirit Emblems for your Loaded Axe.

![](images/29f1a5c024c347f09728eb97556c3763fecb7e69ead6603efc6ef54faaafae71.jpg)

Sprint up to the archer here and you can kill him before he gets a shot off, and without any of the other enemies detecting you. Once he's down, grapple up to the roof of the nearby building.

![](images/7f2f289899d3ea12d019011b946daf1d1c0be4d8a13189034b9e3b0cd6904841.jpg)

From up here you can safely watch the two pairs of patrolling Bandits as they pass by each other in the middle of the area. When the pair coming towards you gets close to the end of the building, use a Plunging Deathblow on the one with the axe before quickly cutting down the other. Done correctly, the stationary Bandit in the middle should not spot you.

![](images/d9a1e405cdb20409fbdb28e9404ef4b369894db2859b817fbd3a8c2501a63947.jpg)

![](images/db8c94b45dd9445479e29f083a31aa24e79c722416ebcfea4f2daa77743c55c1.jpg)

You can avoid having to fight any of the Bandits in this area if you stick to the rooftops and use them to circle around to the other side of the pond. If you stay as close to the fire line as possible without getting burnt, you should remain undetected.

![](images/219d8fd8b7644de8b727b372eeb85cc4baf79cda504ce2f2647955ba576f5c72.jpg)

![](images/ac7590aa33cb6c858ce7385bf9c2efa73129b54482ac8ed87296d26723ff89fc.jpg)

Wait for the other pair of patrolling Bandits to walk past the stationary one in the middle, and then skirt the edge of the fire so that you can sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on him. As soon as he's down, continue along until you reach the patrolling Bandits; Backstab Deathblow one of them before cutting down the other.

![](images/9e17a2be1f147921515d3747b524fdc3c502bbe5782121a32146aed42641cf95.jpg)

![](images/74a17f9a039d12ebe31fa3aeff553e0964e63413233835b455042255fc85e057.jpg)

If you go straight ahead upon entering this building, and then hug the back wall, you can get close enough to the Bandit to Backstab Deathblow him.

![](images/010f12cf6f1cbec1f36a17afe281b5c25de9a8e2ff87815f1dac4bc9a99fa665.jpg)

The enemy here is situated in a small, recessed section of the wall, making it very difficult to sneak up on him. Your best option is to approach quickly and overwhelm him before he can mount a counter-offensive.

![](images/6ca637882ebd4d81a4404bf54d41c1a201f9d293f7984db0977d741e9057de2b.jpg)

# Nogami Gensai

Although retired, the brave Nogami Gensai will still try to defend the homestead until his dying breath. After a brief conversation he will charge straight into battle with the entire enemy group; make sure that you're ready for the fight before talking to him, so that you can take full advantage of

![](images/c3b4b6d73223b4ad6774ae9b2245848b1f85b4130b7a38eaa239e5396794bb12.jpg)

his skills. It's recommended that you clear out all of the Bandits surrounding Juzou before talking to Nogami, because that's when he will prove most useful.

![](images/075723958f358b4edb06151107994cfc871a2c72f7fb62ddf9bcde938aaf5262.jpg)

To completely rule out the chance of these enemies getting pulled into the upcoming fight, it's a good idea to come over here and clear them out first. Enter through the side of the building and you can Backstab Deathblow the Bandit inside, and then advance into the walkway and finish off the one around the corner.

![](images/79b5768a1c02bc64e62cf1d7cc69218ae3cf5114119652129665e6d10a00d057.jpg)

![](images/7226c209c2fd99a3f26843c23cb39e5da3a1dda8b5bfb87825a1a19238f60916.jpg)

Hug the corner of the wall here and a patrolling Bandit will walk down towards you; wait for him to turn around, and then approach him from behind and use a Backstab Deathblow to finish him off before taking out the nearby archer.

![](images/f5b5c3fee377556e58f7c5ccadf47537272cd13e03226753bfcf6a2e474b8779.jpg)

The ornate artwork is not the only interesting thing about this particular wall. If you hug it, it will reveal itself to be a Shinobi Shortcut, leading to a secret room containing a number of items, of which the Prayer Bead is especially important.

![](images/35d621fafb65ed50c2bb019d2202322b3f7bbf21e9e744a9febb77c8836bde3e.jpg)

![](images/f9580a490e3267c5b3dcc812ee64d2c8d95493516dd815d299195be496ed8295.jpg)

# Hirata Audience Chamber

Having defeated the leader of the Bandits, only a few stragglers remain between you and the hidden temple where Lord Kuro, and someone altogether much more dangerous, await.

![](images/373842f14902cb1e3c22a490284be48af1e17f25a9f6127fee72ad3fb846b495.jpg)

# Mother Nogami

In the room near the Idol you'll find Mother Nogami, who first gave you the charm you used to access this memory. While she doesn't have anything quite so valuable this time, she will confirm that Lord Kuro is indeed nearby.

![](images/01d7715f0194230aa59d31e566f83cb12fc4fa6363b8ac59da71762e18347089.jpg)

Sprint along this hallway as fast as you can, because while you're traveling along it, a Bandit archer at the other end will step out and attempt to fire at you. If you close in fast enough you can kill him before he can fire his first arrow.

![](images/b3b5c90336a62ec8082ff59a83249e9a89936ee957aa8633a290408d1e848692.jpg)

![](images/78719eb28db4a47308494917bcb12fa447bf6b628fb47b29728180607b4a98c8.jpg)

# Inosuke Nogami

Much like when you encountered him in Ashina Outskirts, Inosuke seems to be gravely injured from defending the temple entrance against Bandits. Speak to him and he'll warn you about phantoms in the temple, and give you a parting gift in the form of a Snap Seed, which can help dispel such phantoms.

![](images/46bb3595ec8c60467331a658e4904b8e3533beb6c2b6a9f10c91d0271d63707c.jpg)

Interact with the tatami mat to move it out of the way and reveal the hidden staircase. Follow it down and use the Hidden Temple Key to unlock the door at the bottom.

![](images/6d9d2082726e938cd93c56a9483f006b5ce1703e3ada8243dee52befc7d6fd23.jpg)

# Boss Battle

# Lady Butterfly

2591

750

1500

![](images/b1fd849c2b1e09290a3dea83dff9be80ea0309e8e3a9c9bf83aeab409c73e19d.jpg)

Lady butterfly likes to jump around and make use of near-invisible steel wires to create tightropes that she can walk across. Because of the time she spends airborne, Shuriken can be extremely effective against her for dealing a critical hit and knocking her down.

After removing her first Deathblow Marker she will disappear and attempt to summon a group of Phantom Minions. You can interrupt her summoning, however, by hitting her as soon as she lands near the base of the large statue. If she completes the summoning you'll have to contend with a group of Phantom Minions, which you can dispatch with basic attacks, or by using a Snap Seed. Snap Seeds have an area of effect, so they can be very useful for taking out groups of minions, but their supplies are limited. If you require more, you can get five from the area with the Great Serpent near the Underbridge Valley Idol in Ashina Outskirts. For everything you need to know about Lady Butterfly, head to P.438.

![](images/b92623b3709293653e3aacfc9d80e5310e14c9ed11f0b407cea084b903c812e3.jpg)

The Wolf finds the castle well guarded, and the soldiers' mood is tense. The enemies of the Ashina are known to be gathering and preparations to defend against an assault are being made, so the Wolf's goal of reaching the Castle Tower Lookout will not be easily accomplished.

![](images/64fcf69071fbea903700303eb0bad9f3d1df4ca7e8fb88abc45d5ffa9667245d.jpg)

![](images/2de9b2927c1ec664f30981d3d7a044d5ebefb21ef5530510714933145724cf11.jpg)

# Ashina Castle Gate

After defeating Gyoubu Oniwa and opening up the imposing gate that he was guarding, you'll see a long, winding stairway leading up to the base of the grounds surrounding Ashina Castle. There's a tough mandatory sub-boss encounter coming up, so while it may be tempting to grapple past all the

![](images/be9dc52bdeab186b13f119a6be8d65aaf990d36e52fd48faaf7e9367a3638890.jpg)

enemies, it's worth taking the time to kill them all and gather the items in the area so that you're better prepared.

![](images/70f34e49723102e7c968eea6a29dcbd6bd158dd7ed07944cb9d05860ea243963.jpg)

The enemy up the stairs will not move from his position, but since he must load his weapon before firing it, if you sprint in fast enough you can attack him before he gets a shot off.

![](images/ca9f8ab95e6cfd4e8d6c1cbcd8d7e80cfe68b0004bf012c985239d1feb9e76bc.jpg)

![](images/3bd741a2252d464fbf7e5cd72d3e741ced6a497c812de8502ace9209f7d7d6db.jpg)

Look out from here and you'll see a large branch that you can jump across towards and grapple onto to reach a small patch of land. From there you can grapple to another branch to get back onto the main path having skipped the first couple of enemy groups.

![](images/f3cb9bb2c9bd7768831dcdee21c2c8763f7712b2ee3354738d4592d5aea765e5.jpg)

![](images/683c63338486cfaa42bfdbc50a4df4390a594bc8fbdf2b11d910184c2fdf6d4e.jpg)

Grapple onto the top of the gate, and then jump down over the wall to the right. There's an Assassin hiding behind the tree directly ahead, but if you take a wide approach around the left side of the area you can sneak up for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/a6badc821ed4207c941b0480b77d069ef07f6c59473c3c975528e268d3c4908a.jpg)

Two more Assassins are foraging near another tree just past this point, but before getting too close to them, make sure to eavesdrop on their conversation to find out about their mission. Once the conversation is over, sneak up and Backstab Deathblow on the first one and use the Loaded Axe on the other.

![](images/eeeefc306bf20491a36c2c3946b7272a84dc66aa075a2d55e5b920b661ed7d85.jpg)

# Tengu of Ashina Update

Those Assassins are the "rats" that the Tenuu tasked you with killing, so now that the job has been done you should return to the tower where you first met him and claim your reward: the Ashina Esoteric Text. This skill tree has some very useful skills in it, and now that you have the Tenuu's respect, if you master the final Skill of any skill tree he will give you the Mushin Esoteric Text, giving you access to another skill tree.

![](images/961f99725a6398637a9078bf52f9d49f4c5dfbce6acb426296969230d536192f.jpg)

Jump onto the wall so that you can see the group of enemies below, and then use a Plunging Deathblow to take out the soldier. Once he's down, dispatch the Hounds with a series of Shuriken.

![](images/713ebe42cc856168e8d8bc75e85a8ada093eed184dcfb9faf7baf2210d427bb9.jpg)

![](images/ad90c1c8b0477bb949e8789b878bd6125116a6974ba1609f6722e6f4ac7e43c2.jpg)

Go back to here, wall jump up to the ledge, and then follow it around the area.

![](images/e4539fc8513e7ff3cf169ed011402ecbc555f43700978c06e5b10e3afa3d155a.jpg)

When you reach here, use a Plunging Deathblow on one of the soldiers below, and then finish the other one off normally. While fighting these enemies, try to stay away from the next set of stairs or else you'll cause the next enemy to approach prematurely.

![](images/1e958bd654b46b5251989b37ab41c8e886cc5eb6434b72ee9671e354d8dda0e9.jpg)

Once the previous two enemies are dead, walk slightly up the next set of stairs until you can see the ranged soldier inside. He'll begin walking down towards you, so run around the left side of the staircase and wait for him to walk past so that you can wall jump up and sneak behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/662e082023473f1a899f3b5634c0ae9ea61c2a4597c4b8e07ba12d40a96a208d.jpg)

![](images/5bacbb124236a46ea25722f826cba2435f68d1ba9fc951f4397e6f566e39d149.jpg)

![](images/04c4561ec19f4a45923a3fef111546adbf2f0615d8e5cf00f55bfbfe5f0deb96.jpg)

Wall jump here to reach the ledge above, and then follow that around until you can grapple up to the roof of the building ahead of you. If you jump down from the side of this building you can get straight to the Blazing Bull fight without having to fight any other enemies.

![](images/2c60048de1a344081185160f255bba17b5949dafc0abf8719fe1c7dc190db3b7.jpg)

![](images/a35bf89c09b959e291d0df1f70ca5c2566ee000d79fdaf74d4b23df5bf5a09eb.jpg)

From that rooftop you can also jump across to this raised area, and from there grapple across to Position A so that you can get the items there. Just be wary of the large number of Geckos on the wall.

![](images/1dd9ad4520f2d2dc60ca062d4c63185464acd97a86b19531198b24c75dcc01e9.jpg)

Use the long grass to sneak up behind the enemy here and use a Backstab Deathblow to finish him off. The Taro Troop in front of you should be your next victim, but resist the urge to move out and attempt a Backstab Deathblow on it because there's a second Taro Troop around the corner of the wall. The best option is to lure the one directly ahead of you into the long grass by first moving back so that you're deep in the grass, and very near the wall. From there, throw a Ceramic Shard at the Taro Troop in front of you, and then move through the grass and hide behind the nearby rocks or trees. Wait for the enemy to give up its search, and then sneak around for a Backstab Deathblow as it turns around.

![](images/d845ed77f49cc73672630b028f68cc06fa07c1befd5f544f2168cc9eee4a3191.jpg)

![](images/8455154fdcd26ac6a7f0906146097c609ad2fe55d23916e65ed8c153bbdd3fc5.jpg)

Hug the corner of the wall here, and the second Taro Troop will walk towards you. Stay on the wall until he passes you, then release from the wall and get behind him for a Backstab Deathblow. If he spots you, you can lure him into the passageway you came from, then grapple over the building and drop down behind him. The soldier on the path ahead of you will usually catch sight of the massacre and walk over to investigate, but if you retreat back into the long grass you can stay hidden until he turns to walk back, and then close in behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/9ea8bca52fbe41ae66b508e09e95d64cc4d5fc7a50548abd852a1bff87fd524f.jpg)

![](images/7e9c98114ed2afa4b9600636ddd972841f7373af7f0f22fda9bcb2cc580d72a0.jpg)

Jump over the wall here and you'll be able to land on the small ledge jutting out of the cliff below that has an item on it. Look straight up after grabbing the item and you'll be able to grapple back up to the wall again.

![](images/1d910835a0a194677a60a60da996ab861a1560314221d5a9841bd285d2f0d2cc.jpg)

![](images/a76a584e3448531d60f5c4861bde75b97495fe5178a4f9f3d2b6e6f6db551b9b.jpg)

After eavesdropping on the two soldiers at the base of the stairs, use a Backstab Deathblow on the spear-wielder since he's the bigger threat, and then finish off the other soldier normally.

![](images/a175666f8f98cd21fa9c22aa0f3b877a47807830a6116871377ba1bcb1eb3670.jpg)

![](images/b5ed6917a04f09e80fc444ad7b8e21ac9a6b6c16143b8c63398dc77ee1b916ba.jpg)

The previous two soldiers gave a warning about a fearsome beast that was going to be used to help defend the castle, and now you must try to vanquish it if you want to gain entry. Because it's a beast, however, you can take advantage of their inherent weakness to loud noises by equipping the Shinobi Firecracker if you have it. The fight will be significantly easier with it, so they're strongly recommended.

Run and Backstab Deathblow the lone soldier with his back to you, and then, as you approach the middle of the courtyard, be ready for the beast to come charging in. You inflict a lot more damage by hitting the bull in the head, so looking for opportunities to do just that should be your priority. When it comes charging towards you for a head ram you can either deflect or step out of the way, and then while it skids to turn around, you can quickly run and land a couple of hits.

If you have the Firecracker using it anywhere near the bull will cause it to rear up in fear and not attack for a couple of seconds, giving you an excellent opportunity to attack. Once the bull gets down to about  $10\%$  of its Vitality it will go berserk and randomly charge around the area, so you'll need to keep your wits about you and dodge accordingly. It will eventually hit a wall and knock itself out, at which time you can run up and finish it off with a Death-blow.

The quiet that ensues after the battle with the beast leads a brave soldier on the other side of the castle gate to think everything is clear so he'll open it up. As soon as he realizes the folly of his ways, he'll alert another nearby soldier, who will then come charging into the area with his spear. Kill the charging soldier quickly, and then deal with the soldier that opened the gate. Rest up at the Ashina Castle Idol once the area is clear.

![](images/4d25fb143a5902b2ac4155f0ed3194b538d43d0f6569306e1a0fad40ca7788c1.jpg)

![](images/a6b148d3cb2e2f84244a6cd3a8ac18258cf09a2cf6a87f16286e8190c429f9a1.jpg)

![](images/5bf92060cf3aa59935975a63d93e92329b9e234881d363514742ccdef39cb5c3.jpg)

# Ashina Castle

Once you reach this point the game really opens up and you have a number of options as to how to proceed, with some of your choices having a direct impact on which enemies you encounter in each area. Exploring smaller adjoining areas, such as Ashina Reservoir and the Abandoned Dungeon, won't have any long-lasting effects, but they're worth visiting for items and Skill EXP to strengthen yourself before continuing with the larger areas.

There are two locations with main bosses at the end that you can now face: Ashina Castle, and Ashina Depths. Whichever of those you defeat first will decide the type of Vengeful Spirit enemies that will appear once the time of day has progressed to evening. Complete Ashina Castle first and you'll have to contend with additional Vengeful Spirit versions of Nightjar Ninja and Fencers. Ashina Depths on the other hand will cause numerous Vengeful Spirit Infested Villagers to spring forth. While completing the first major area locks in the type of additional enemies you'll face, them actually appearing is tied to the time of day progressing, and that doesn't happen until you have defeated three main bosses. To find out about all the changes associated with the time of day changes, please check P.502.

Going through Ashina Depths can be extremely rewarding due to the amount of Skill EXP you can acquire, and defeating the boss there grants you the Mibu Breathing Technique that allows you dive underwater. Having access to that technique earlier means you'll have to spend less time going back through areas to get all the underwater items. That route is quite difficult, but remember that you can always return here

![](images/c06d35d527a00125a3bafff279ba52cc1b294fe169a6db1f444cb7821722a63c.jpg)

and continue through the castle at any time. To start your journey towards the Ashina Depths, head to the Abandoned Dungeon on P.216.

![](images/89f35882a217529b31392a13f8599ab9f7ec07e1d9a28913d71cc789d3e025c0.jpg)

# Faithful One

This is the first appearance of a Faithful One, but as you explore more areas you'll encounter her quite frequently. She often gives hints to the locations of other areas, or how to manipulate some situations to work in your favor. It's always worth paying close attention to her words, even if they don't always come for free. In addition to information, if you use any item that has you performing a prayer-like animation (Mibu Balloons for example), she'll offer you up an item in

![](images/9549d1f28b8096b0ba8537bb87423c3b81efcfa34f68ad8d42df94b867398571.jpg)

return for your devotion. Do this three times and she'll give you a rare Divine Confetti. For a full breakdown of her interactions, flip to P.570.

![](images/008afa4ecc617f029767c05d0205bbefa08ea3361efedcc6e3c0f0e86bf902f5.jpg)

![](images/7d60431800276e5448e4491e24c953bc69fa649d6562cbccd47155c8ed2cf0c8.jpg)

If you're thinking of going to Ashina Reservoir, you'd do well to travel this way first. Jump out from the bridge and grapple onto the branch to reach this point, and then start sneaking your way along the bridge. Eavesdrop on the two soldiers, and then close in and Backstab Deathblow the outside one and use normal attacks on the other. Doing that will get you the Gatehouse Key, which can be used to unlock the gatehouse in Ashina Reservoir, where Gyoubu's Broken Horn is stored. That item is the key component required for the Sculptor to create the Loaded Spear tool.

![](images/68cb8da91876453e70a849639efccd24d8fb27b80183bc67bddf8ffe2fe34720.jpg)

Just to the side of the bridge here there's a narrow path that you can follow along to use as an alternate means of entering Ashina Reservoir. The door leading back into the castle cannot be opened from the outside, however, so going the normal way and opening the door first is recommended.

![](images/bb1e6b36c5d4f800f2d521222a916f29448e8152c79352b48acba39e1e8b0f91.jpg)

![](images/c067280c109e6cff6ce80842ed10f985a55f2cf9075992df971e19087182462b.jpg)

The Taro Troop on the other side of this gate has surrounded himself with a pack of Hounds, but if you grapple up to the top of the gate, you can kill the Hounds with Shuriken without him detecting you.

![](images/ba5c500ca976f03a345dc76e03e9385c82301793d438c127f757cb74195e4100.jpg)

![](images/1b10240854c4984701dca49ed533e5a2471b2421bba77b5c23474f7f78ea5458.jpg)

Now that he doesn't have the Hounds surrounding him, you can drop down from the top of the gate to the side of the area, and then hug the outer wall and sneak around behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/6abf97ea26387d8e598345f837a041e248e0401642f9cf14d71f5ecfd54276ce.jpg)

# Abandoned Dungeon Entrance

The path at the end of this hallway leads down into the Abandoned Dungeon that can be used to reach Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo and Ashina Depths. Senpou Temple cannot be completed until after you've defeated the boss of Ashina Castle, so you may want to leave exploring the passage leading there until after that point. While most of the dungeon is fairly

![](images/add6353e26e50deea4885959dc5440835cb6ceb740c731e9ca97faf9e47f5528.jpg)

straightforward, there's a strong sub-boss that you'll need to be weary of if you venture down there to explore.

# Dungeon Memorial Mob

Another of the Memorial Mob has set up camp next to the Idol here in hopes of seeing some increased foot traffic over the previous members you've encountered. The top bill items from this merchant are a Prayer Bead, and a very expensive Mask Fragment. There are three pieces in total for this mask, and if you acquire them all you'll gain the ability to exchange Skill Points for Attack Power at Sculptor's Idols. To see the full list of available wares, turn to P.559, and to find out more about the mask, go to P.134.

Opening the door on this side of the building will allow you to open the back door on the other side so that you can get the items there. If you drop down into the basement of the building you'll be able to unbar the door and open the main access point to Ashina Reservoir.

![](images/8f3d907f2b630c86be5416a2fd03edac95311605ca90a16613a80c6510952e29.jpg)

If you have the Mibu Breathing Technique you can drop down into the moat below the bridge here and access an underwater channel. Follow it along and you'll emerge at Position B. From there you can grapple up and access the area behind the building you used to access Ashina Reservoir.

![](images/810bb68c48330ee4bb1b64f581225882fcce53102c17ebcccb1c64b6c87c8aa1.jpg)

![](images/ce634690d9729e48483aac12705e8734230184ba207bfaa3a47bed0d124a9da6.jpg)

Most of the enemies in this area are at ground level on the streets, so you can avoid a lot of them by taking to the rooftops. Grapple up to this building, and then follow the rooftops along to Position C, and from there grapple across to Position D. The end of that rooftop will allow you to grapple up to the top of the large tower, and from there you can access the castle rooftops, picking things up at Point 1 on P.198.

![](images/1b64661b5d76e3c9dcdaa0a975f7778d47f73a1ee6632c5bd4e2969991838925.jpg)

![](images/fab4d5ebacfb46bc6b0eb73b4b5e7cab07a06b6517b6364712b3e64be3aa1e6c.jpg)

![](images/035d7a7f3acc75f47d718a8ec3c545c3d4c3d1ab7b1e10e5723eae97e754f407.jpg)

![](images/ba029d9016a7c6465f7ccf74b0a30bcec6c3cbfaa5f824cea18fa3b884a5fe13.jpg)

While most of the enemies patrol the castle streets, one of the biggest threats you face when going through this area are the Nightjar Ninja on the rooftops. They have extremely keen eyesight from their high vantage points, and their shuriken can home in on you, meaning you have to either defend against them, or make use of cover to block them. The last thing you want is to get into a pitched battle with the ground forces, while having to contend with shuriken from a Nightjar, which is what will often happen if you try to access this area directly.

![](images/1f1b7dc5950b706e6cb0c6aca52daf3f04a7c37e27724ead393c4a16b23d84f3.jpg)

For a true shinobi approach, wall jump up next to the Ashina Castle Idol and grab the roof above it, and from there jump out and grab the wall leading around the edge of the moat; you'll see a Nightjar watching atop the building in the distance, but he can't see you. Shimmy along the wall all the way around the corner until you reach the end, and then wait there until you see the enemies patrolling along the pathway directly ahead of you start walking away. When that happens, drop down and sneak up behind the nearby soldier and use a Backstab Deathblow on him.

![](images/04521d9425886b75aaac044f8c3ba5f87aeeb64285bd437ed53c09ec4416b29f.jpg)

![](images/dcd28bc48e6bc87918fcaf4a2e33b8ae6a959433b3559bd33f9c0ab4d01607d3.jpg)

Move backwards quickly to avoid being detected by the two crouched soldiers just ahead of the one you killed, and then when the patrol is moving away again, jump on top of the wall here and crouch. Follow the wall around until you can grapple up to the building that the Nightjar is on, and then sneak up behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/3ee3e72176cb570f2bd37a987b915a7d384e5759171de7ca5cc19c572a3d9025.jpg)

![](images/64e5c2787f2779c7c1bf06b75be6dd6a2458c8a752523176495f588b622cd549.jpg)

The Assassin in this area has its back to you if you approach along the main path, so sneak up behind it and use a Backstab Death-blow.

Jump across to the adjacent rooftop and walk along it to reach this point. From here you can watch the patrolling enemies in the alleyway below; when they start walking away, move back to the other end of the rooftop so that you can drop down behind the two crouched soldiers. Use a Backstab Deathblow on the one in a straw cape before you're detected, and then finish the other off.

![](images/82b34b2dd11fa0f3ddc064efa2577956646f9b26f0664e79d1da0daad67b75e6.jpg)

Go up the nearby stairs and follow the path around to reach this point, and then jump up onto the wall and crouch. Position yourself so that you can see the patrolling enemies, but they cannot see you. When they're close, Shuriken the Hound, and then use a Plunging Deathblow on the soldier with the straw cape before using normal attacks on the remaining one.

![](images/15888b1582c0d38c2d75754841107f3b39ddebb5b5bdb9719c9f53ec3a0a4c54.jpg)

![](images/9e7233ab22af2fa1c2fc61f88ec52629776490d2c16bef31915319041860c1da.jpg)

![](images/41c7bf169438f8e113321ce589525a335adc6be1c5c284943feba02287e61ff4.jpg)

Grapple onto the tree here, and then grapple up to the rooftop of the building ahead. Crouch as soon as you land and try to stick to the left side of the rooftop to avoid being spotted by the Nightjar watching over the other side. Staying on this level, follow the rooftops around the left side of the building to Position C, and from there sneak up behind the Nightjar and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/3c0e6a862d9316933ad9a51da708150cbc7feab7ae2921a2722837ef811f54c2.jpg)

![](images/c68f664dd7436c824a2e7ad8715b9145b13855f7e760c2336cff2e7a186ff51b.jpg)

# Ashina Castle

![](images/48b4570556b5a29a9edb281a38c9952408c87bc90042b7003ab8ed38f6308409.jpg)

Drop down onto the corner of the wall here so that you can observe the group of enemies below. If you time things correctly you can take out nearly all of them with Backstab Deathblows before they know what's going on. Wait for the patrolling soldier to start walking towards the alcove at the end of his route, and then drop down and move around behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/e0ac24aca08de3e5358831a9123cecc13d41defe4b749727f3450a716de5bef3.jpg)

![](images/3802a99ca4add61e8daad8bc15108f223574b412320926dfd21e66cd15d63990.jpg)

![](images/3eb928539fba71b4e60eb079e8897d2f536f02c7f8b3a3d30cbe5e8068a4cef1.jpg)

![](images/e614525c04003541a7afdde440a623d17df61e282d04995746df5e5b58620a13.jpg)

Sneak up behind the soldier facing the building here and use a Backstab Deathblow on him, and then quickly run across the courtyard and Backstab Deathblow the ranged soldier with his back to you. That will only leave one remaining soldier to finish off with basic attacks.

![](images/1a697a0eabe1d39d1a8d1c681eb4315b5a0c4cce7b9cdee9969bf001304dc739.jpg)

# Fujioka the Info Broker

Hiding in a little dead-end alleyway nearby you'll find the cowardly Fujioka, who is being hunted by the castle soldiers. If you have already cleared out the group of nearby enemies, he will reward you with the Nightjar Beacon Memo, otherwise he'll ask that you help him out by killing those enemies first, and then he'll give you the note. With the area now clear Fujioka will relocate himself to the Dilapidated Temple area next time you go there. If you don't interact with Fujioka at all, he'll still move to the Dilapidated Temple, but not until

![](images/850b167c18317e2c8eabc57dd4f78c5c87a9311f4d963f2bd9ab8b6896bdcd01.jpg)

after you defeat the boss of Ashina Castle. So if you want access to his wares as soon as possible, it's best to help him out now.

![](images/33b440dbfa8c064e7a19d4d7b39c7a8ac2a11e32bc5eabb91cceab09102fd4ae.jpg)

![](images/579aaffb2a6aef9bac2876d475cde07cc8e6b07e75d353730cee14f6f8210a06.jpg)

Jump onto the wall near Fujioka, and from there you'll be able to grapple up to the rooftops of the buildings lining the main stairs leading up to the castle, which will allow you to look down on General Kuranosuke Matsumoto and the troop of ranged soldiers he has around him.

![](images/fc03bca0bab868e5e0d8003476abb7f995168c4463148eb7edc92831065af5ea.jpg)

![](images/63d838884553f42fba4ec16ce5d95033ac12c409f15595a5fd306ff02e967d2a.jpg)

This general is similar to the ones you've previously encountered, but fighting him with the additional threat of the surrounding soldiers adds an extra layer of difficulty. There are a few ways you can handle the encounter depending on your preferred attack style. From up on the rooftop you can use a Plunging Deathblow on the general straight away to start the fight, which will put you in the crosshairs of the soldiers. You can usually kill one or two before the general recovers from the Deathblow, but after that you should try to lure the general around the corner away from the soldiers, then sprint past him and take them out before he closes in again.

Alternatively, you can use a Plunging Deathblow on one of the soldiers to start the fight, and then use hit-and-run tactics by grappling back up to the rooftops and hiding until they lose their alert status. You can repeat until only the general is left, and then still start the fight against him with a Plunging Deathblow. This method is significantly slower, but it's also a lot safer. If you have Spirit Emblems to spare, you can also use Shuriken to take out the soldiers below without ever fully alerting the general. You'll get 15 emblems back when you defeat the general, so there's no need to be conservative with the Shuriken.

![](images/0e286e9f0c100ffc61241bd0d93a5fb4d7b311508ad2a98ef5588088772d02ca.jpg)

![](images/205f614a1fc8596366198a5a844286516d2b108eb5e53fe99f64204a780ca133.jpg)

Grapple back up to the rooftops here once the fight is over, and then follow them along past Position C, and over to Position D. It's wise to take this slightly more scenic route, because if you go directly towards the tall tower that is your goal, the Nightjar Ninja standing watch up there will spot you.

![](images/45657d7a6120bd88682efd5990e109813d436e73115fffcdf0b5a52d0b108291.jpg)

![](images/602f7a5d0afd87b1a96773ce138ecad20cfb76fc01213b86ae6df911bac00aab.jpg)

With the roof of the large tower blocking the Nightjar Ninja's view, you can safely grapple across to the large tower from here.

![](images/dd1d3bea41536ae723658ee6994203ee3f7689336d8bc422cfbe078c1c95ff4d.jpg)

![](images/2a9086bdce3b4f04c412ce27bd010f1bce82aad81492865d933002cc84fd7abe.jpg)

![](images/e5cb038c177b81849a9a07047e930c3d49e36ed4730e5960fbca8d274a2ab41e.jpg)

![](images/3a32d2dacfae49867155e8fb82ec26ed4d65f5f7b5d070fda7b5c94eefc7603a.jpg)

![](images/cb595891bf8f2e62b8e8d48d7063f134dc2ae58f421f964cc76333ea4cb133b3.jpg)

This next section can be very dangerous if you don't handle it correctly. On the other side of the rooftop there's a Nightjar Ninja with its back to you, just waiting for a Backstab Deathblow. If you go out there and attempt to do just that, however, the two Nightjar Ninja on the roof of the castle will spot you and start throwing shuriken at you. Under normal circumstances it's difficult to grapple across to the castle without them seeing you, which can lead to you getting hit in mid-air for a critical hit and massive Vitality loss. You can make it across by deflecting the shuriken if you have the Mid-air Deflection Skill, but the timing is extremely difficult.

By far the best option is to use a Gachiin's Sugar to improve your stealth capabilities. With the sugar active you can sneak out and Backstab Deathblow the nearby Nightjar undetected, and then immediately grapple across to the castle before the Nightjar directly ahead of you spots you. As long as you stick near the outer edge of the rooftop or slightly further along, the second Nightjar here won't spot you, allowing you to deal with the first one alone. Once the first is defeated, hug the corner of the wall and throw a Ceramic Shard at the other one to lure it towards you for a Wall Hug Deathblow.

![](images/94e2dfc7050ebf23d77dca285c153b6459723ffb76a20f503800eb4de3201301.jpg)

Make sure not to go past this point during the previous encounter, otherwise you'll have to contend with a third enemy that will drop down from the kite hanging in the sky while letting lose a battle cry as he descends. The impact this enemy causes when it hits the ground can cause massive damage, but if you don't have the other Nightjars behind you, you can just move backwards to avoid it. Once he lands, try to attack him constantly and keep the pressure on so that he doesn't have time to apply the flame coating to his weapon, which makes him significantly more dangerous.

![](images/449c773602cc2e1516d134d237222d1c858d2b66739458afbbe2477c71f1fe86.jpg)

![](images/d0a47384fb96e8f65cfebe34fd5fdd6de5c26f882f8a649eeb0047eb8a8e37d4.jpg)

If you're confident in your sprinting skills, it is possible to sprint all the way around the rooftop and grapple directly into the antechamber window without engaging any of the enemies here. Take one wrong step, however, and you'll find yourself surrounded by angry Nightjars.

![](images/2f87bc445aee6652185231f73aaab5a86835c98a451c5149e397aadd4ceb17c7.jpg)

The Nightjars on the rooftops ahead are especially coordinated, and if one of them spots you they will often whistle to signal all the others to converge on your location. That would be dangerous enough with just the ones you can see, but there are many others hidden on the other side of the rooftops, along with one waiting to ambush you from a kite in the sky.

![](images/dd4a1245868e44883536ab35731aec4d93bf1dc397faad5676e1cd1689daa488.jpg)

![](images/14d342ed45068669249b2fbada65a4ca16328020b2868ee2dd3dccc353415a8c.jpg)

To start clearing out the Nightjars, crouch and move around the corner here until you can just about see the Nightjar on the other side of the small rooftop peak. You can't sneak up for a Backstab Deathblow on this enemy without being spotted by the Nightjar on the adjacent roof, and triggering the one in the kite to come flying in, so you want to lure him to you. Throw a Ceramic Shard

at him while he's walking away, and then retreat around the wall to this point. When the Nightjar gets close enough, throw another Ceramic Shard at him to lure him in for a Wall Hug Deathblow.

![](images/17ba372e97f9b59d1cc61ae13b295b98e6071c0abf24ac5284e0a6b3f9c9a60d.jpg)

![](images/1174ef68e7c79dcff69aae8bcfb5b5042c7ab4790f27b171f3e197c60cca4500.jpg)

If you stand on the peak of the roof here now that it's clear, you'll be able to grapple up to a higher tier on the main castle roof and take on the Nightjar Ninja standing there.

![](images/c72c10ce89fb896b37c9354f88d7c1352fd50c449050175a25451c4d50b7704a.jpg)

Drop down onto this small connecting rooftop, and then jump up to the lowest tier of the roof on the adjacent building and follow that around the outside of the area.

![](images/57f33eb5d7e9a0741d835b6f9386dfedfaf564ee5bee659e45f50808a8db809b.jpg)

If you happen to fall into this courtyard at any time, you'll have to contend with a few Geckos, so have some Antidotes handy. You can get out by grappling up to the small connecting rooftop to get back up, or you can jump over the wall at the back of the area to drop into the pond behind the castle. Since you likely won't have opened the castle doors, or have activated any of the interior Sculptor's Idols at this point, jumping into the pond is not recommended.

![](images/ac41c3600b9bbba205969b5706d8c4d0b97727e9a57f535a975dae4750fbbfba.jpg)

There's another Nightjar on the rooftop of the adjacent building here, so try to move quietly while you get into position. Jump up from the roof you're on and pull yourself up to the tier above so that you can jump across to the middle tier of the roof on the adjacent building. From there you can jump up again and grab the ledge to perform a Ledge Hang Deathblow on the Nightjar above you.

![](images/50ba4e2be027058dc21a76de262299f116d95f10efe9c97a88b458101ba0c1b9.jpg)

![](images/f1ce049579da5f108dc088bb0014dcc1da160ec49581d4258e784d5a479be452.jpg)

![](images/3e0ea8eae62612a85618e949f45e51db2028e7b1daff94248e1b6070bcf6c465.jpg)

Follow the rooftop around to here and you'll be able to sneak up behind both remaining Nightjars on this side and kill them with Backstab Deathblows as you come to them.

![](images/2838c2726901e7cd0a5b48258cdb864a3a065cd92c641e952b176ca0479431c1.jpg)

![](images/11c64bcc798b3d66570b6b34b4fa5370a86540a6a3284bbecd601b5565a78ae3.jpg)

Make sure to stick as close to the castle wall as you can once you reach this point, otherwise you'll cause the Nightjar on the kite above you to come crashing down before you can deal with the enemy around the corner. The Nightjar around the corner is not a normal one; rather than try to fight you with its shuriken, this one will run towards you and blow himself up as soon as it sees you. If you creep along the castle wall, however, you can get to the corner just in front of him without the Nightjar on the kite coming down, and from there you can lure him towards you with a Ceramic Shard for a Wall Hug Deathblow. Once he's down, move away from the

wall and start running backwards to avoid the impact of the Nightjar from the kite, and then finish him off as you did the others.

![](images/8cbfe3a31a3dfe012ea1caafcf8532f63469b4789853e88f32496dd5a686d408.jpg)

![](images/65f1f2620ceff2119fa6e8a15a520fafca2653c8faba785691f7f9c9eb019098.jpg)

With the area clear, all that remains is to grapple up to the open window and enter the room on the other side where you'll find the Upper Tower – Antechamber Idol.

![](images/7bd622195d09b3f110fcaac99bc1ea4fb42f5f827416fa086f71af5d3946d929.jpg)

![](images/4ede209fda7f15e7a6e603c3c3b1e7c25216d830cbe719a7406eff6c01df457f.jpg)  
Upper Tower - Antechamber

![](images/e0eac579c6d5148f5bc82666d5cb13abc5ee3972ba8dca9b98b6196338bca1b4.jpg)

# Upper Tower - Antechamber

The interior of the massive castle has a very different feel to the exterior. Gone is the back-and-forth action where you're switching from taking on Nightjar Ninja on rooftops to Ashina Soldiers on the streets, and in its place, ornate rooms and wooden walkways that the top Ashina Fencers will defend until their dying breath. Before pressing on into the heart

![](images/2972521276ffa8ba6350a0493d7052145da82428e96676523dbfc48744768449.jpg)

of the castle, be sure to open the nearby chest to retrieve the Gourd Seed inside and give it to Emma to increase the capacity of your Healing Gourd.

![](images/86f19800534c4bb46ff5aa543d85a1bb038e19bebfa3ed346e890b28b13dc55d.jpg)

There's a Fencer patrolling the hallway on the other side of the screens here, but if you peer through the gap you can watch his movement and time your approach behind him to land a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/a54f7d9158e3955dd17e1a3372413c5d18f04ebf806f52e525567b55075c5848.jpg)

Open the door here, but don't advance straight away and remain crouched in the doorway. A Fencer will walk across the room, heading away from you; once you see that, sneak up behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/04694956affe0e3a06190b860897aa3cab007acea59ddb9eb1ba4aa7bbdc5555.jpg)

On the other side of the room another Fencer along with an Old Maid behind him will start moving towards a room at the opposite end of the walkway. Wait until the Old Maid passes the bridge connecting the two walkways, and then throw a Shuriken at her for an easy victory.

![](images/850a70ca9f414d9c136bbbe4fe2d105be5fbb78afbe2b2dfa2aba6bd6eaa79fa.jpg)

By this time the Fencer should just about be entering this room. He'll still have his back to you, so quietly approach from behind and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/faa6a923fed991f94bd4d234843dd1b6e820674d5db97354162946872aa6b7e1.jpg)

If you look over the railing here you'll see the bottom floor of the castle below, and you can actually jump down and grapple onto a beam halfway down, and then drop down from there. The route we're following will clear out the rest of the upper floors first, so if you want to pick things up from the lower floors, turn to P.204

![](images/428c220afed785b22ecde3fe87757cd170978a8c6d85cc623348a722763947fe.jpg)

The way forward is to grapple up to the hole in the roof here, but it's highly recommended that you take the time to kill the two Fencers drinking tea just ahead. You can easily sneak up behind the closer one and use a Backstab Deathblow on him, meaning you'll only have to take on one in open combat. With the area clear, approach the wall at the back of the room and hug it to reveal a Shinobi Shortcut that access a small treasure room containing a chest with a Prayer Bead.

![](images/4dd101159fe8c78ccbf9a848694e259df2522045b4a1a0b63ff90a43879d7ce3.jpg)

Circle around to the back of the hole here and use a Shuriken to kill the Old Maid in the area below you. When she's out of the way, drop down and use a Backstab Deathblow on the Ashina Soldier before he can react, and then finish off the nearby Fencer. Now that the room is clear you can open the door, giving you a shortcut back here from the Idol if you need it.

![](images/9e978fc533e59c711b9fa1c4a8f79306712229d6d59629c35b674d9ce528f0c1.jpg)
