![](images/b33805565883f053c6f250c61413745d8a8968e27e917f6f59e19a54898555a2.jpg)

The stairs here lead up to the dojo part of the castle, but you can also reach that area via another route by continuing around this floor. Taking the lower route will make one of the fights nearby slightly easier, so it's the recommended approach. While you're here though, you may want to quickly run up the stairs to commune with the Idol so that it's already activated in case you need it.

![](images/e5b1d6b48621da282fbeeabf464d5cae484f396bdfe329df1581c2f75ab1ede5.jpg)

![](images/b3367607a9af9db60fff8d647508b393913c6e0a9aa296ddbc76bfe7e8c9a7a0.jpg)

The two samurai here are facing the wall just enough that you can sneak up behind the one closest to you and use a Backstab Death-blow. It can be awkward fighting the remaining samurai in the tight hallway, so you may want to retreat to the previous room and fight there.

![](images/256d6b88c5d04ac93f42568f6aeeebb68e35c8e1d9b5eb8a25365ec5f3cd07db.jpg)

Break through the paper screen at the end of the hall that the two previous samurai were in, and then hug the corner of the wall here. At the end of the long hallway ahead you'll see three Nightjar Ninja; with no way to be sneaky here, you're going to have to fight them in open combat. Head down the stairs just far enough so that you can lock onto one of the Nightjars, and then throw a Shuriken at it to make the whole group come running towards you. Retreat back up the stairs so that you can use the narrow doorway as a choke point that the Nightjars have to squeeze through, making it harder for them to surround you. While they're in the doorway and bunched up, hitting them with the Flame Vent can be very effective to weaken them before you use other attacks. When they're all dead, proceed along the hallway and head up the stairway at the end.

![](images/f80505390eae1cb1266bf0257761f0b9df2acab79bd609f55a26422f80b3ccd8.jpg)

![](images/22c3b35070f9f798999621a87f364c1f0d53a9c9d3510e75954d92aa4a35cb42.jpg)

This room is the home of the infamous Isshin Ashina, but as indicated by the note he left for Emma, currently he is not here. The note hints that he has gone to investigate something near the Ashina Castle Gate, but the only person you met there is the mysterious Tenu...

![](images/5090199454672c34d30b25edeff79aedc44912c3cfca15a36c16d7e94f775ca1.jpg)

![](images/01df9227af40e86ff7a765e4160877b6d6dba760989c53c138e6cc61acfa24b6.jpg)

# Isshin Ashina

If you come here directly after having already completed the steps required to have Isshin return home, the note giving you a hint as to his whereabouts will not be on the floor. To make him appear here you will need to have defeated the boss at the top of the castle, have received instruction from

![](images/9be54cce920ef2125e33ff22d2621f64d35a3df5f23702474d744e68e88120fc.jpg)

Lord Kuro, and have spoken to the Tengu of Ashina. For more information on Isshin check P.553, and if it's the Tengu you're interested in, go to P.568.

![](images/a5a9d4402072c81dbbefe4a2c1055e451ba8b95626226b588ff69b8fc027b6ee.jpg)

![](images/7f2fcbb82d9100a3197a42c720521518f9007dc0a349bff9766902f67dbc3b53.jpg)

![](images/8af23ec902b4279b0d1500aa52a54637de30d9ea7c08f7ccb4eba5225d2f8b5a.jpg)

![](images/8c9a7f5fee413e6973cab9a92a1d2eb0cf1e797bbc54aa11aef53fadc5e85d2c.jpg)

![](images/e5353f0e45e3baf1eb9aa6d12b36d298499b9c1be04be3f975d59ca1094b13ec.jpg)

Exit Isshin's watchtower so that you're back in the castle exterior, and then jump down onto the long connecting rooftop that leads back to the main castle and grapple up to the rooftop on that side.

![](images/5254fc062244627a46c4b444d290989f77004dc96c000e9feaa557554bd281d7.jpg)

It's possible to jump up the rooftop tiers from here and go straight to the Castle Tower Lookout area where the boss awaits, but only do so if you have already been to the Upper Tower - Ashina Dojo Idol, so that you have a nearby Idol to resurrect from if you're defeated.

![](images/5eaf78dad317e776fcb7afdf28c02b42ec7842657f264dcad9e0a8a3d4eb7f0c.jpg)

Follow the rooftop around to here, and then stay on the same rooftop tier and follow it around to the left. As you run along that section of the rooftop you'll see an item hidden in the overhang of a higher tier; grab that and then continue in the same direction.

![](images/1bffb602e8f16e282cc0fb383ebe809ab3673edfaf7d0ebacd78e2acb7fd83d6.jpg)

When you reach the next corner of the roof you'll be able to see the purple smoke guiding you towards the open window that leads into the dojo area.

![](images/1cea5cf59959a0bb1a333be0e376bb6eb005a1a008c9e338e82c3cb4d9993487.jpg)

![](images/36cf3bb332f797b0c1bc38353598dff2fa1a38bdd1e4e8b149a9de4059e57206.jpg)

![](images/48801f5bc2dd8e11e3530a8ba5f382b47d0ebe1c7fe7eb4483c0e296c7a2ea0d.jpg)

# Upper Tower - Ashina Dojo

This dojo area is where only the most elite of samurai are permitted to train. The Idol here provides you with the closest point from which to reach the Castle Tower Lookout, so it's the ideal place to launch subsequent boss attempts from.

![](images/08c4af78491dd34a29cf5f01fe120988edf6d48d9d4551363c958410334bac47.jpg)

This elite Fencer is a master of the quick draw style, and uses the Ashina Cross almost exclusively. Once released it is extremely fast and hits twice, but there's a tiny glint at the hilt of his sword that indicates when it's coming, so pay close attention and look out for that. If you're sneaking in through the window, you may want to use an Ako's Sugar before jumping through and starting the fight, because you're going to want to maximize your Posture damage. Deflecting his Ashina Cross is by far the best way to defeat him; this tactic can be made even easier and deadlier if you use the Loaded Umbrella, so if you're having difficulty, acquiring that tool is highly recommended.

![](images/1c635bf956a4c47bf4913d030c03484970e29e034377176d3190d1f0780add54.jpg)

The scroll on the back of the wall here can be read to learn some of the history behind the legendary Lightning Reversal technique, which you may find useful while fighting the upcoming boss.

![](images/b296a8765fd18a311d02e86afc552248e96a7e379bfa447fc47c8bebf5dd0936.jpg)

In this section of the area you'll find another Remnant that you can interact with to learn more about Kuro and Emma's relationship.

![](images/561111e72d52965674aab001a3784f1684df0ca65b071c5c10b7120e6aa09b1c.jpg)

Make sure to commune with the Idol before leaving. Where you head will depend on what you want to do; if you've already explored the lower floor and the grounds to the rear, then jump back out the window and head up to the boss (skip to P.210). If you haven't explored those areas yet, then either go down the nearby stairs and make your way round to the large hole in the room below, or simply travel back to the Upper Tower - Antechamber Idol. Whichever way you go, when you reach the hole, jump over the railing and grapple onto the beam below.

![](images/83675a0760033b24b499c0041d1411ed3cb863fe24a2536351647521af3f1a15.jpg)

While you're on the beam, take the time to look down and spot the locations of the enemy group below. There are a lot of enemies in a small area down there, and it's very easy to get surrounded and overwhelmed if you drop down haphazardly. Tools like the Firecrackers can help manage the group, but you can also take a different approach. The Fencer is blocking a doorway in front of the trio of soldiers, so if you jump from the beam and use a Plunging Deathblow on him you'll be able to go through the doorway. Now you can use the doorway as a choke point and attack the soldiers as they attempt to funnel through one at a time.

![](images/050ab086b8be306d1e427f8d5b4f474a298a4c867b7e1f4fff5d7e7549f66c89.jpg)

When the area is clear you can go to the front door of the castle and unbar it to create a pathway between this area and the Ashina Castle Idol if you need it.

![](images/c87e84e9ac9e4c6759ce1e5642d7a183d7f1bc4b21b7ee9d609592dcb5c14c90.jpg)

The doorway in this room leads to the rear exterior of the castle, but before heading out there, make sure to open the chest and claim Sabimaru. The Sculptor can use this item to create a very powerful dagger tool. Once you have the items, unbar the backdoor and head outside.

![](images/5203302413a4c8ab69de2a0c591e18ddca742969fed39a1d04be119d8701d00b.jpg)

If you don't have the Mibu Breathing Technique, then there's very little you can do in the pond here. There are some Man-eating Carp swimming on the surface, so if you do jump in, be ready to take them on.

![](images/7e71847e44ae000445506d505f1d9a512f837b97be30e6f432a78235801dc7e5.jpg)

![](images/3b7b26b549f1d5fcebaf8290c197f9724f8beada7a424c40bef42180aede89b6.jpg)

With the breathing technique, however, you'll be able to dive beneath the surface of lake and face the intimidating underwater Headless. These enemies are very different to their landlocked brethren in that you do not need to imbue your weapons with any kind of Spirit energy to damage them, and they have a completely different set of attacks. While you do not need to use it, applying a Divine Confetti to your weapon will still give you a significant damage increase against them. You cannot use most items while you're in the water, so make sure to apply it before jumping in.

The only items you can use underwater are Gourds, so if you want a way to reduce the Terror build-up from its attacks, you'll need to travel to the Exiled Memorial Mob near the Mibu Village idol in Ashina Depths and buy the Mottled Purple Gourd. This enemy has a lot of Vitality, and because of the limited options you have while underwater, it's very dangerous. It's recommended that you return here later in the game once you're significantly stronger. If you still want to find out the best tactics to use against this foe, turn to P.401.

![](images/d1e9e475bd5aaced7b2fa3c76972f3b355522883b95700ff82f334df9de4427e.jpg)

At the other end of the street from here you'll see a dangerous Shinobi Hunter patrolling back and forth near another Ashina Soldier. If you grapple up to the branch directly ahead of this point you can reach a ledge that runs around the side of the street, and from there

you can use a Plunging Deathblow on the monk to take him out easily, leaving only the soldier to finish off.

![](images/f29c6ff8f83f5a6cd45e3c96b6bd07f0e0963d18f40f91615c8074eb384817a7.jpg)

![](images/ed725cf75380198beb49bf8612966749d2f6d07fb56f08fd1b958ce3b96ced8a.jpg)

You have a choice of paths again once you reach here, with one path going up towards Great Serpent Shrine, and the other going down to the Old Grave. The Old Grave is closer, so going there first is advised so that you have a handy restart point if things go badly.

![](images/508eb1746164ad507494a1137df48987e7e1d98cc27208b4789aaa655ddd2e44.jpg)

![](images/7d71b1fd4985cf0909c5f7c2b427caaf751a3b02055649b3b0f08752d12a7669.jpg)

# Old Grave

This Idol sits at the top of a heavily fortified section of the castle grounds overlooking Ashina Outskirts. Soldiers with ranged weapons, including fearsome cannon wielding Sunken Valley Clan, have taken up defensive positions to repel any intruders from the outskirts, but they are not expecting to be attacked from the rear.

![](images/cbc937501d6447964324a975f8574f913f7d96df464be2cb02d149007ea559e6.jpg)

Look over the ledge here and you'll see a building below that you can drop down onto, and then drop through the hole in the roof to come face to face with the elusive Blackhat Badger. Once your business with him has concluded you can just grapple back up through the hole and back up to the Idol.

![](images/24521076934e9b387402080fce7e7a343571f31b25f51b9dc1d7d3ed8298e706.jpg)

![](images/09666bfc6a3a51b4e5e0a0022e35a2b7fbc81e079866a3e727c61d5244792bc7.jpg)

# Blackhat Badger

Blackhat Badger is a notorious outlaw that is currently on the run from both the Senpou Temple Assassins and Ashina forces. Thankfully he's in need of money to help him stay one step ahead of them so he's willing to part with some items he's acquired during his travels. Of particular note are the Anti-air Deathblow Text that will allow you to perform Deathblows against airborne enemies once you have it, and the Iron Fortress that can be forged into a highly defensive tool

![](images/c8f96b606972dd2ae3df49ebfa9b364e8a18343e68bd4c7dae76860f38be38b6.jpg)

by the Sculptor. Blackhat Badger has a long journey ahead of him, so if you want to find out where you can meet him next, go to P.565.

![](images/18112e7116af793fbf7aeb149db14ff79310f8cb7fdcbaeeb24ffd7ef5ed3e9b.jpg)

![](images/be2ae4796fd0dcb7858cac5dca6de5c3b018b090f55004b9073b76e436217084.jpg)

It's worth taking the trip over to the grave to get the item and enjoy the scenic view of the outskirts. While you can drop down to the area below from here, doing so puts you at a disadvantage against the enemies due to the way they're facing, so it's better to work your way down from the other side.

![](images/24f2c3e20a2d6ab180256a36d9837055e92dae866dfd34b5f9c58dc042a9e341.jpg)

![](images/531fe778f0cc7b0ebbda2f31305a87d04a50fb4ece08189d70b606bfdd915819.jpg)

Climb onto the wall here and grapple straight across to the lower part of the roof on the building directly ahead. From there you can grapple straight into the back of the watchtower and Backstab Deathblow the clan member, and then turn around and using a Plunging Deathblow on one of the soldiers below before cutting down the other.

![](images/915c926754a2d36ae3de119f9eda2890726119d29900c018e07128201d32c1c0.jpg)

Jump over the wall here, and then hang over the outside of it and shimmy along to the corner. Drop from the wall and grapple across to the branch below you to land safely on it.

![](images/2ec5b22cc5e1485ff2e601696c78dec0c054db5c5fe25517a121f4836854fd36.jpg)

![](images/c69fd45c8a717035009fddaf3d831ade6b3b0e06bdbabab3cd7d84602b789c84.jpg)

Walk to the end of the branch and wall jump up so that you can grab onto the top of the wall and start shimmying along it. Keep going until you're above the ledge that soldier is standing on, and then drop down behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow. The Sunken Valley Clan member in the watchtower ahead has his eyes trained on the upper portion of the area, so as long as you don't go too far out you're safe here.

![](images/44d4c507eb1ef585e44a0f26a1fb19137170572712a06181a2de1c3286b7c544.jpg)

# Ashina Castle

![](images/5a4d64126c952dd0f69b830c0c459e24fc778427c27f7f5430720a29deeb2318.jpg)

![](images/bb0932d4e33c589518925610e57e8f34be5367c5b8a4623ba69b05d6fe97f4f7.jpg)

Drop down from the previous ledge, and then crouch down and make your way across to this area so that you can Backstab Deathblow the soldier here. Go around the back of the watchtower and you'll be able to use another Backstab Deathblow on the soldier facing the tree. Once they're both down, grapple up to the back of the tower and Backstab Deathblow the Valley Clan member.

![](images/9a23d0e1f31a3d82d83a782d0e411d5567de5c8cd8e2bae920b2d205bda25cb7.jpg)

If you're quick, you'll be able to close in behind the patrolling soldier and Backstab Deathblow him while he's still walking away. Make sure to check around the corner before going after him, however, just in case he's on his way back, and if he is, wait at the corner and Wall Hug Deathblow him when he gets close.

![](images/a2c2b32df87af48ea377a4448b7d6b16dcfaa5f7522bd0ec802f7734da214dce.jpg)

![](images/0f552250a64cc9f38c9001962723c8da44fe9fb9c0666405a1c1bb80b8423203.jpg)

Now that there is nobody watching over you in the area you can run to this point and grab onto the ledge. Wait there until you see the patrolling soldier start walking away, and then pull yourself up and Backstab Deathblow the Sentry.

![](images/1e4284acd7b5bf1e1b6cdf78ee768912f1779218c53d782a816ae4f09145de6a.jpg)

![](images/56428a0549fade3e6095035b7306f68452da12e613855734c03adbd568d4840e.jpg)

That's all the enemies in the area so you can now freely collect all of the items. Once you have everything, travel back up to the Old Grave Idol, and then start heading along the path to the Great Serpent Shrine if you haven't already been there.

![](images/c4d0b31ce966d0a5ea985e0526e004215416c3b1418fddc500592f8e3ff8ef6c.jpg)

From here you can eavesdrop on the conversation between the two enemies on the bridge ahead, but don't rush in there to attack them because there's a third soldier on the other side of the bridge with his rifle sights trained on the area. Instead, drop down into the water and swim under the bridge to get past them.

![](images/b6c7c063b85fa363464f7b44df8fa50cbdef9f4cf5f073f1b4c3d78904616876.jpg)

![](images/e4c4b5ff3b34c291a098d5460a590c978c35fd246a9fd8aa9d76d0a27b4a136d.jpg)

# Anayama the Peddler Update

The information you obtain from eavesdropping on those soldiers is just the stuff the Anayama was interested in knowing, so you may want to go back and let him know what you found out. From the profits brought about by the information you give him, Anayama will have an increased selection of goods available the next time you visit him.

![](images/439d5071b32bd77104cb0bfa82b2179a6b811eb1e3608da8d1f8f8a415b58b31.jpg)

![](images/fcfd594c7348828f291d4cc1ae34e2e7d5aa3be6ca44d3599e4642b1cabc6bb5.jpg)

Wall jump out of the water here and grab the ledge above so that you can see the unaware soldier standing above you; shimmy yourself into position and then use a Ledge Hang Deathblow on him.

![](images/5638f3c6298832fac49387038e9932466841adc13389b02c18c9e341175cf20d.jpg)

![](images/228bec75c6a63d62262c0e8bda3896127bb09983c11a1250852ee285d57d49fe.jpg)

Now that the soldier is not watching over you, sneak up behind the Samurai General and use a Backstab Deathblow on him before striking down his conversation partner.

![](images/9a2f819e9e0028dc95607d6ea4a1f83709b99f6432d7128443cec7e31ab2e374.jpg)

![](images/a74ad3dbc515a72c74b0d100d7915650d11045c54e9c450fc94db869c260410d.jpg)

If you stand in the corner here you can wall jump off the gate and grab onto the nearby wall. From there you can pull yourself up and cross over the roof of the gate to reach a ledge that runs along the back of pond and has an item on it.

![](images/228993a0fcce7598676a86a72c645a40472cf49062cbfc85b4af4f05e4857a9b.jpg)

A small group of Valley Monkeys have come up from the Sunken Valley and taken up residence in this area, and while some of them are trying to use the long grass to their advantage, they're no match for a shinobi's keen senses.

![](images/277a291be4cefc7ba1572519a20c5a4747c8bcb2548e4eccd3edec210f4e5d5e.jpg)

Crouch down in the long grass and move along it until you can see the monkey sat on top of the torii gate. Shuriken are by far the most efficient way of dealing with these monkeys, and it should only take two to finish one off for good. Once you've taken out the first one, move a bit further along the grass and then use your lock-on to find the other two that are hidden in the grass and use Shuriken on them too.

![](images/587df1c8f0bfd64bb6a69b141b60536dfdb158385b16df75c6d457524c12d819.jpg)

![](images/acb0fd85880b1f101879952d1d48c6e986d159ad79e4f8c622c065a50ed6a5f2.jpg)

# Great Serpent Shrine

The building that houses this shrine overlooks the giant chasm that signifies the start of the Sunken Valley. To reach it from here you'll need to jump over the railings at the back and grapple onto the branch on the opposite side as you fall. If you're coming here before beating the boss of Ashina Castle you won't be able to make it all the way through the Sunken Valley because you require a key that you cannot

![](images/e956511e38f3bd166423d592e826ebd1fbf3bba70d00d75c729bc9c69433c581.jpg)

obtain yet. It is, however, worth jumping across and communing with the Under-Shrine Valley Idol now so that you can travel back there later with ease.

![](images/54f35a7fdfcfd69de87559358c8e095a943b3cf84d3e284af74bd503b4f3adad.jpg)

![](images/3eb31d641508d74ff8c0d5997ae49c13d657ef2b3768cdabfc558970301fa63b.jpg)

With the castle and its grounds now fully explored, it's time to head up and face the boss at the top of the castle. To get there, use the Idol here to travel to the Upper Tower - Ashina Dojo Idol, and then jump out onto the rooftops and grapple your way up.

![](images/9ba1fb89e5fa1e8f6d0f2d3698dcc800070958bec579376f74ef772d905a38d6.jpg)

![](images/cb79fe577254d468f579cd400a82417aaa38b270f3f7698e215d478f9e1eaaf7.jpg)  
Ashina Castle

# Item Legend

39 Gachiin's Sugar x1  
40 Light Coin Purse x1  
48 Yashariku's Sugar x1

50 Heavy Coin Purse x1

![](images/18ef9a1e8262fc7ffac23a86116d028eb163471ebb913b31245e2683f34565f7.jpg)

![](images/a811cd15cf58a19fdfdee0cbd96f6d15e619d2d9833cfc8fd87ce3f7dda8d999.jpg)

It's time to face your nemesis, the one responsible for taking your arm and the Divine Heir. Unlike the previous bosses you've encountered, Genichiro has a total of three Deathblow Markers that you'll need to remove before he's defeated. During the first part of the fight he'll have two Deathblow Markers and he'll fight fairly similarly during both phases. After taking his second Deathblow Marker, however, a cutscene will play and he'll undergo a transformation. At this point in the fight he gains new attacks and fights quite differently.

In the first part of the fight he uses a combination of sword and bow attacks, and because of his bow you should always be ready to deal with an attack, even when at range. This is especially true if you're attempting to heal because that will nearly always result in him firing his bow at you. Try to stay as far back as you can while healing so that you have more time to react to the bow shot.

For the final stage of the battle Genichiro has the ability to imbue some attacks with the power of lightning, and if you're on the ground when he uses those attacks, they will stun you for a few seconds. While those lightning attacks are very dangerous, they can also be used against him. When you see him jump to use one of those attacks, jump up and do a Lightning Reversal on them to inflict massive Vitality and Posture damage to Genichiro, and stun him so you can land further attacks. For a more comprehensive breakdown of everything Genichiro can do, turn to P.442.

![](images/9c7449a055105ad5c77abe9d25aa69984859b9fbef156de5cdf0c4b3c3b0931d.jpg)

![](images/ed5a5dcecbb65625f9a7af1e8d6d4ab12102682c660d9d6a486cd162e8573afd.jpg)

# Castle Tower Lookout

Upon defeating Genichiro this new Idol will appear near the doorway in the room, and you'll get a Memory of the battle along with the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu Skill. This skill is extremely powerful under the right circumstances, and it's highly recommended that you equip it as soon as possible.

There's another nearby Idol that you'll unlock shortly, but this one does provide you with a clear and direct route to Isshin's watchtower if you require it.

![](images/4c45bba18a1e0b10920822641075dcf51c79083cecc7b078ca98218acfb00ffa.jpg)

Emma can be found standing just outside the room now, and if you talk with her, you'll learn more of her story and she'll inform you that Lord Kuro is waiting for you down the nearby staircase

![](images/9f5fa064e2a73713e9e202080ab1199f6d000a82353c6431680a71705b5c6fb5.jpg)

# Emma the Physician Update

Emma will remain in this location until you have progressed the main story events to the point at which you have spoken with Isshin Ashina. Until that time you'll be unable to make use of her services.

![](images/0afba28b437c36596a69bcab65eaa953e2ce4595b8ca50fd9e3aff7c5d131bac.jpg)

# Upper Tower - Kuro's Room

This Idol automatically gets added to the Important Places section of your Travel menu once you commute with it for the first time, which is an indication of how many times you'll be coming back here. This room is the hub through

![](images/363140b55b1654617675d0b2747bb63bd6768b440819d257b6aa9265affb1e82.jpg)

which many key story and progression events take place, and where you'll often be able to obtain clues as to how you should proceed if you're unsure of where to go.

![](images/56e7c34650388e48be316fca8646ed58a0d61c101ed8e2dc498549d122c4e33f.jpg)

At the end of this hallway there's a Shinobi Shortcut that you can use that will take you to the end of the small tunnel in the Dilapidated Temple Area. The shortcut is slightly faster than going through the Travel menu of the nearby Idol, so you may as well use it if the temple is your destination.

![](images/57d6178bf7154422bbc526725c7ffcee59a6df1ed05442804d8a5d0023bdda86.jpg)

If you head around to the narrow passage here and hug the wall you can eavesdrop on Lord Kuro and learn about how the situation is troubling him. Some of the information you learn from eavesdropping on Kuro here will open new dialogue options with other characters that are very important depending on which ending you're going for; make sure to return here often and see if he says anything new. To learn more about these interactions, turn to P.548.

![](images/9377d2886f3a49721f7a20f8619f2a59c2af8870c9b5178fa179293b555d4ead.jpg)

![](images/d6c8a6fe1e5fa980ec1edf4f6474096b44a8b07ef979ce690de1e540cb60b552.jpg)

Speak with Kuro when you're ready to proceed, and during the conversation he will hand over the Immortal Severance Text that provides some clues as to how his wishes can be carried out. Examine the nearby incense burner when asked, and even more information will come to light. Talk to Kuro once more and he'll task you with your most immediate goal: gather information from Isshin Ashina.

![](images/2ca89dc206350d9c08bc91040b97a3c8c2a02fd3ba446054afc0c45b5dd7ad0b.jpg)

Kuro will walk over towards this area to point you in the direction of a window that you can open and jump through to reach the exterior rooftops. Isshin's watchtower is across the adjoining rooftop to the right, and since there's no enemies here, you can just grapple your way across quickly. Speak to Isshin and he'll give you some Unrefined Sake, and then you'll be able to ask him about the Mortal Blade and where it can be found. Now that you have all the information you came here for, return to Kuro.

# Sake!

There are many different types of sake, and each type will lead to a different conversation from the multiple people that you can offer to share a drink with. Once you use the sake it will be gone forever, and you'll need to find more if you want to keep sharing drinks with people. Go to P.134 for a full list of the available sake types and who you can share them with.

![](images/1bc5677e2d9b6d6b09abc968c14efb931f7f04236c51fbeb5562c07091fed724.jpg)

# Isshin Ashina Update

If Isshin is not currently in his watchtower, it means that you have either not spoken to the Tenu of Ashina or not finished speaking to Lord Kuro.

![](images/9f48f0b1f4bf6967a9a328c2fd003351dd9fa1283765a8d67703dd7788948df1.jpg)

When you return to this room you'll find a note on the mat in the middle letting you know that Kuro has discovered the location of the library, so go through the now open door and join him here. After informing him about the Mortal Blade, ask about the flower and he'll pass on what he has learned about it in the form of a Fragrant Flower Note, which leads to a potential location to investigate.

If you smell the incense burner in the main room again, and then speak to Kuro once more you can learn about a sakura tree that has a very similar fragrance. Emma knows more about the tree, so speak with her to gain more information, and then relay that to Kuro to continue trying to unravel the mystery.

![](images/e8ed71daee84629768ad38908b1dcdec3521096b473885a8a857fa4108da8fad.jpg)

![](images/ab9d2e4f2e7b080a4140d6b8b748150847ba53cf793f1eac580c2ec028b581f7.jpg)

The window in the library here can be opened to allow you to quickly reach the front of the castle exterior.

![](images/98b01bc87dff9cf2ba5759bb0feeb918d5b0788deb09db81f173f447290adae7.jpg)

The item here is the Gun Fort Shrine Key, which is required to unlock a door in the Sunken Valley in order to reach the Sunken Valley Passage. With all the information you've managed to gather thus far, two main locations stand out as ones that warrant further investigation. You can either go down the winding path at the back of the castle to the Great Serpent Shrine and the Sunken Valley just beyond it, or go through the Abandoned Dungeon to reach Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo. Our recommendation is to go to Senpou Temple first, so for that area turn to P.222, or if you want to go to the Sunken Valley, go to P.246.

![](images/f09a2b2463c66952e718308d37c28edecc0588b3c03cfb47417004b741b3411e.jpg)

![](images/b025c73635e5f331e62447eb25c5e9199a7ed5e35be2ba45a97b33325f4209a7.jpg)

The Wolf returns to the area where Lord Kuro was held captive, and finds it somewhat changed by daylight. The secret tunnel can no longer be accessed, but a route via the sewers to the Abandoned Dungeon may be helpful in reaching his new destinations.

![](images/36661791d7fe0daa4888cf05d1f074adb68f4d234ff1ea956ac5c467b07650be.jpg)

![](images/91cb210d12ce5f9a6f9481921f59e2389190ec6f5955f2e14cfef696fe640bb2.jpg)

![](images/f47bc4231b2c0ce8861323ee617a9d6102222d63a7dc390e6d2c316d95a92b09.jpg)

While it may be tempting to run straight ahead and attack the soldiers directly ahead of you when you first enter the area, it's worth taking a trip along this path first to reach a small group of Assassins that are guarding some useful items.

![](images/c2ae76ccb9dc20bf729048555dd3e49487e3e5d54167a0de5357370192e64e67.jpg)

Drop down from here to the ledge below the bridge, and grapple across to the other side of the gap.

![](images/80f00972d68149271166f309a3b7badd04d87b8bad8df87ae10408192ec1455d.jpg)

![](images/0bf1c040861c461c8613eb3fedf7ec013ae330dc4a8661271585910e6ef4274a.jpg)

Peer around the corner here and you'll see an Assassin looking out over the ledge; drop down and sneak behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/8e807589665582f68e5857df2bf634816296a0ae1ff90c2bf9029fdf23f9fd19.jpg)

![](images/c59e5e077dcfba8270d981d98781eabd6118c6300fd59bc885822f5eb8ed443e.jpg)

Continue along the ledge and you'll be able to sneak up behind another Assassin on the other side of the moat and Backstab Deathblow him, before grabbing the items he was hoarding.

![](images/c787976cb8e8a2de6dcf29e18ec0af79f77af88504611e409f07168e0f0ae7bc.jpg)

Look down into the moat from here and you'll see the final Assassin foraging in the shallow water below you—a prime target for a Plunging Deathblow.

![](images/792a27ffc437c7a8f4e2c163795c674a48a380a2d69a46876be7fc9bb36b1226.jpg)

The door here is locked and you have no means of opening it currently. Follow the series of grapple points towards the bridge, and then across to the other side of the moat to end up back where you started.

![](images/bb1d4285ed7cdd36ab7d3fc436cc0534ae9d1a539c38d47b8291b977047f84d8.jpg)

If you want to avoid fighting the group of enemies near the stairs at the start of the area, grapple across to the branch protruding from the cliff from here. From there, you can grapple to another branch to reach the other side of the area.

![](images/40c106668c5b24981cb4f9e82d359000e9092a94d73900d272b6ef344f11b5fd.jpg)

![](images/0fb66d6ebcb115824f0c9c56437b2e59ba62e04cec79ccd590403df255107484.jpg)

Eavesdrop on the two soldiers here and you'll learn that there is potentially another shinobi in the area; little do they know that there is already one close by. From the top of the stairs you can Shuriken both Hounds, causing the soldiers to run towards the gate to investigate. While they have their backs to you, run and Backstab Deathblow one of them, then dispatch the other with basic attacks.

![](images/28fdd7c1dd4a5ca335fc074e236a46ddc2eefd45bfa41a9cbac461383ea3ba9d.jpg)

The area beyond the gate nearby is under close watch by many ranged enemies, so your best option is to try to sneak around behind them, denying them a target. Walk out onto the branch here and grapple across to the one on the other side—here you'll be in a better position to accomplish that goal.

![](images/f22016956fa0400c63fafb13a56abcbd143b78f44635cdbe683f6cfcee8785a9.jpg)

Wall jump up so you can grab the ledge above the branch, and then pull yourself up to the top of the wall. From there you can see the Sentry ahead of you; walk along the wall a bit so that you can drop down behind him, and then sneak up for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/007f9b2e5a124c700c7f91a812f2c2688a0cd53dbc974a091f3739ee1fb5d004.jpg)

![](images/3b2927a226ca34d99743311df2e9cf2972565e67d26de0645539fcb22d2fa9be.jpg)

You can shimmy along the ledge here to reach the access point to the well that you emerged from at the beginning of the game. Instead of the note that was down there previously, something much more dangerous awaits you now.

![](images/d6f6b33f6edab945125bc3224cabc3558d5bcb74ede222e40cd39c46e35027a3.jpg)

# Jinzaemon Kumano

Next to the opening to the well you'll find the extremely distracted Jinzaemon, who can seemingly hear music coming from somewhere just out of earshot. If you greet him

![](images/3d74cfb7f0f9efb7b68840624468f6d87a4e6f85098c1b64832a30490ebc7b09.jpg)

you'll learn more about his troubles and take the first steps into helping him find the source of the bewitching sound.

![](images/88af683c0f1777b3a2e5fd28b37c2ff8ecf4893ae9b5717df4f984f309bea765.jpg)

If you go down into the well the same way you escaped, you'll find the Lone Shadow Longswordsman standing in the middle of the room you awoke in. Unlike most other sub-boss enemies, you can approach this one and strike up a conversation with him to find out that he's looking for a shinobi that he was told was in this very room. Talk to him a second time, however, and he'll realize that you are the shinobi he's looking for and attack you.

The passageway leading to the Abandoned Dungeon is sealed by a barrier, so you cannot enter it from this side until he's defeated, even if you used that tunnel to reach this area in the first place. If you approach the Longswordman via the passageway you'll be unable to use a Backstab Deathblow on him, but there is still a way to remove one of his Deathblow Markers before getting into direct combat. Instead of dropping into the well at the first opening, walk past it and along the ravine until you come to the second opening, which is directly above the Longswordman. From there you can initiate the fight with a Plunging Deathblow and drastically increase your chance of victory. To find out what other weakness this enemy has, turn to P.430.

![](images/c079a6a91e87fad1bfb0465bedfa06a3e1c00372b91f3ece4499ebadef8c7ed8.jpg)  
To Abandoned Dungeon

![](images/df6680bd49962719ffa535941bf2b624c902ac43666ec258a6b3591a7a5ce731.jpg)  
Lone Shadow Longswordsman Lone Shadow P430

![](images/58e12bdc3459ac344b972b4ca75efd3488417000ad920fe8e3ff2fd120e7db91.jpg)

This water channel will allow you to reach the Abandoned Dungeon on the other side of the Shichimen Warrior so that you can access Ashina Depths without having to defeat him. If you have the Mibu Breathing Technique, there's also an item underwater that you can snag.

![](images/3905ccb9ae87cae1025f995af56e5960bdbd30878a4277a9e6bec5590783f617.jpg)

The soldier here is facing away from you, so you can quietly sneak up behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow. Make sure not to continue forward past that point, however, or else the soldier on the ledge behind the gatehouse will spot you and open fire, alerting the other enemies.

![](images/a1274f1ecd74367ece56bdef9daa40a9e60fe9250f693bb2cfaba68557497ac2.jpg)  
Shikibu Toshikatsu Yamauchi Seven Ashina Spears P427

![](images/0601e2b7f6419faabe8c68d83b7c4549b8430432f28bbd76f569044b67fea8ee.jpg)

![](images/af954d5c6fd896a75f58273c1a482e8df3036dd9fc987651a73adc2c69aa0643.jpg)

![](images/cd43f5bf4e47252b21e9502374b523f015c6f9b9bbd9d2fe12c73672352bd3cd.jpg)

If you obtained the Gatehouse Key from the soldier on the bridge leading to the Abandoned Dungeon in Ashina Castle, you can use it to gain access to this building here. Inside you'll find a chest containing Gyoubu's Broken Horn, which can be used to create the Loaded Spear.

![](images/e50af7beae7677d7eef714727a6b0a18d4733468cdb05c583da3c862d3f8698c.jpg)

Use the crawlspace beneath the house to reach the ledge on the other side—Backstab Deathblow the soldier there when you emerge.

![](images/c7bc3098e724c01fad6d6a6b3792d2a4ba894e527884d3a0baeca5ede1491398.jpg)

You can avoid fighting most of the other enemies by continuing through the long grass to this point and using a Backstab Deathblow on the soldier with his back to you. Once he's down you have a straight path along the ledges to the Moon-view Tower.

![](images/d5b152e3b01b8880a23c402d6627a52fbcb662d0321a03cedefd5e3f8d334a84.jpg)

![](images/4f72e2668e86f6bce717514a6969f758f8ca8bb171d096b595307871047f8ea3.jpg)

Jump down and kill the soldier below the ledge here, and then sneak around to Position A and Backstab Deathblow that soldier, while making sure that the patrolling Taro Troops on the main path don't see you.

![](images/0370928ab021f4e01872fbe50844c5128037caa6315f05a1d4caaa1e966fc1ce.jpg)

![](images/54dc669e7dffcd7da2e7a6e60a2a353720d7fc65d8293a6ae4c340d380e1ae43.jpg)

Hide behind the wall here so that you can observe the patrolling Taro Troop unseen. When both of them start walking away, drop down and Backstab Deathblow the closest one. As soon as he's down, quickly move behind the large stones.

![](images/2bea3aa1f85a60ab9586829bb60aee831e56cd369fa1c0c5697b6b61b87fa488.jpg)

Wait behind the stones until the other Taro Troop starts walking away again, and then sneak up behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow. The final soldier in the area is standing nearby with his back to you, allowing for an easy Backstab Deathblow kill.

![](images/d8d1d0d1b1ff8824ef9c7354cad0928a5820b54ea9a348cfa9eeb7af7df1e10f.jpg)

![](images/c94af7a1ef2d81d35c694f3b7fde92decda6e00cc25609787d8878d6b807c817.jpg)

This imposing spear-wielder has a commanding view over the area from his position atop these stairs—if you approach him directly, he'll be able to easily detect you before you get close. Follow the cliffs around the outskirts of the area as if you were attempting to reach the hole in the side of the tower, however, and you can easily get behind him to start the fight with a Backstab Deathblow.

Try to keep the battle away from the stairs once you're in combat, because the angle of the terrain there makes it awkward to fight. This enemy has a lot of thrusting attacks, so if you're going to fight him, make sure to have the Mikiri Counter Skill. Head over to P.427 for a more in-depth strategy.

![](images/72fd292ae6786202c805f246e3c43d66f0fe73a85e372b1094fa02840402b3c2.jpg)

![](images/de7fb061d88ec698aa586a206d407b3dece961e3887696626ae0b69eb99c085d.jpg)

If you want to avoid fighting the sub-boss but still get the items on the rooftop, you can grapple up there from here without him detecting you.

![](images/3fe2421eddac9ef68895baa37911eb6d9b8a133fe44b4eb398352ee2de833aa9.jpg)

![](images/5f8775d9d89060a7d02daf6c0690146e34f03673621014af0e3c25ce29d238e8.jpg)

An underground cave system that connects some of Ashina's disparate areas, this is a place infested with disease and home to unscrupulous characters. The Wolf will find plenty to uncover here.

![](images/d843c2bc83552c6bafa707c9a740adb617ec0228d4f39006461c7491bc5542bf.jpg)

As soon as you pass the doorway threshold at the bottom of the stairs, look for a tiny opening in the wall on the right that you can crawl through to reach an item at the back of the cell.

![](images/535fccefb4cdebab7be94cedf2b07b66205cf26245ac033c1ebf28c190787031.jpg)

![](images/33544044caf2f6716166152671b4c00fd49cf5f31878cd38447651c7122c6d8a.jpg)

A seemingly lifeless corpse will rise up when you get near the item—these enemies are not quite as feeble as they may first appear. After years of being experimented upon, they have developed strong recuperative abilities, so after you kill them the first time, they'll rise again and you'll need to kill them a second time before they stay dead. If you apply the Burn status to them before they die for the first time it will negate their ability to come back to life.

![](images/1539b01a7828e02077cd1832dc395b60dc93433de6ddbf5aeb8a55f7f04ac5c6.jpg)

![](images/2f0c695a005c2e5a35a70aa90bb8256fd9efdb397e8b5de06d593615cdebcb3a.jpg)

Planks link the beams that run above the dungeon, and you can grapple up to them here to reach the opposite end without having to fight your way past any of the Test Subjects.

![](images/082d156051a06907bc24696b76ac4ea13c4355b3e6514dd75f6bce1887f82f90.jpg)

![](images/de3f274b843e21e026640599c08fe994e4f3ad82da813f7e00c77370584bf4b8.jpg)

Like the first cell, the item in this one is also designed to lure you into a trap. As soon as you pick it up, a group of Crickets will drop down, so be ready to attack them straight away. The note that you acquire here gives you further hints as to the location of one of the items you need to recreate the fragrance.

![](images/ffea763ba4ca3a3e8f688dbc2dda48f9106d98f792a123465f4c79cf3aeadb1b.jpg)

![](images/4043e694c131999833c6c9b66beaa558a415d4109dde98a2ea3286ace71a49e7.jpg)

# Dojun

The surgeon Dojun can be found standing outside the cell he's using as a makeshift operating theater. If you speak with him and answer yes to his question, he'll ask a favor of you and hand over the Surgeon's Bloody Letter, along with the particulars of his request. To find out more, turn to P.554.

![](images/23483b1ce304a8837f3690174eea98a515daa985d1139b75e5d97c71fedcbd5b.jpg)

![](images/f4308de0f8b33fc30af509826212ed634aaa9e4057dbd9876be7c0697058517d.jpg)

The lower part of the main cavern is littered with Crickets, so make sure you clear them out before attempting to pick up the items.

![](images/bfc351f401b642f32fdbbaed1873738f5554e5d8e2cac49112ac83fcc741e090.jpg)

![](images/cc2f0b83ed6719040268e1d52610269679c4949d1824929c4252b581eda875a6.jpg)

![](images/8e1c4b9194903ade60da63582f9f7753bc2475f7503a54b262f903fc99e02333.jpg)

From the top of the cliff here you can see the mysterious Shichimen Warrior performing arcane rites at the back of the large cavern. If your goal is to get past him and reach Ashina Depths, know that he will detect you as soon as you drop down and a barrier will appear behind him, stopping you from progressing. To reach Ashina Depths without fighting him, enter the Abandoned Dungeon through the Ashina Reservoir entrance. You cannot sneak up on him, and you cannot Plunging Deathblow him from the top of the cliff on the opposite side; you must face him head on.

Like the Headless, this enemy is an apparition—unless you imbue your weapon with some form of spirit energy, you'll deal very little damage to him. All his attacks inflict Terror, so make sure you have some Pacifying Agent with you as well. Most of his attacks come in the form of projectiles that home in on you; when you see them coming, make use of the large stalagmite near the side of the cavern for cover. This enemy can be very difficult, due to its unorthodox fighting style, so it's recommended that you save your items and confront him when you're stronger. That said, your reward for defeating him is the Ceremonial Tanto and you should try to obtain it as soon as you feel you're strong enough to attain victory. To find out just how to beat him, head to P.416.

![](images/e0e8856a5a5def3e43fa7fa6882c222bb17d8230bfd2f1de34e6dbfddfe59c69.jpg)

![](images/39dc7cb4933b4b6d67ff26b3b975fcac86d4c0c994135f3b96af24dab2f06fb6.jpg)

![](images/87d4f9cc2298ec642e08171b1732f24a27e23bc7800e2e539035f2b2b74c0666.jpg)

# Bottomless Hole

As the name implies, the defining characteristic of this Idol's location is its proximity to the large bottomless hole at the end of the nearby path. If you're going to attempt taking on the Shichimen Warrior, this Idol is also the perfect place to

![](images/91b20b9ebe77d0afdba5aee8ce469d04afed72c5dba4be915eca3271a49021f7.jpg)

rest at beforehand, so that you don't have far to go if you need to attempt him multiple times.

![](images/705ba161d08199bf4e28563691e5ec9812dfc67af330cdde4bc6c0783eaac230.jpg)

# Jinzaemon Kumano

If you've previously spoke to Jinzaemon in Ashina Reservoir, you'll find him sitting along the path leading to the hole. Strike up another conversation and if you've also spoken to Dojun, you'll need to make a difficult choice: lure him to the Abandoned Dungeon, or don't mention it. Head to P.571 to see how these choices impact his future.

![](images/ed1879218b69a3b91094444c587252d1d8db5ca966e388e965e53da9f9dfb601.jpg)

![](images/0b46eb1433a37261eed8de6ca6249298f39543c5cabf4f1e68af20e6db766224.jpg)

# Faithful One

An enigmatic Faithful One has found her way deep into the dungeon, and talking to her will provide you with the knowledge that perhaps there is something to be gained from jumping into the bottomless hole.

![](images/01e69ae3324090c9ad0e9d6f3a51d2d26a34d1e3a000cbf916aa09ef5b454cc8.jpg)

If you listen to the nun's words and are brave enough to take a leap into the unknown, make sure to be ready to grapple at a moment's notice, because that is all that will save you from the abyss. You'll have two chances to grapple to different platforms as you fall; miss them both and you'll plummet to your death.

![](images/204542cf4f685e030b3e14993e364a705e4d96e76739e0d01565eb7b22537269.jpg)

![](images/00f1a021e5f7a7185b4a69a72357341a77155c4278e559c5318ac15b49d3e312.jpg)

Regardless of which platform you grapple to as you fall, you'll be able to make your way around to one of the entrances leading into this cave. The hole behind the Test Subject in the cave leads down to the Ashina Depths, and you will take a fair amount of fall damage when you drop down, so make sure your Vitality is topped up.

![](images/ceb54a0ea67a1bd677bd1506778ef6acb39282fe0ad92d1689ebdc24e44a63b8.jpg)

# Underground Waterway

This Idol will be the first one you can reach if you're entering the Abandoned Dungeon through Ashina Castle, so you may want to commune with it before exploring. It's unlikely that you'll have the Mibu Breathing Technique the first time you come here, so it will serve as a handy travel point to get back here quickly when you do. As the game progresses,

![](images/73e4128e6f06ffa7591fecc01a8fb7f315af27cee34116cba22b80997d7e8ecd.jpg)

however, you will lose access to the Idol from time to time and you'll need to return and commune with it again.

![](images/789758ffc46f0014deaaeb0ca9b5ad59face85b2a85c98b807457053b4a55488.jpg)

![](images/a3b3859821b5947ab8f88b069eb37f4872259e16ff68a372e23fa3d7c4e15e86.jpg)

The waterway here runs deep enough that you can go below the surface if you have the Mibu Breathing Technique. There are Maneating Carp down there, however, so make sure you clear them out before searching for items. Although you can lock onto these carp from the surface, you cannot hit them without going underwater yourself. They won't attack you if you stick to the surface, though, so don't worry about them when swimming along normally.

![](images/88fa8f3ab6b6cdc41fbb6020857317bee8a3e8822b15f5e14449ba940c6fe983.jpg)

There's a tertiary waterway that branches off the main one here that you can access with the Mibu Breathing Technique. Follow it along and you'll be able to enter the cell that Dojun works out of and acquire the items there. You can then open the cell door from the inside so that you have a faster way of getting back there if you need to speak with him in the future.

Underground Waterway

Dojun

![](images/cf5c21a6c182d489047ea1baa7f9c0498f899d54afcddb222b5731a164f6fe40.jpg)

The rifle-wielding soldier standing at the top of the makeshift dock here will open fire on you if you try to swim past, so it's worth taking the time to clear out the enemies and get the items before moving on.

![](images/398c6b08ecef608eb5320a838a0ce9db3084b832c41692e1d41897c34f965b3e.jpg)

![](images/59d5eb42ea2f2cb24d86af08654d229053fd8e9a0165caff9928cecbf22fda03.jpg)

Crouch as soon as you exit the water and quietly make your way up the stairs so that you can get behind the soldier here and use a Backstab Deathblow. The other two soldiers are far enough away that they won't hear, so sneak over there and Backstab Deathblow the first one that you come to, before cutting down the last one.

![](images/29fd72a627a757a44a14a95520bc441e2eb32e85f3ecb5d8403b48af17bf24fa.jpg)

The Man-eating Carp beneath the surface here will often make enough noise while you swim above them that the soldiers standing on the solid ground ahead of you will be alerted. Use the stalagmite formation as cover to wait until they're at ease again.

![](images/2a0e9bb44f31c65d8d62395da4219f4cfe782ef823cb61c6f2954d2bb1187a73.jpg)

Swim around this side of the stalagmites so that they mask your approach and you'll be able to get close enough to the ledge to wall jump up to it and use a Ledge Hang Deathblow on the soldier above. Once he's down, finish off the remaining soldier and continue towards the Senpou Temple.

![](images/242f9051e3f8a2ff537f191a0151c5adec4d00987a233f97552b45704c2155a1.jpg)

![](images/e4cdde18e3c52114f82fff4cfdf3886de885793f3feee6461d752cc7e0797c73.jpg)

Depending on what the time of day is in the game when you reach this area, you may have to contend with some additional enemies in the form of Vengeful Spirits. The exact enemies will depend on which boss you killed first, so to find out those and other details about time of day changes, turn to P.502.

![](images/477bd9fd352a980ca0d80c0d549cc40c9cf93b3d1e9881e84fdb82cc0fd4b747.jpg)

The venerable halls of Senpou Temple are home to the Seekers, a sect of monks that have been driven mad by their obsession with immortality. The Wolf won't find what he's looking for here unless he has knowledge of the Mortal Blade.

![](images/2c1cea7faca447c059fb92ab6988fcc27d1d9e55aa1b7a668a2599a8c0d78a13.jpg)

![](images/1cf74aed3ac951997d92e3ffa97356b2932f523026ead27fd8437ba520b4c357.jpg)

![](images/9b1d9159ab418f68e1aba3fdea34052b9e8bc47fde88c4836c8eac304e5ee030.jpg)

![](images/1a779273fbdc96745183ee109319bd4e0dbaa01561f38d5254e42b4ac854a005.jpg)

# Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo

Upon first entering this area from the Abandoned Dungeon, you'll emerge inside a temple building and be greeted by a disembodied voice emanating from a scroll hanging on the wall next to the Idol. Interact with the scroll to continue the conversation and the voice will give a warning about the dangers of going further into the temple grounds. Your only

![](images/22f898441abe28c451185be29b6114d2878236b365bfb81800c1b1ef9fd2c822.jpg)

due to the whereabouts of the Mortal Blade was that it is somewhere in this area, so regardless of the danger, you must push on.

![](images/6056e9c3385bf04e00446994cabcf54938d566e2befe15e7f9db3daab813b7d7.jpg)

# Kotaro

The shy and innocent Kotaro was abandoned by the other Seekers, and to compound matters it seems as if he's having some trouble with his memory. The only thing he knows is that he must find a 'pure white flower', and since you likely don't have anything that resembles such an item, you can do nothing to ease his suffering. His physical characteristics match those that Anayama the Peddler is looking for, and are exactly what the mysterious Dojun requires to further his

![](images/e33da00a23c00deddb6015568e8c98b5c78e6a05c956deea23be624e2d10a58d.jpg)

testing. Eventually you'll find two items that you can give to Kotaro: one to recover his memories, and the other where you decide his fate. Go to P.558 for more details.

![](images/591a454e49df15ddd62ddded07268329b4e9ee24c56f90fa3f5ea17212ad888d.jpg)

The first Seeker that you encounter is going through his daily mantras while enjoying the view from the end of the broken bridge here. Sneak up behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/3219eb13e418ac071717414b60a3ce5966be207665990976004e6a58594e1373.jpg)

![](images/badcc599c685cb69eb961ce4de8490a035aa570c3909b355ef598e3e03eb65a9.jpg)

The Assassin here is similarly distracted by the kite flying in the sky, so you can also sneak up on him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/c8190999eba066272b631168db4a5cd1032057b4d5945155f641c442fd01d2b0.jpg)

![](images/4288d9e53ec2575a6111031c0f9727d77263aca9b154e1c1a638d9f6f1d25d1d.jpg)

The mechanism here is used for controlling the height at which the kite flies, and while you can use the handle to raise the kite, once you let go, the cord will wind back up and bring the kite down. You need an extra person to keep the kite in place. The Puppeteer Ninjutsu can be acquired from defeating the boss of this area, and once you have it, you can use it on the Assassin that was watching the kite to have him hold the handle in place for you. Keeping the kite in its raised position will allow you to use it as a grapple point to reach an otherwise inaccessible part of the area.

![](images/e2d0cbcea9f103fba1a27de83582b227cb42e3c8aee81c8b11868e1304cd18dc.jpg)

![](images/f71bd2daf3c02f22cc36e1f1e58c147815947cbe4a3970ce884c100b9423d383.jpg)

You can avoid engaging the first group of Seekers by getting into the tall grass here before they patrol down the path, and then following the grass up the hill past them.

![](images/4cacde846399e27ef117db5900910cfee1d281610067132a59d7842096039f1b.jpg)

From the top of this branch you can wait for the first patrolling Seeker to reach the end of the path, and then use a Plunging Death-blow on him.

![](images/38114a412091155df4472514a3aa4027578472656091e9f047593695af2af66e.jpg)

![](images/3e6f82ff252dfd68922b3d13674c6bfd61c1ef723dc34f55f6113892b634623f.jpg)

When that previous Seeker is down, grapple across to this branch and use a Plunging Deathblow on the second patrolling Seeker once he's below the branch.

![](images/c4561b426b38ebd9d4e4f3303651d2c9e4b3b2b75001ea1ab9920a32fbc44eaf.jpg)

Move across the path into the tall grass and follow it along and get behind the Seeker at the top of the stairs for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/7ef2322f248e607f4371e989aed0696cd131af1f0b04cdc93e60873676fc9420.jpg)

![](images/36f6fa1501e97f3953b88f9802d8772b44302c9b08277f40d396632f748d9d55.jpg)

There are two groups of three patrolling Seekers in the area ahead, and if you go running in, there's a good chance that you'll end up fighting all six at once. To avoid that, try to fight the first group as far away from the other as possible.

![](images/a7fbcbe7b4c69ca180f37c63ae06a91baca299183c3a2459f3dceea16c6b065a.jpg)

19 Lump of Fat Wax x1  
20 Mibu Balloon of Spirit x1  
25 Ungo's Sugar x1  
26 Antidote Powder x1  
27 Pellet x1  
28 Gachiin's Sugar x1  
29 Ceramic Shard x3

# Prosthetic Tool Update

If you arrive in this area after having already acquired the Divine Abduction Tool, it would be prudent to have it equipped. With a single activation of the tool it's possible to wipeout entire groups of Seekers in an instant, making it an extremely powerful option.

![](images/d6e203cda7ccaae154ca92bc94ae239591aeaa621a262ffb17621388ddf1be5f.jpg)

Hug the side of the building here and wait for the group of patrolling Seekers to walk into view. When they're close enough, throw a Ceramic Shard to lure them to the side of the building, and then go back through it so that you can get behind them. If you have the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu, Backstab Deathblow the first Seeker, and then use it to blind the rest for easy kills. Otherwise you'll need to finish them off with basic attacks.

![](images/81db5f092e66f09b4fe720292f6ad1bb70628628e7e293471e7e6848b1886b55.jpg)

![](images/33c0cae4854e034453db8a5e3fa96a7e38d62fba6de16630d0c334523a9ee7f1.jpg)

After either killing or waiting for the group of Seekers to patrol away from this area, you can grapple up to the ledge and then follow the base of the cliff up the hill for another stealth option.

![](images/70f972cf8da83f5c174b9f6f6edffdaff5c1688ccbf7f4f9ef3abefb03801b3d.jpg)

Observing the patrolling Seekers from this point in the tall grass will reveal that an additional pair has started patrolling through the area, coming in from the right. Both groups will converge just ahead of the tall grass, so if you have the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu, time a Backstab Deathblow on one of them, and then use it to blind the remainder of the group. Be mindful of how many enemies are left during the encounter, and if it looks like the Ninjutsu will run out before you finish them all, reapply it on one of the enemies. If you don't have that Ninjutsu, it's best to try to take them on separately.

![](images/93df4556f6d3b1aa16a06f29566a0b8b519f31996d13c8d454fb581a003e2cf7.jpg)

Jump out from here and you can follow a series of grapple points around the edge of the cliff to avoid the pair of patrolling Seekers.

![](images/813f2797906e767492b3aa86d16ead70576e724a584ee02ea496b6e245630846.jpg)

Follow the tall grass and you can make it to this point, where the pair of Seekers are patrolling. When they get close, Backstab Death-blow one of them and cut down the other.

![](images/7a3b81bf7264eb13aa3fa528ae79cefef6082ea2bfb60c577e5be39cd0310514.jpg)

Return here once the pair of Seekers have been defeated and wait for the trio of Seekers to patrol back down the path towards the grass. Backstab Deathblow one of them when they turn around, then engage the others.

![](images/a99199eab9316dadc3a5557f032b22dec6097f5e7a08eea22b9a9e061ff8259d.jpg)

Instead of going straight up the main path, if you circle around to this point, you'll be able to get behind the two stationary Seekers and Backstab Deathblow both of them.

![](images/4a52648656e07d8b250766d8c4089bdbbf7cc7faa1f1bcc990056b984a63c222.jpg)

![](images/3db28ad3fda3c57c5d7a843718a26e6ff362f628813705da17be73d470278ee6.jpg)

Grapple up to the beam here, and from there you can jump across to another beam and pull yourself up to a small room. There you'll find several Crickets—make sure to kill them all before continuing so that they don't give your position away.

![](images/0116b47d6ce0d989e8e61b97389e07b5880a59e5229cc90994ef5a3348816374.jpg)

![](images/264b8ec5a690b65a179d50913d7d4ffa7e590ef4a44805d3867e560bf6e5b5d9.jpg)

A lone Seeker will patrol back and forth just past the bottom of the stairs; if you remain quiet you can sneak up and Backstab Death-blow him.

![](images/d20bc99e01166c1a849ae9c86a4f4d07f00e5dd03805a99795aeda310e8183de.jpg)

The Seekers in this room are deep in prayer, so if you want to avoid fighting them you can simply head straight for the window and jump out. Skipping this fight is not recommended, however, due to the enticing Gourd Seed sitting in front of the Infested Seeker.

![](images/e90cc363317e3387cece645770dea0ebf2abb2cd835f9abd2cdff34d76b81a84.jpg)

While the trio of Seekers appear to be the biggest threat initially, the true danger in this room comes from the Taro Troop hiding behind the shrine. Skirt the outside of the room and you'll be able to get behind him from this side undetected and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/10f1c26cbe5870dde021a0e5a5542a11f804daa389c0ec6e4e4beb4450d4636e.jpg)

Once the Taro Troop is down, retrace your steps to get behind the trio of Seekers and Backstab Deathblow one of them, then cut down the other two before they can attack.

![](images/4262b4f4e4b93de7baeb73b5923516bbd9e0d52f7783cb1d8896dcf942b31f98.jpg)

The Infested Seeker sitting in the middle of the room does not really pose a threat—all it will do is start vomiting up Crickets when you get close to it. Because it cannot be permanently killed until you have the Mortal Blade, it's best to just leave him alone.

![](images/10e2d0f5737798f0ebfdba3930ec46ec13fc3ba0b48baaf715f547750b376b1e.jpg)

![](images/ab5d2144eab91b085551b1926cc011044f28dca48b0dbbc12be187d9537a7803.jpg)

# Faithful One

The ever-knowledgeable nun can be found sitting on the edge of a cliff here, and as usual she has some cryptic information to pass on to you. This time she speaks of "fruits of the serpent" one of which can maybe be found on the other side of the chasm. To get more information out of her you'll need to offer her some rice, which you won't be able to obtain until after you beat the boss of this area.

![](images/11706da78a26f094fc6e5bb101db783056a770c7ea10c66502f47461b07dad87.jpg)

By crouching down and sticking close to the exterior of the building you can make it here undetected. You can take on the Bandits by using a Backstab Deathblow on one and basic attacks on the other to clear the area first, or simply ignore them and grapple straight up to the branch near the cave entrance above.

![](images/4efe0b371ee65399896b3b24845c8c207cb0539d1d95dd17c94b5c1a9d8b05a2.jpg)

![](images/91ce5f93dea98bac4b1056ff4117e28fcacf9e727a5f5dec81ff4ec1eb7b7bda.jpg)

Grapple up to the rock here and you'll be able to get enough height to grapple over to the large tree, or across to the roof of the nearby building to avoid some of the enemies.

![](images/4145185e5274a0ca09744837bef139d6df549ba3b8de3a8f2f2a1ccaae56bba0.jpg)

![](images/3d0bf69d03f27c692d5205f9190950ddcadd21f40b306252177e50f563ec5e38.jpg)

If you've used the Puppeteer Ninjutsu on the Assassin near the kite mechanism, this is where you'll be able to make use of it as a grapple point to reach a ledge on the opposite side of the chasm.

![](images/d3100179df83f4d7febb38f7e211a6d4683712fee681ada87d17780cbff60add.jpg)

From here you'll need to follow a series of grapple points along the side of the cliff to reach the cave leading to the Sunken Valley Cavern Idol.

![](images/9fd40cc0dca5f887480e735dd4b1b464f130a3c5a29dca2490822700a543fbbc.jpg)

![](images/03f96c156ae7e5ac0aa959ac40e81ed8282cf343073902d6b7d3a8e52dba18e5.jpg)

# Sunken Valley Cavern

For an out-of-the way cave, this one is actually quite important. Depending on your progress with Blackhat Badger, you may find him seeking refuge here, but the main draw will become apparent if you return after having crossed the rope bridge above the Great Serpent in the Sunken Valley Passage.

# Ending Update: Return

If you're attempting to go for this ending, travel here after encountering the Great Serpent in the Sunken Valley Passage, and then go trough the cave until you're standing on the wooden beam protruding from the cliff. Look down and you should see the serpent in the water below you. Jump off and perform a Plunging Deathblow on it to obtain the Fresh Snake Viscera that you need.

![](images/4a595bca9d2c3922a890f90e38e1dab05a3d77009d8fc25d0948ee1145a7d09d.jpg)

![](images/103b54c57fc1689b7af1a16e1ae96e932f1720cdfc55a50a96fb6ba31b9ce2f5.jpg)

A patrolling Bandit will make his way into the tall grass here when you enter it; crouch down and wait for him to walk towards the building so that you can move around and Backstab Deathblow him. If you crouch again immediately, the other enemies won't detect you.

![](images/ee63d5f6d99e814add61d4ffffea060b45b2ea5a34c9264aac2aaddf4697877c.jpg)

![](images/017c956e721b2589d9982bba9e860db561e59984f0e60a3b18d4f39e8a23a174.jpg)

Jump up the ledge here and quietly move along the side of the building until you can get behind the Seeker looking out over the cliff for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/dab8b9e506eb1907483356697074c53ef2a9d50f2286778ec1b2808d625fc189.jpg)

Another Seeker is standing near the opposite corner of the building, and if you jump up onto the walkway here you can sneak up and Backstab Deathblow him.

![](images/06d642217c5fdf17e2ec044e8906d57470a3bf231a5dee28ad3198ff7a581812.jpg)

# Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo

# Item Legend

![](images/122c6ca8230cd325b0519e15c3c52e80faae201782ce67ba77abe0a2ea48d263.jpg)

![](images/643cc34670581a4d7e59238b2b3af3b7f7eee74f4611024bb3126c21241b3999.jpg)

![](images/67388333d737fcfdddedee7cfe578b2e54dd5b4bafa86f0836b33f0b36c69d0e.jpg)

Jump back down from the walkway and grapple up to the ledge here once you're in range. Crouch down and use the large rock for cover as soon as you're on the ledge so that you stay hidden from the Spear Adept on the broken bridge ahead. Use a Gachiin's Sugar, and then sneak around the rock and get as close to the railing of the bridge as possible. Angle a jump correctly and you can jump off the railing and onto the bridge without the Spear Adept noticing. Then you can sneak round behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow on this very dangerous enemy.

![](images/a19f21d95ed7865a5746191a27f88e13156840d3db1dac10db898e85013685a4.jpg)

![](images/8784d3f628033be5a95130381cd26de7d84f730b3533dbf4e4739cddb80eae0e.jpg)

From here you can jump out and use a Plunging Deathblow on the other Spear Adept, and then quickly run over to the Bandit archer and attack him before he starts releasing arrows.

![](images/7e5a3699a2c5b8c937973085dd7ff958e9e599eeaa1031942042bcea49a58406.jpg)

![](images/d2e57c909ea37499eadd46fd6dd9c88231a959956fa511d5a3054570006b34ac.jpg)

The two Bandits below this point should be none the wiser as to what happened to the other enemies, allowing you to Plunging Deathblow one and cut down the other from here. With the area clear, grapple up into the cave and head towards the Shugendo Idol.

![](images/f0ac239436d4a765fb9f247519cce21dc108a7ace821a54dedd5fbc9ce9b0c0b.jpg)

![](images/2bd0b79a465aa9c32ada6fe59b5acd77d4573fde0622ec588f86aa74e28ebf38.jpg)

# Shugendo

The labyrinthine network of walkways, tunnels and ledges in this area will be a real test of your traversal skills, and only the bravest shinobis will be able to uncover the many secrets these cliffs are hiding.

![](images/b158cc060ca84f8a56fbaa1d669c69927a551ee217a2c693e6e228b8f460a596.jpg)

Look down from the ledge near the Idol and you'll see a makeshift walkway along the side of the cliff that you can jump down onto—follow it around until you reach the area with the Shugendo Memorial Mob. To get back, simply retrace your steps and grapple back up to the ledge near the idol.

![](images/158b64dd74f8e04f4262aaef4a6800edb1838f21dc5908d1963d86c2c7e22dd5.jpg)

![](images/7fa787c0d67e6c5c6c7834f3aacf15059ba7695ed4a4db7d42dcdc6c1c5f0f1f.jpg)

# Shugendo Memorial Mob

The fascination that the Memorial Mob have with out-of-the-way locations continues with this particular member, but as usual, his selection of wares makes the trip worthwhile. You need a Persimmon for the Return ending, so you may want to purchase them from this merchant to have some spare. The Five-color Rice gourd is not the rice that the Faithful One was interested in, but it can still be used to mark a trail to help keep you on the right path.

![](images/bf559695fb87149eba2c35312c0820a99a72272f21e3951ff269699b14d24344.jpg)

A number of Assassins have taken up defensive positions on ledges between the rickety bridges in the area just past here. If you grapple up to the top branch ahead, you can then grapple up to a higher ledge, and onto another branch to get past most of them. They will spot you, however, so you'll need to be quick.

![](images/e0499beeb30bf770a388984c61b27e64a507baa5b9e02f4f2a037a66d68869c3.jpg)

![](images/0cece4624bb6562f1e39a088dc6b0467867a0fb7226a8ccad957fa4ae047c202.jpg)

If you want to take out the Assassins so that you can explore the area at your leisure, grapple across to this ledge and enter the tunnel.

![](images/d04db08ff7429de79463deecca7423ab8752b9b210d526a37ffabc2b8aa2dbcf.jpg)

When you see the exit to the tunnel, crouch down and stick to the wall on the left because as you proceed, an Assassin will drop down near the exit to try and ambush you. If you're close to the wall and remain quiet, he won't detect you, allowing you to use a Backstab Deathblow on him.

![](images/acb5f623bc8555d3a39ec87892a47dd4872e32e04a2571fa5aa59fa6f3f930d2.jpg)

![](images/7726da77709c6423f6af865590a63304b1cfe5d34d88d4043b3e819f11b3dc3a.jpg)

Because you didn't get into open combat and alert the other Assassins, you can now grapple across to the island and use a Backstab Deathblow on the Assassin there.

![](images/44d3476e421f3715555388de76463bf5b7532b83a51ecfc1ab0a7e6b9b545678.jpg)

Jump back across to the tunnel exit and grapple up to the ledge beside it so that you can get behind another Assassin for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/93b4f8bbc5932c5b17ae93846b837464fdd3d66b93da7046990bb99352934948.jpg)

The final Assassin is on the walkway above you, so grapple up to the branch above the tunnel exit, and then jump up so that you can use a ledge grab on it. Shimmy along until you're below the Assassin and finish him off with a Ledge Hang Deathblow.

![](images/3af2407d46f9bd7bc4c9371309684607de12746ba4280bbff3dec8e3ed70c323.jpg)

![](images/eca2c4fa73b80d1e6471f50581032b4522d8add1b6898adc4aed71dbaa4127a8.jpg)

If you just want to get through the area, the quickest way to proceed would be to jump up the series of ledges here until you reach the top, and then use the branch to grapple over to the start of the large bridge.

![](images/5be353c45fabebc5c3fb233978e9264988ed1589c37ec492f3ea015e7a143e14.jpg)

Look along the edge of the cliff from here and you'll see an unmountable grapple point and some narrow ledges beneath an overhanging section of the cliff. The goal may seem obvious, but if you jump out straight towards the grapple point and use it, you will have neither the height or the angle to grab onto the narrow ledges. You need a different approach.

![](images/567e9194be56acbea64e273fc25a3fdfbba99ed10c9988c4d2ce74d0ef7b7abc.jpg)

Line yourself up so that you're facing the ledge with the item on it below the narrow ones, and then jump out towards that.

![](images/7b5911e170f0f5983dfbe7a56c468865212dc1289cba7f5d7b54ca8fc5b7eedc.jpg)

Now when you use the grapple point it will take you high enough and at the correct angle to grab onto the upper narrow ledge.

![](images/2790fe8a43c77a26d067e8afab77c323884e5d732c8d89e8b9dc42bc9b5b0fe6.jpg)

From the end of this ledge you'll need to look up to find an unmountable grapple point that you can use to propel yourself over to the opposite cliffside, where there's a ledge to grab onto.

![](images/937e2f2a8a8e450745040def0b4bfdd6c2cd9e7c84e7637842a8f1a573a154a4.jpg)

After climbing up the ledges here you can either continue along to the consecutive jump towards the Bell Demon's Temple, or you can wall jump back out towards the cliff you were on previously and grapple up to a ledge.

![](images/3844b1b174bf834bb4b46dbde52f718797246755dbfcd89a96b7006aa49ac432.jpg)

![](images/e4d17482568053abf9d99c9b5f2e2bfadd1e2aa55007b2f59f44f1a695c86321.jpg)

This ledge leads back through the cliff to the other side, where you'll be able to grapple up and continue around to the area near the bridge. You can also reach this place by going down those same ledges from the bridge area, and then jumping down to the opposite cliff and grabbing the narrow ledge. This jump is considerably easier than the one near the Shugendo Idol, so it's a safer option for reaching the Bell Demon's Temple.

![](images/8d90b4c670a20141f1269741c1545a1152b98a9bc65ad25b92bc40800d499807.jpg)

# Kotaro Update

![](images/e4d06680a3e9079aa75cf0643e8c00245961cdfc6f96d7c5c8f1b0fae9bb96c9.jpg)

The White Pinwheel can be found here, which is the item you need if you want to help restore Kotaro's memories.

To get back to the main part of the mountain again, slide down the broken walkway here to end up at the top of the ledges below the consecutive wall jump, and then wall jump out and grapple across to the opposite side.

![](images/9b0409830d008089bd6212d85b61f5b247fd4db61aea64332cc7c3d6ee0336c3.jpg)

![](images/1889e5db52afbeb76ae3d40339196c9d66397f9bfcee14baadb029784609c951.jpg)

# Bell Demon's Temple

Ring the nearby bell and the spirit of the Bell Demon will possess you and make the game more challenging by increasing the stats of all enemies. While that does make things more difficult, the power of the Bell Demon also increases the item drop rates of enemies, allowing you to acquire significantly more upgrade materials and consumables.

You can dispel the demon at any time by consuming the item if you're finding the increased difficulty too challenging. The

![](images/45f28a5063cf7fd9b0c9cf6687496b0051c58b69fa789f558e9f249e4f0ac2a7.jpg)

Idol here will allow you to quickly return to the temple and reacquire the demon at any time if you decide that the increased item acquisition is worth the risk.

![](images/e0d088e8d34d192701b41c5fc29447ae3f4609ddec8947895f81dac85248ab55.jpg)

If you're going through this area after the time of day has progressed to evening, you'll encounter a group of Vengeful Spirits here, so don't let them catch you off guard.

![](images/6eb131df04a932bf227cbaf422e8eafcf2dbe1fa8a67dbaf131d5ffabc3d9794.jpg)

# Kotaro Update

The Red and White Pinwheel found here can be given to Kotaro if you want to lead him to either Dojun or Anayama. Once you hand over the item, you will be able to guide Kotaro to either of them if you are at the relevant part of their quests.

![](images/345bbbe1dc2131743d060cf08a4c90617133489a37d2ad38fca281440de924ec.jpg)

To cross the bridge you'll need to defeat one of the strongest foreign warriors to have ever ventured into these lands. His strong armor makes him all but impervious to attacks, so attempting to whittle down his Vitality would be futile. His only weakness is his Posture, but even once broken, you'll be unable to penetrate his armor with a Deathblow.

The Deathblow may not inflict a mortal wound, but performing one does cause the warrior to stumble a few steps before recovering. If you position him anywhere near the edges of the bridge and then Deathblow him from the correct angle, you'll send him stumbling over the edge to his death. The walls of the bridge will often get destroyed during the fight, but you can still make him stumble through one of the wooden walls, even if it's intact. He does have quite a few very dangerous attacks, so turn to P.423 to find out the best way to defend yourself against them.

![](images/98cc3417222b325fb20d9517456efffebb14a405401aeb1e220374ddfea011b4.jpg)

![](images/3a5a54969fb722bb8b9d72f06fbdacb66ad7f3ef699792897b0257bb2b3b82e8.jpg)

![](images/c1a728c09bd3e0aa44bdce84e99c194dbb1311b5eea04a18ef8cfb54737fd764.jpg)

# Temple Grounds

The Temple Grounds Idol is your last refuge before you ascend the final stretch of the mountain to reach the Main Hall. If you're coming here before acquiring the Mibu Breath

![](images/6c9a253f536bd6e92cfbc241168cea3f2c99c918a7290ec1cf5e6002c7859138.jpg)

ing Technique, it also provides you with a quick way of getting back to the nearby pond to get the items at the bottom once you do have it.

![](images/b59865458565a628ba469afc1f426ae1cc939f6e55a43d1204e6fa2638f4ffe8.jpg)

Jump down onto the roof here and you'll be able to safely Shuriken the two hounds on the ground below, and then cross over to the side of the roof near the pond and do the same to the two hounds there.

![](images/cb88f539939f61897e2efcc0cf8a9bc4f65639222693103e7228f340d71eea11.jpg)

![](images/6ef0ab4a80ccc8c48f2c3bf38c5741c9263fbd0ef397f32e6ac443ede1e96d23.jpg)

From here you can jump straight out over the pond and grapple across to the roof of the building on the opposite side. Run across that and you can grapple onto the roof of the large temple building. One of the Seekers along the path below will usually spot you if you attempt this, but you'll be long gone before you're in any danger.

![](images/bd7ef35b92c4c92a4c11bc086f477ddb6121414fa496231204519a73fb969180.jpg)

![](images/801b6f95270507ad2f50f13a9f8bf5c06f1ef8d14906835fb286913c1cf5da6e.jpg)

There are a couple of good items at the bottom of the pond, including one that's required to attain one of the games endings; make sure to return here once you have the Mibu Breathing Technique to pick them up. The Treasure Carp here are on the surface, so you can easily kill them now to get their scales.

![](images/442f2995825f09f402a1dd525fbabf53a1498b940e4be8d640eb00d50e5f75fa.jpg)

Once you reach the halfway point of the stairs here you'll be able to Shuriken both of the remaining hounds before they can get close to you.

![](images/6fb245a01e90219885baa6c86ac0a425a0fdeff3d5d881f0af4e5d233c1da5d1.jpg)

Do not let the sparkle of the item on the path ahead grab your attention, because there's a monkey in the tree above it just waiting to drop down and grab you when you get close. Use your lock-on while you go down the path, and once you have it in your sights, use a Shuriken to kill it quickly.

![](images/7e0d4fe8190149e92a469864d6bf2e24da33f2766e330284eceeae5a8e140a95.jpg)

![](images/c65188cfee16d82521c20b611a8b9bafa12caf159b7bb358d8d2588c03436be4.jpg)

A trio of monkeys up on a ledge will spot you when you walk beneath the arch here; simply move backwards and let the narrow path funnel them in, so that you can pick them off easily with Shuriken.

![](images/802933a9d3e7ac1fef01702c4635d67a55c519b24854fd41fa2592c1d72c469d.jpg)

Near the bottom of the path you'll find a Taro Troop sitting near a sleeping monkey; sneak around behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow to finish him off before taking care of the monkey. Depending on the time of day that you get here there may be some Vengeful Spirits in the area ahead, so try not to let the fight go down the path or you'll risk drawing them getting involved.

![](images/ed750ff82ac8d6fd7049108f9636b34c4f5ed3bd4a75373195ebc7f46a75854b.jpg)

![](images/f2955d5341f017a9d240855b961380529ce3bf474a207aeef2b3deccec476e3e.jpg)

![](images/13162404e7c64e820005215aed3e2773be1fb11c5b18f3d83055065a6c91372b.jpg)

# Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo

# Item Legend

![](images/d84b0db73bb72e4eda16cc3efb5371c7d33666f699dd585147b486101e3ee05d.jpg)

Scrap Magnetite x1

# Ending Update: Return

The Persimmon that you can acquire at Position A is one of very few in the game, so if you're going for this ending, make sure to pick it up now.

![](images/f20606c93b97ba578726fce4b375a79ddc9e00b2c8fb2187edc3571523149b11.jpg)

Most of the Seekers along the path leading up to the large temple have a direct line of sight all the way down, and can easily spot you coming; if you want to get the advantage over them, you'll need to make use of a sneakier route. Drop into the pond, and then grapple up the series of branches until you're next to the walkway around the building here.

Crouch down and follow the walkway around the side of the building near the cliff, and then Backstab Deathblow the Seeker around the corner when you reach him. Move back around the corner straight away to avoid being detected by the Seekers on the ledges ahead of you.

![](images/33dc79c3b0bb32a17a880f0bdbbf16cdbbd6e9bba3be4b469d1a0b948d19e276.jpg)

Jump over the railing so that you land next to the cliff, and then crouch down and follow it along to reach a Seeker with his back to you near a tree that you can Backstab Deathblow. Use the ledge in the corner of the cliff here as a platform to jump up to the front of the temple building. Walk along that until you're behind the fire firebomb throwing Seeker, and then sneak up behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/0b00dbf149cfacec810b5e092d6236fc9d55687c38aa239475ff297fe8c85a63.jpg)

Move around behind the next Seeker and Backstab Deathblow him too. This will leave you free to work your way back down the main path using Backstab Deathblows on the remaining Seekers.

![](images/3c30515a6dddcd6c8dbf985ab88a214660a2dd75d54b55e5184d03815629e847.jpg)  
Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo

![](images/1341323b9ea189c99bec32f4120bb57f162c5a7650d41d10257baf5c07e02aa8.jpg)

Drop down from here and you'll be able to land on the ledge that the monkeys were using as a lookout post. If they're still here, you'll be able to take them out quickly with Shuriken, and then jump over the gap to reach the item at the end.

![](images/0e597072d0ee2f2ae74fd7916e1e8f69fc01a4a8fa8cf6aefe17c0162de84c8a.jpg)

![](images/d615ca40502ee15337b998a3d856d01a1a5e6a39162e9ebeb22b8e8a73a0d55d.jpg)
