![](images/881a53ffeb89378c7453872dac6fb2f78ed16e355b496000df9c5294865d3b73.jpg)

![](images/c73d3a13b3ca26654e3cec18f623e0b7e18e3001707c927b1845c65e46773e9d.jpg)

Grapple up to the roof of the temple building, but make sure not to go over the peak. A pair of Assassins will jump up from the courtyard as soon as you land, and you don't want to draw their attention. Instead, start making your way along the outside part of the roof towards the cliff to the left while remaining crouched.

![](images/571b0813d44c2936ae42a807b963622aa9826745018a90e5027bf9d5be1ab33c.jpg)

![](images/ea1690ecf74f50b03a78e2347a89481a7e88aef80eaa14ed801b17206d657a7b.jpg)

If you want to reach the Main Hall as quickly as possible, the most direct route towards it is to wall jump up to the ledge here, and then grapple up to the branch above. From there you can wall jump up to another ledge to reach the area near the stairs leading to the temple.

![](images/ec41a96f111e4be8b699c9266a34c584173bd8da8ff2c88d9d850bf6ac5b6e2a.jpg)

![](images/303c84aff5bcf3465687359f3a91a491e82d289e6ae22ca4d778e677c1545900.jpg)

If you stuck to the outside part of the roof and have remained undetected, you should be able to get behind the Assassin here and take him out with a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/825800c6b675c0599f508b0a0740239074017b896eddb5f8e93ad356d304c06d.jpg)

![](images/d601d4872f6471d62b69bc29ac5f0ca0f87a794b8a23b246514c9a535b972bac.jpg)

Continue around the roof and you'll find the Assassin here is walking away from you when you get near him, allowing for another Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/0d0923058e90c49e939619c96a676a8bbc2d7cdf07a42005ce3c9470e8d0abe2.jpg)

![](images/38af04517f5694708ca51f0d3bfb8372f07b2c7ed732fc9d03aa464d730b0f8a.jpg)

By this time an Assassin from within the temple will have made his way out into the courtyard, so return to this point and use a Backstab Deathblow on him.

![](images/ec074f9f0d59998d8a3b7405b409c89525c762d50dcda1962bd2191c9c800548.jpg)

![](images/74595bcd47b06fb7ff063760b547efae7db6202a79f19d3ea202635ece26b3d1.jpg)

Grapple back up to the front section of roof and crouch down as you get near the peak. The two Assassins that jumped up when you first landed here should now have split apart and be walking in opposite directions; sneak up and Backstab Deathblow them one at a time.

![](images/f38e968ed5feabe20763aafb8cdb934ddf33458291ed5a995c5e476b13a4e44d.jpg)

From the corner here you can jump across to the roof of the adjacent building, which will allow you to access a hole in the roof that you can use to grapple down onto a beam, placing you above the enemies inside.

![](images/972cc40ca09b41b46aac9e06c50a128aa62c7e92d6e000304a3caa167c898dae.jpg)

![](images/97240afefb81e374bf9d50233cf0e4e1247a5867e52a74e80e87e35c6ef4c2e7.jpg)

![](images/e42f16a226e465e3c34c337429883607cbea683c077e75fc262e877d65acd76e.jpg)

If you want the upgrade materials from this room, then you're going to have to deal with the enemies inside. The Infested Seeker sitting here is more dangerous than the one you previously encountered, because this one has been fully infested with a parasite that will lash out when you get close. To get an early advantage in the fight, sneak in on the left side of the entrance and stick close to the wall to get behind the trio of Seekers so that you can Backstab Deathblow one of them. The Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu can be very useful here for dealing with the remaining Seekers. Otherwise, make sure to keep the fight with them away from the Infested Seeker, taking it out into the courtyard if needed. When you're fighting the Infested Seeker, just finding an opening can be difficult, so focus on deflecting the centipede attacks and try to break its Posture.

![](images/437c2dd1bd3b6341d8e0858444efdcfd4faa604422f7fdabec903da9267f2d4f.jpg)

![](images/e138dfa3efd33c5655ea3657330e56bb2047632886b0340f244febced555fadf.jpg)

This is the beam you'll land on after grappling down from the opening in the roof of the building, and you'll notice straight away that there's a Long-arm Centipede on the floor below you. Centipedes are also on the beams above the ground, and one will usually spot you when you land and drop down. It shouldn't alert the Long Arm one, though.

It's important to remember than you can Plunging Deathblow Centipedes straight away by jumping near them, so work your way around the beams and do that to the two still on the beams.

![](images/2be2fad756260ffdedde1ca062aaafb11816ac22ed38043805c8e1327f9b973d.jpg)

![](images/31dab719521b07974884e60228f77d300914074a9297c7b303f5b10b4c4e4007.jpg)

As soon as you've cleared out some of the Centipedes on the beams, use a Plunging Deathblow on the Long-arm variant to get a big advantage in the fight. While it's recovering from that attack, use Plunging Deathblows on any remaining Centipedes before turning your attention back to the Long-arm.

Long-arm Centipedes employ attack strings with many fast consecutive hits that can be difficult to deal with. If you're having trouble deflecting them all, guard the strings instead and focus on these two key openings. During one combo it will use a sweeping Perilous Attack; use a jump kick if you see it, otherwise keep guarding and just try to deflect the final hit of the string; you'll still guard even if you mistime the deflect, so there's very little risk. If you deflect that attack it will always follow-up with the Claw Sweep, so be ready to jump and counter it. For a more detailed breakdown, turn to P.421.

![](images/32aa1c1b1f09ab58f49976afe481a6bedc23ce81dea505671492fc295e40a296.jpg)

![](images/c6caf8f05f2b9b65a725a93bf5538f036eeb4ceef1e8e4fb4c4b00dea141b1a4.jpg)

This path will eventually take you up to the crossroads near the large pyre, but coming this way will put you at a disadvantage for dealing with the large pack of Hounds halfway up, so you're better off using one of the other routes.

![](images/fd79dc813cf9817dbf00b6e2909a305b1b28ae269fa8581963023114ed8258c2.jpg)

If you want to take out most of the enemies in this part of the area, then the middle path here is the best option to take, as it allows you to get into good positions to deal with them. To start the process, grapple up to the tree here as soon as it is within range so that you can observe the Seekers patrolling around the pyre.

![](images/e2a31049bff3d720b43d6e08d2a673fd90d5b35b4ace06e71e2e30fc1278b7dd.jpg)

![](images/374781eefc021626dd43d9b2d2ccd847b38662e38fec7d8260b945d8ff7114a6.jpg)

The first Seeker that you want to target is the one that splits off and starts walking over to this area. Wait for him to be far enough away from the other two, and then use the trees to grapple over there. Drop down and use a Backstab Deathblow to avoid making any unnecessary noise.

![](images/0a9de6ea2be66cca714a706b3b513434e29f616535a9a1f2e5955351a7a886b0.jpg)

Look over the edge of the cliff here and you'll see the large pack of Hounds is directly below; if you want to kill them all, drop down from here and use a large area-of-effect attack such as WhirlwindSlash as soon as you land.

![](images/3bde33f4089f4e9d2dcf3d2d86e1a676229ed610c3eb2571b13a6f411da1e5e2.jpg)

![](images/c8e623be724d9f42c0f1db2fee502d4c60bd0a885c46fc92f98f50e2a1cf7c1f.jpg)

Use the rocks in this area to stay hidden from the other two patrolling Seekers. When they have their backs to you, close in and Backstab Deathblow one of them before chopping down the other.

# Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo

![](images/531807946a74572c4ba254b2e25f59c783d18741a0e0e65b9d0717e63d3ad70c.jpg)

# Item Legend

Mibu Balloon of Spirit x1  
58 Fistful of Ash x5  
59 Gokan's Sugar x1  
60 Ungo's Sugar x1

![](images/8fc0530ae8f57fcca08273effcfd2efc0bfc71796faeb022dc8bc5ace7a662bc.jpg)

![](images/a6e1ac001de6947769d70b043ee701e6626ff0bfb06460472e124dc749cec23c.jpg)

![](images/6ecb5ed0aa215b789283fbd3971c94aa4714d331f977bb008a4bc3d6550b2dcc.jpg)

Sneak around this side of the large rock and you'll be able to get behind the Taro Troop that is standing behind it and Backstab Deathblow him. Stay behind the rock and wait for the patrolling Seeker and shield-wielding Taro Troop to reach the bottom of the nearby stairs. As soon as they turn around, sneak up and Backstab Deathblow the Taro Troop, and then attack the Seeker before he can start throwing firebombs.

![](images/e67416dd531ee6756c52123fc4af1603cb949a9f75e975c9c2b05479ed9f2ecb.jpg)

Start making your way up the stairs, but stay crouched in the tall grass while you do because a second firebomb Seeker will start making his way down the stairs. Remain hidden and you can wait for him to walk past and then Backstab Deathblow him.

![](images/12a1239d149232225fc7d4c446de31a4fbe2959769b525002be1e713d3945f5e.jpg)

The only Seeker that remains is another firebomb-throwing Seeker up on a ledge here. To reach him and get the item he's standing near, wall jump up to the ledge and attack him directly.

![](images/d70af925c7951818982a555e8a4de49d785e9f953caf73b8bef3c9c25df1e64c.jpg)

![](images/1dfbf676bc17bcd164f2562589b3fa1595389ea16be7fccef1b59a322560f103.jpg)

If you get into trouble fighting the enemies along this path, there are a series of unmountable grapple point branches above it that you can use to quickly move up the path and onto the roof of the building at the top.

![](images/561f57cf87d6528801430524740daa6015408e3e1a76d274f5f9d42010033137.jpg)

![](images/e276ccea7fe6a72e4c922afb7c43794a71c30e47f8228b83f96803f6673a098d.jpg)

Grapple up to the roof of this building, and from there grapple onto the branch further up the slope so that you're above the two Seekers on the stairs below. Use a Plunging Deathblow on the patrolling Seeker once he's beneath you, and then quickly run up and attack the firebomb Seeker before he starts bombarding you.

![](images/87bb767552bf55e750afd95a39963ca573e1515f82925c1ac8267001ed167501.jpg)

Around the corner from here there's a patrolling Seeker, but the main threat is further along the path in the form of two Spear Adepts outside the main hall, with a third that comes into the area during the encounter. To avoid engaging them before you're ready, hug the corner of the wall and use Wall Hug Deathblow on the Seeker when he gets close.

![](images/d420072f002e87f5da038db5f0b09b62f46e5467296da483b5486593ded30adc.jpg)

![](images/11e15cc22bf0461a8890c5e09788f65266c9e6814af9f50f804950ac4047bb03.jpg)

There are grapple points on the outside railing around the main hall, so if you want to avoid fighting the Spear Adepts, grapple along them to get past the first two, and then sprint past the third and enter the main hall through the rear hallway.

![](images/fafc7c43bfaf9c3c2970cfdd70b1828d7c5a50afa18ee0fe1155452e0cab4dbc.jpg)

If you want to go in through the front door, you're going to have to deal with at least one of the Spear Adepts. Go along the walkway until the alert meter of the first one starts to fill; as soon as it is yellow, retreat to the previous corner. The Spear Adept will investigate the area he spotted you in, so wait until he gives up looking, and then sneak up behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/96fb74436479b24352480af198839ffa6eeb7d56ca72f0dd1c70d900fe994214.jpg)

Once the first Spear Adept is down you can sneak up and open the front door to the main hall undetected, but the second Adept standing with his back to you nearby is quite a tempting target. The third Spear Adept will often be patrolling the walkway just past the one close to you. Wait until he is walking away, and only then go for the Backstab Deathblow on this one. If you're quick, you can then move along the walkway and Backstab Deathblow the remaining Spear Adept. That enemy drops a Bulging Coin Purse, so your efforts will be well rewarded.

![](images/8bacee3fb9f21d29ecc344622ba228458318912d7b1bf92131fdc98d28775c46.jpg)

It's worth taking the small detour down this path before heading into the main hall to initiate the boss encounter, because it leads to another Esoteric Text. A lone Seeker will start walking up the stairs once you reach this point, so either engage him directly, or wait for him to start going back down and sneak up for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/ef1bbf7b1607ed0db5f256666bc54fd3589b507c8d95cc954a421202995833c6.jpg)

Near the entrance to the cave here you'll encounter a group of Centipedes. Take them out one at a time by jumping near them and using a Plunging Deathblow.

![](images/d029df288dc4146e7ab3f7ff8f7ac4e9fc8c160e0a9d8f4da7dbd2f107f6c772.jpg)

![](images/bfcc4abc0252f449035aeb054c8f3981eb95af9e5054b3b5d5ea3be28c82b50c.jpg)

Crouch down here and you'll be able to access a small crawlspace that you can follow to get behind the Centipede at the end for an easy Deathblow.

![](images/2f2be1db08638151207dc9d882b2db3ad91c72bade0f6038d570f0a25f4859b2.jpg)

![](images/f97bbccfac580430e063de5115a3d29458c322b64947d56618fe75acae5c959e.jpg)

The path out of this cave can be accessed by crouching down and going through the crawlspace beneath the overhang here. Follow the tunnel to the exit, taking out the group of Centipedes along the way.

![](images/34aa8615668e73dc9819e7d676e40f6f63c1323f66f77c5d2ba6866546ab5562.jpg)

![](images/079807bd8f5947c6d3dadcef139140542d9fa340d87ad9247f87add54c795331.jpg)

Open the door to the shrine here and you'll be able to acquire the Senpou Esoteric Text. The Skill Tree you unlock with this text contains all the martial knowledge of the Seekers, which you can now turn against them.

![](images/727457e937694d59988259f4c5c69acdd93ca7f292358525a3948015bc464a7d.jpg)

Now that you have the text, you need to make it back to the main hall, and while you could retrace your steps, there's a much quicker way. Kill the Geckos near the edge of the cliff here, and then use the unmountable grapple point to propel yourself over towards the hall. Grapple onto the branch while you fall to land safely.

![](images/a03e0984c3ce7d864b2225985f01eec7e17eb16ab3e435bb35f0d6e420f0397d.jpg)

![](images/df6b05c32568f22eff81319a0af22b43003e803cc6b2876e69a546a6e147c1af.jpg)

# Main Hall

The Main Hall is the heart of the Senpou Temple grounds. While it was once a beacon of peace and tranquility, now it is a place of darkness and obsession. On the shrine in front of the large statue is a bell that, when rung, will whisk you away to the Halls of Illusion, where the Folding Screen Monkeys await, but they are not the only things in the halls, and you may find yourself returning there from time to time for other matters. The bell will not appear until you learn

![](images/77917f46aec6a4a51b5ac4f6c2cecbd9b53f85e1a92a69bddabd4b4aae2cc04e.jpg)

about the history of the Mortal Blade from Isshin Ashina, so if you arrive here before speaking to him you'll need to return after advancing the story to that point.

![](images/486cd75c8cbf0d426cc7ede2ef16ccc39ad77e5672ffb08326a49693dc4dc956.jpg)

Although most of the items in this room have Infested Seekers nearby, you can run past them and grab the items without having to engage them. Only once you get the Mortal Blade is it worth taking the time to kill them.

![](images/e512db7a85682daed93c8c3f244be231a305af4666e7d6ef77718675c5c86e80.jpg)

To get the item in the hands of the large Buddha statue you'll need to grapple up to one of the beams beside it, and then jump across into the hands. Once you're there you can drop down to get the item behind the statue, and then either grapple back out, or go through the small opening in the wall. If you go that route, be careful of the two Infested Seekers sitting just outside.

![](images/cf26c14fd02e44918bf500235a22e1573edfc05063bfc75bd1c6a0702b42b79a.jpg)

# Folding Screen Monkeys

Once you're ready, ring the bell to be taken to the Halls of Illusion, where you'll have to defeat a very unique group of monkeys. This encounter should be considered more of a puzzle than a battle, because each monkey has its own set of strengths and weakness, and you'll need to use the environment to your advantage in order to create openings to attack them. Upon entering the halls you'll also receive the Illusive Halls Bell. At any point in the encounter you can ring the bell to reset the positions of the monkeys, and take you back to the starting point of the halls.

Any monkeys that you have killed will stay dead after ringing the bell, so there's no downside to using it, especially if you're having a hard time tracking down a particular monkey. Standing directly ahead of you when you start is the Illusory Hall Monk, and if you speak with him, he will offer some advice on the characteristics of the different monkeys to help you. If you require additional information flip to P.453.

![](images/676e84298db0d418f0a5dd4c494145c8c3be399a447935c7307cdfe948152ba0.jpg)

# Inner Sanctum

The Divine Child of Rejuvenation is a key character in the story from this point on, and this handy Idol will let

![](images/cd9fdf09269a9ab0e12e133cc9aec8bbcc65aedc7b515978a2feaa42cf7f578e.jpg)

you return to her as often as is needed. It even gets added to your important places list on the travel menu.

![](images/24718319ccfe269dc884732d95940290dc2981080e4767b69b24d1c7fcfbc785.jpg)

Now that you're in the sanctum you can run up the stairs here and open the door to create a path between this area and the Main Hall.

![](images/2646245c30758cd76f4746bb68f67f3b29455b4d77792fc25914a03412fc95a1.jpg)

![](images/ef3dac10ec9e1ab08f729b9e60320f83542c985e637bf9d002d7d08aaf09ab3e.jpg)

Speak with the Divine Child and confirm that you do want the Mortal Blade when she asks. With this weapon in hand, you are now one step closer to fulfilling Lord Kuro's wishes. Talk to the Divine Child a second time and she'll reveal more information and offer you a portion of Rice. You can only hold one portion of Rice at a time, and you won't be able to request another until you've consumed the one you're holding.

It's worth returning to Lord Kuro now to speak with him about acquiring the Mortal Blade, but your next goal should be acquiring the materials to recreate the fountainhead aroma, and for that you need to head to the Sunken Valley.

# Ending Update: Return

Having met with the Divine Child, you can finally begin the steps required to attain this ending, the first of which revolves around the Rice. You need to use three portions of Rice to progress events with the Divine Child, after which she will request that you bring her a Persimmon. To find out the remaining steps, please turn to P.555.

# Mortal Blade Update

Now that you have a weapon that can kill those that were thought unkillable, there are many things you can do with it. The Infested Seekers that you've encountered through the temple grounds can now be killed properly by performing a second Deathblow on them after knocking them unconscious with the first one.

The weary Hanbei the Undying has long been searching for a way to end his suffering, so if you've learnt all there is to learn from his combat training, you may want to offer to mention the Mortal blade and its power to him.

# Ninjutsu Update

The Puppeteer Ninjutsu that you acquired from defeating the Folding Screen Monkeys can be a very useful skill in battle, but there are also a few unique situations you can use it in. Try it on the Assassin near the contrapction controlling the kite at the beginning of the area and he will raise the kite into the sky so that you can use it to access then Sunken Valley Cavern idol (P.226). If you go down to the bottom of the Sunken Valley Passage (P.256), you'll find a monkey that you can use it on to create a distraction for the Great Serpent.

![](images/a70892cb8a92064722c34335fcac9db4b0ccc6d9217af59218a018010755e7bd.jpg)

# Faithful One Update

The Rice you acquired from the Divine Child is the exact type of rice that she was looking for, so now you can hand some over to her for more information if you like. Giving her some Rice will consume the item from your inventory, and it will count towards the three servings you need to use to advance the Divine Child's storyline.

![](images/c3fd4f76ede4eec0d52d21354f48a584fe32a767179c3a3dee5b727cc4fa4381.jpg)

![](images/f6898242f3816e52e4e9c1c2a5756d60ea8b1bd644dd7198b838e32b2e4fb003.jpg)

The Sunken Valley Clan have taken up defensive positions along this vast tract of cliff-side outcrops, making it a place not easily traversed. The Wolf must test his sword against their firearms as he navigates the treacherous terrain.

![](images/2104f6858fabf1e1ec3f42bf05ece8b7ba51ba259c39eec4ebc323a6065d0d22.jpg)

![](images/074ea8a67439a1030e789a60af89eac16b1221f02dccf7ffd765f90c73b2f124.jpg)

![](images/9d6278df6f0f835d8eb12f44b31a53038f7e56f80dbb708b86f70b1ced1e277c.jpg)

# Under-Shrine Valley

The Sunken Valley is an extremely lucrative area in terms of items and upgrade materials, and the Sunken Valley Clan members that call it home are well aware of that fact. You'll find yourself constantly under fire from Valley Clan

![](images/8e01e2a2ca7cbac6a6ad40b76b6f9bf8f1c621190cf38afdc6a04b0895a11f37.jpg)

members perched on hard-to-reach ledges as you traverse the area, and only perfect timing and speed will keep you safe.

![](images/8ac2e3bc2e166fc66f1557be3691190507e256c575b7bfbc27fba28fc157214b.jpg)

Before going to the Idol, it's recommended that you take a quick detour in the other direction to acquire some very useful items. Look down from here and you'll see a patrolling Valley Clan member on a platform, with another sitting down in the middle. If you don't want to take this detour, simply turn the page.

![](images/499256d07dad909f77b27dca41a5c661fa9cb0c5624b781e0cce613d31c98778.jpg)

There are multiple grapple points along the outside edge of this platform that you can use to pull yourself to safety, and one of them can allow you to take out both enemies stealthily. The furthest grapple point is the one you want; time your jump down so that the patrolling Sunken Valley Clan member is just walking past that point when you land. Done correctly, you'll be able to Backstab Deathblow him without the other Valley Clan member detecting you—allowing you to then Backstab Deathblow him as well.

![](images/52c75754a21990c17616b192aae95781a8533d009f4abedad4565f4509067618.jpg)

![](images/8ae6e9eeab1d2c7bb41df8b101cc58a5ff725e0651d9dc408ac1a6b39138365d.jpg)

Once the Valley Clan members are down, jump over the gap here, and then use a wall jump to reach the ledge on the other side and follow the wall along the ravine.

![](images/e46676f1dd00bb588138795d7fd2bb80755a1b3b9b715a16302236b2edd8ddf6.jpg)

![](images/f6dbea6778eefabf328a50108c1ac6dcd808a053c51609bfd79e2539b80b7b91.jpg)

The Prayer Bead on the ground ahead of you here will lure you into the sights of a Valley Clan member who sits along the wall to the side, and he'll start firing if you go straight for the item. To avoid that, drop down from here and hug the wall until you reach the Valley Clan member, and then launch your own ambush.

![](images/8d90fd01d85c107192572549736067981c1d148bdcffa92883f31bdf7c238262.jpg)

![](images/35d2ef656dc0921076dcd1107deffcb4cd3e51e9b648016c9ac52c7aca6e52dd.jpg)

Depending on the time of day at which you reach this area, you may also have to contend with some Vengeful Spirits. You should still try to kill the Valley Clan member stealthily, however, because that will make the fight with the spirits easier.

![](images/c1d4998c159d47c82cd6664ad19f4ae52996e9c6a363833da41fb72734dbbbc3.jpg)

If you have the Mibu Breathing Technique, dive beneath the surface of the water here and you'll find a tunnel that you can swim through to reach a cave, where another fearsome Headless awaits.

![](images/152b5925b4a03d91497e694e8bdb2a2e86ff825947b7558f9ff95e9b3248d8dd.jpg)

![](images/e4eda9eaaed91f47e30f3f79b0b2f55eaa0a2b4a019d8caf7df0d4d2cf5a629c.jpg)

This Headless is functionally identical to the first one you encountered in Ashina Outskirts but with more Vitality. It's still unlikely that you'll have high enough Attack Power to make attempting to battle the fiend worthwhile. If you do choose to engage it, make sure to pick up all the nearby Pacifying Agents in the area first, and for a refresher on how to fight Headless, turn to P.401.

![](images/02976267b4dc89c60565f77c10cbfcabcf840c5c6908fecc7f41429919547740.jpg)

To reach the Idol directly, stand here and look down to locate the large branch protruding from the opposite side of the cliff; jump down and grapple onto it to break your fall. From there you can just jump down to the ground and commune with the Idol.

![](images/e55d22f9785eec6a34d7a5b37b994353ae6be69ca2057481b6d312cc6f4d888f.jpg)

![](images/4b5e0228e0df844fdeb19fa3e81d558281e06f88c6d55b7ce96820f2b51b5d47.jpg)

Vengeful Spirits will appear on the platform ahead here during the evening, so if you spot them, make sure to keep the fight towards this end of the platform so that you don't come under fire from the Valley Clan member on the opposite side of the ravine.

![](images/63becaec42a871dbec50189f096734fa5a2ce1429931670ead962f969eb5f6b3.jpg)

![](images/3ed81543201f70f1ba1ce34962ab4fb79959d3d6c4ea74d07bbfeaf82325a7e9.jpg)

![](images/075e87e5b2f208f0368d2d2c974c9fc9e536606a5eccda8cbd861f2c32d2266d.jpg)

The item along this platform is another trap: attempting to pick it up will expose you to incoming fire from a Valley Clan member watching over it. To turn the tables on him, look across the ravine from here to locate the ledge below the one the Valley Clan member is on, and then jump down past the branch and grapple across to that ledge. From there you can wall jump up and use a Ledge Hang Deathblow on the Valley Clan member. Once he's down, you can grapple back across and pick up the item safely.

![](images/9d5e3d4da07e86f5398a10281fe7a45b9ce6d12aa8f17aedf5ab10170f7a79be.jpg)

![](images/975e0227294d7fc56f93eaa4a4ebf2c4038428584c24068e4f97b16297e270e2.jpg)

Hold your position when you reach this branch, because there's a Valley Clan member patrolling back and forth along the next ledge you need to reach. Watch him from here, and when he starts to walk to the right, grapple over and sneak up behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/ca19a04af65fa02a4a5d87db1faa29d23ccb030b3d69117bc3e7ca818e853f3d.jpg)

![](images/c35f207fa6484ee8de61eddbf95e4829052c02ab90032a25a38f66d4816a0bd5.jpg)

Another highly recommended exploration route can be accessed by jumping up to here, and then wall jumping up to the tunnel above.

![](images/37835bcc3b555cacf2c4f85594b5c0d5caeadcf674012fd7c57393d170e8cd78.jpg)

![](images/6ff04d50d67ede81197391bb1df9bbc49b85e968dffc92e2164035262e0f6b1e.jpg)

The Sunken Valley Clan member at the end of the tunnel here is supported by another Valley Clan member on an opposite ledge, so if you try to fight him you'll have to do so while avoiding constant fire. A better option is to run straight past the first Valley Clan member and grapple over to the ledge with the second one and fight him first. You can position yourself on that ledge so that the lower Valley Clan member cannot shoot you, so you'll only have to worry about the one you're fighting.

![](images/37929986872b1861476371e49be00e3ba96046129d61bbefa7467f76ce4ad62d.jpg)

![](images/dace02a2d33e3b7a2dff076a2277a682a95f0299f9d5a26a1a8b67cfff2c7f20.jpg)

Climb up to this ledge to get the items you came for, by which time the lower Valley Clan member should have dropped out of his alert state, allowing you to Plunging Deathblow him on your way back.

![](images/f92125d55c72d395e8a7686e257d17d3cec272aa42dceb22a748cfe168a17f26.jpg)

![](images/94a6733fd887f5415cac5590135a3e9f43d7408a3c82f0b12e728ae3cf076011.jpg)

A lone Gecko will attempt to ambush you when you reach this platform, so make sure you kill it before picking up the item, or else you're likely to get poisoned and have to use the Antidote Powder you just picked up.

![](images/b6904373f6dcb4071e66dfc503297bc05f27adc9e07bf04b86ca15fd62a810a7.jpg)

![](images/aefc2bcd32cec6db617842fe332f9753fa0425260a186b4b28ec9fb492d7691c.jpg)

The enemies in the area below are arranged in a way that makes it very difficult to avoid fighting them in open combat, but there are some things you can do to give yourself better odds of success. Instead of using a Plunging Deathblow on the Valley Clan member below this branch, jump down and sneak up behind him for a Backstab Deathblow. That will give the other nearby Valley Clan member less time to react, allowing you to cut him down before the scatter-shot Valley Clan member can start firing. The scatter-shot Valley Clan member is by far the biggest threat here, because his shots can knock you down; the most important thing to remember is that he has to reload after every three shots. Use the rocks for cover, and then when you see him start to reload, close in and attack. The Flame Vent is also worth considering, as it will set him ablaze in a single shot.

![](images/d8612435061f414df5271082aec373227339a7dc399e597200d75f8c20ba0510.jpg)

![](images/698e22ec16bcef0caf0bfa8790df9508bbff5c8bad5dde84113b3e10fb56f284.jpg)

# Sunken Valley

The Sunken Valley Clan members you've faced thus far were just early warning scouts—you're now entering the most heavily-fortified part of the valley, where they've built a gun fort into the side of the cliff. The dying Assassin nearby is

![](images/180bfef1f4a9f8337da2b72ea95810e0fe062576b79d10359cab43eec1cacf44.jpg)

testament to the danger of the upcoming fort, and one wrong step will see you meet the same fate.

![](images/7e1cd8d58bf450c61f7c60b493eadadaa1ccd5c136f5bc1b3ef2f0fe94f08c4a.jpg)

The Valley Clan members of the gun fort will open fire on you as soon as you grapple down to this platform, so make sure to keep moving and grapple across to the next platform as quickly as possible. Take the time there to heal up if you got hit, because as soon as you grapple up to the next platform, you're going to have a tough battle on your hands.

# Sunken Valley

![](images/5c39657184043cded57c00a691e8059a1fa8047fc83b436ff1d88080a8e6a828.jpg)

![](images/900b6b150ebcde6409f9419c2e4eae611a3758f00dc0910f1621802b9b36d946.jpg)  
Snake Eyes Shirafuji Snipers P418

Sunken Valley

![](images/859d42ce669e3bf62354b34e596dc16409f6b7adaf52e969fda5285239751e2e.jpg)

Shirafuji has extremely good vision—her constant barrage of rifle shots can make it difficult to get close to her and she will detect you as soon as you grapple up to the platform she's on. If you have a Gachiin's Sugar and the Suppress Presence Skill, however, it's possible to sneak around her. Use the item on the platform first, and then when you grapple up, crouch the instant you land and she won't detect you. Her alert meter will start to fill, so move behind the large rock to the right. Wait there until her alert indicator resets, and then jump between the tree branches and the outside edge of the rock, so that you can get to the other side of it. From there you can close in and land a Backstab Deathblow on her.

To continue your onslaught, if you have the Sabimaru Tool, immediately start attacking her with it after the Deathblow to start building up Poison. After one full combo she will be on her feet, so be ready to deflect her attack and then follow-up with a second Sabimaru combo to inflict her with Blue Rust Poison. The status will cause massive Vitality and Posture damage to her, and cause her to vomit for a short time. Inflicting more Posture damage will be the fastest way to finish her off—if you have Ichimonji, it's the perfect skill for the job. If you require more information about how to defeat her, please turn to P.418.

![](images/18f1b879cc3fef4604acfa48892efa49e613ac5bddd4db7729b6f48f268ebf7d.jpg)

![](images/1d5c081c131dc7e19b2afae5c2ac9c7c24d7b967cf88799048f17ef3e74bc64e.jpg)

If you want to get item on the ledge below here right now, you're going to need to be very quick. The gun fort Valley Clan members will open fire on you the instant you reach the edge of the cliff, so you need to run up, locate the Valley Clan member on the ledge below, and then Plunging Deathblow him before you get shot. Then quickly grab the item and grapple back up before they can start firing again. It's quite dangerous due to the amount of damage you'll take if you get hit with multiple shots, so you may want to return for the item after clearing out the fort.

![](images/cdb5a7161c7e9e6caa7ebf8f0471d80fde735dcde1c3876579e9345cc9ed7938.jpg)

Rounding this corner will once again put you within the sights of the Valley Clan members at the gun fort, and you won't find any cover until you reach the other side of the long bridge, so speed is of the essence. Your goal should be to get three quarters of the way across the bridge, where you'll find a hole that you can drop through, leading to a branch that you can grapple onto. Walk to the start of the branch and you can get out of the line of fire much faster than if you jumped over the hole and continued that way.

Depending on what equipment you have, there are a couple of ways you can go about reaching the hole. The basic approach is to sprint directly for it. While this isn't the safest option, the bridge does provide some cover, and you can zigzag to avoid incoming fire... The safest option by far, however, is to use the Loaded Umbrella, since that will simply block all the incoming shots and get you to the hole in one piece.

![](images/1dc5d31314b8ff1c02820c014f096a3a81b18f5a1b747a54fb41f5d9caec0cc0.jpg)

![](images/9e02dc4421d9b87b357dae5a1ab0c570a1ddf1ec084f38548c966ae88b52b03c.jpg)

![](images/07c65f60689797b092eabdb97284dfa1153d84d3c740358489e1e9b31ae9b225.jpg)

Once you reach this point you'll be safe and can wait for the Valley Clan members to lose track of you before continuing your assault on the fort, which will also be much easier from here. Grapple up to the ledge above you, and then quickly run along and grapple across to the branch below the fort and run onto the ledge there.

![](images/db958a01e9f051d3a923d903a336204d75c85ecfa9a494246435d9da5402000d.jpg)

Done quickly enough, you can make it here without getting detected again. If they do spot you, simply wait here until they lose track of you again.

![](images/d52d53a4478f24c0a61534dacc9407a013edf8e5d070e5f3b342c667159da57d.jpg)

The first couple of Valley Clan members are on ledges above you, so it's time to get some revenge on them, shinobi style. Wall jump up to this platform, and then turn around to face the way you came from; wall jump again and grab the ledge of the platform that the first Valley Clan member is standing on. Use a Ledge Hang Death-blow on that Valley Clan member, and then pull yourself up and wall jump up to the next ledge and do the same on the other Valley Clan member there.

![](images/71b4387bab8064ce9e778a30046cd981c3a778ea21cb3317f4fb53f37cdb9240.jpg)

Make your way across to this platform and look up to locate a branch that you can grapple up to. Jump up and grab the ledge above this branch, and then use a Ledge Hang Deathblow on the Valley Clan member standing there.

![](images/8df0d5c9b328188a1fd544a3021d5a17921cd0b1cab00e4df0ed93a5bd10748b.jpg)

![](images/3ecd5d2a45eddb763c95d69545255f8a691e2338e10d18bc1185b393a1a4895a.jpg)  
Sunken Valley

![](images/5a01eb2ba4bd13738ed10e29ac8d3099bcfad94ad5fe10b6b7ae47fb165274bc.jpg)

For an alternate way up to the fort from the previous branch, instead of jumping up, locate the unmountable grapple point further around the cliff and use that to propel yourself towards another branch that you can grapple onto.

![](images/4d2193132ded961a03509b8262d360f0fa6f07bd3387503fc67ca2bfdfab2aa8.jpg)

![](images/4c849c41b94b7842c2e26fa7434034da0031debe4533a58e5d2799faad664436.jpg)

Look ahead from here and you'll see a grapple point that you can jump to and use to land on a ledge. Once you're on this ledge, make sure to stick as close to the wall of the cliff as you can, or else the scatter-shot Valley Clan member higher up will spot you. Grab the next ledge above you, and then do the same again to grab the ledge just below the Valley Clan member, at which point you can shimmy around and Ledge Hang Deathblow him.

![](images/b3e93d21a60749c5b567e59dbbf5c2cc5afd8ecf7e699a4dcea429d8d8cef159.jpg)

![](images/755ce74eeded3a85afa66f6197ea79264179c0dffc1905bb9c00c36b95d3aa9a.jpg)

The Valley Clan member standing lookout from the interior of the fort won't spot you if you remain crouched while moving around this area, but he's not the only thing you need to be mindful of. Scattered along the path are small explosive mines that make a loud noise when you step on them, which will alert all nearby Valley Clan members to your location. Look carefully at the ground and you can spot the small mound of straw they're buried beneath; make sure to avoid them at all costs.

![](images/c0b6c96ec1e52f63be1f8a0e11064346b105ac1520c1b00be23efbd24a98163d.jpg)

![](images/853b5cd1df960deb349d8bef26630be0563ab75e30e0edb12b6382aeb493d89a.jpg)

From here there are two Valley Clan members that you can see. It's best to take out the upper one first, because he has line of sight over the lower one. There are a large group of mines on the floor here that prevent you getting close to the platform he's on, but you can get close to them, and then jump over and grapple up to the ledge to avoid them. Backstab Deathblow the Valley Clan member once you land on the platform, and then use a Plunging Deathblow to take out the Valley Clan member below you.

![](images/9a2a7c550edb16e77d4131bdcfc832f65f0476dec1b0f74b43884225329d00cb.jpg)

![](images/673ed87e70b5d1176c6d1b6d7646d4ab687466da1865a2fd8d0186c3a70c52f2.jpg)

On your way back from dealing with those two Valley Clan members you can jump up to this ledge and walk along it to avoid having to navigate past the mines.

![](images/080e712feb51b7a450bcbf8dc5b902a6dd940868411b31544b65c9b9823af96e.jpg)

![](images/f07e9c5500af7220f1cb91eecb9c5317b7091a95b5b8c8240bce819cc8b1dd2b.jpg)

The scatter-shot Valley Clan member will have his back to you when you approach from this side, so sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on him. Once he's out of the way you can grapple up to the ledge nearby and grab the item at the top.

![](images/aa72b89442289962936b157dc80b85f4553d3be6c506138c971b94c4f1e081ba.jpg)

![](images/47d4edc7039eb139cf9c6157cdf0e1ea7c6f3461cc4ec6b3066b8164a91a48f9.jpg)

An Old Maid patrols this tunnel, and if she spots you she will alert all of the enemies inside the fort, making things considerably more difficult. Keep close to the wall on the right as you enter the tunnel and wait for her to start patrolling away from you so that you can sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on her.

![](images/950945495aa3d56c4f412b5494402d57c1b5d9ac3d26869dcbf5031c4f035b61.jpg)

If you're still undetected at this point, the first scatter-shot Valley Clan member here will be sitting down facing the campfire, with a second one standing guard near the tunnel entrance ahead. There's no way to reach the tunnel undetected so you'll need to either run or fight your way past the mercenary in front of it. Crouch down when you enter the room and you can make it to the first one fast enough to Backstab Deathblow him before he's fully alerted. The second one will often have detected you at this point, so be ready to evade any incoming shots. Try to fight that enemy close to the wooden platform at the front of the room so that the rifle Valley Clan member standing on it cannot get an angle to shoot you.

![](images/8873d084f99bb8890867c4660328814cea43804dfa41509d798f99657e72de76.jpg)

![](images/11036f752de060f831f0f8618db6d23396f7b87cff51952e11ba4447c10cc2b9.jpg)

When both buckshot mercenaries have been killed, grapple up to the wooden platform and kill the one with the rifle before attempting to pick up any of the items.

![](images/2053c93b4bb7a4132c3f3a6a91f0893190fce3bd89fa87b845253a5e8d71c2a1.jpg)

# Gun Fort

This Idol will be a welcome sight after having survived the gauntlet that is clearing the Gun Fort, so make sure and rest up to replenish your supplies for another upcoming battle. The Valley Clan members of the fort are also a good

![](images/72650db02154b1496b2f09ff4889579df8e0b8eca7b51a97722fc509c94ae869.jpg)

source of upgrade materials, so this Idol will allow you quick access back to them if you need to gather some more to upgrade a tool.

![](images/3d806f515b73307bd207670c7fb37eeff5292dc04eca46692c8dbf63e451050b.jpg)

The warm glow from the Spirit Emblems on the ledge below the bridge may be enough to make you jump down there after them, but that ledge doesn't lead anywhere from this direction, so you should leave them for later unless you really need them.

![](images/a5ac5ba9d216f8fca45009df400a318c2805a5b9b0a61c07dea71bd0ed1963b6.jpg)

# Sunken Valley

![](images/207888bf11b431431cea45334645abfe9cbac0fc0e31ce75295f12f3f660e710.jpg)

![](images/96975392a073a862ed6e8910c8e3d8492e45dacf095b8a34eca97fe98cb56500.jpg)

A barrier will appear as soon as you enter this room, and you'll be locked in with the Long-arm Centipede until one of you dies. The cramped nature of the room makes dealing with this enemy a daunting prospect because of how aggressive it can be. You'll need to pick your moments to attack very carefully, and always be mindful of your positioning so that you don't get knocked into a corner. Unless your deflecting skills are top-notch, it's best to be defensive against this enemy and start by guarding his combos.

If he performs the 8-hit combo, use a jump kick to counter the sweep at the halfway point; for the 10-hit combo, focus on deflecting the final hit. This will cause him to do the Lunging Claw Sweep, which you can jump-kick counter. When you land a counter, hit him with the Flame Vent to inflict additional damage; after two hits from that he will start to Burn. Use that opportunity to inflict some more damage, and then repeat the process. If you want more advice for dealing with this enemy and his attacks, turn to P.421.

![](images/c9203c2cbb0c06ce7f6f1aa7847d667b6c965cc674bfe6ed95182ec74ee6feba.jpg)

# Prosthetic Tool Update

The Large Fan item that you can pick up here can be used by the Sculptor to create the Divine Abduction Tool. This tool can be devastating to some enemies in one-on-one fights, as it will allow you to Deathblow them, even during open combat.

![](images/357eb829ea6c4c3f954cbc11a0d2b044ffd88bc406b62000d2409dccd34c1a48.jpg)

With the barrier now down you can unlock the door leading to the Sunken Valley Passage, provided you acquired the Gun Fort Shrine Key from the library in Lord Kuro's room. Before proceeding, however, it's worth exploring the remaining part of the caves, because doing so will lead to another Prayer Bead.

![](images/489243bbd372495b92caed28106bd707ea75211344d146a015886e60505201de.jpg)

![](images/eb3d333be224cbf423583142737e7c28d7c26889d515415044eb56293a704d83.jpg)

Look at the floor closely here and you'll notice a hole in the floorboards that you can drop through to access a crawlspace beneath the room. Explore the crawlspace and you'll find an item to pick up, along with a tunnel to follow.

![](images/ab8c375d59ed9d064fd69e87e947bcc0fd0a71cda2794d683da212e6e983009e.jpg)

Going straight ahead at the fork in the tunnel just leads to a dead-end, so follow it around to the left to reach a ledge above a deep ravine.

![](images/14c9fc7dffc4e5fb5d34b1299f85d9c7491b46d55ce34a3bb261e80d2539d818.jpg)

Going left from this ledge will let you wrap back around to the area below the bridge near the Idol, so if you're after the items, grapple across onto the beam to the right, and then again to the ledge directly beyond that.

![](images/a1d7468f1012c0dcf66cda3ac288ac1abe0be0b80e30a86d790e94864683380e.jpg)

![](images/8655cde5f241cf87d71fc58d3dffb13b0fe9f52aa758281c955c099579ee2cc4.jpg)

Have your Shuriken ready when you enter this cave, because there are a large number of Gecko inside and the Shuriken will let you knock them off the walls easily. If you go to the back of the cave for the item, any that you haven't already killed will drop down and ambush you when you try to leave, making it highly likely that you'll get poisoned; have Antidote Powders in your quick items just in case.

![](images/d1cfac2d97a17619348edd9c00f3e4e6ac10ef85bb504e2ce14a5cc8189c2e09.jpg)

Grapple up to this ledge once you're finished in the previous cave, and then grapple down to the ledge in the middle of this cave. From here you can get a clear view of the Geckos on the wall again, so use Shuriken to pick them off in safety from here. There's also a group of Centipedes in the cave; Plunging Deathblow the one below the ledge, and then quickly run over and jump above the other two so that you can Plunging Deathblow them. With all the enemies now defeated, pick up the items (including a coveted Prayer Bead), and then make your way back along the ravine to the idol before venturing into Sunken Valley Passage.

![](images/95c9202ed5593b51917512807b5bf7345a80326a19af4f49f6ac5ce69453539f.jpg)

Even the Sunken Valley Clan rarely venture to the depths of the valley, where monekys have made their home in the toxic swamps. The Great Serpents are another inhabitant, slithering through its waters and caves, forming a barrier that even the Wolf may not pass.

![](images/e8163bfce4e20d430e0e781588e5794e47f3239ca383059693df10973d661f5f.jpg)

![](images/6b1eb8eadebf9a0aacb7679089686f889fe253c27ad608b5876b039234205caf.jpg)

![](images/3fca0b1b528e19d702c96f8802286f05a7c2b0b1fdb35252fea0f438580ace08.jpg)

Look down below you from here and you'll see one of the Great Serpents coiled around the rocks; it may appear that it's safe to venture out onto the bridge, but that is just a ruse. It will strike as soon as you attempt to cross the rope bridge, destroying it and sending you plummeting into the lake below. There is no way to avoid having the snake eventually destroy the bridge and come after you, but there is an alternative route that you can take down to the lake that leaves you in a slightly better position.

![](images/287afb3d6b44491ba32b0eb937878d572a70ec38cea85a16287cb69f1a3009e9.jpg)

![](images/4a586036593e0ab3510964085b51f0b97ba92720661d2d492676800f3e7af81c.jpg)

From the edge of the cliff here you can jump down to a lower platform with an item on it; you'll take some fall damage from doing this, so make sure your Vitality is topped up. Walk out onto the branch and you'll be able to jump across towards the opposite side of the ravine and grapple to an unmountable grapple point. The Great Serpent will attack you, but the momentum from the grapple point will carry you out of harm's way.

![](images/97dce81a2c0a9f6e4c2f428264663fcf88b0682d853f6873f30bd55d6385ad57.jpg)

![](images/073f1fb2b101f4497e6e10f416976fcc406cc7205d4c906ecddbfe418df80b07.jpg)

As soon as you land, start swimming towards the large rocks protruding from the surface of the water, because the serpent will still be looking for its next meal. You'll get the warning indicator every time it's about to attack. When you see it, dodge to the side to avoid the strike.

![](images/90ef392bada6e01aca4ccd61f8fda8c253ffebe382dfba4f4d502668526bfa75.jpg)

![](images/a704b0eb047ca7127c8cc40281c62c91350593b6167544a35d7b840a4dd22508.jpg)

As with all sections of deep water, this one has a number of useful items in it, along with a pair of Treasure Carp Scales that you can acquire if you have the Mibu Breathing Technique. The Great Serpent is unable to track you beneath the surface of the lake, so you can explore the lakebed in safety.

![](images/87aa5654469633b205b0830d107dab1003b127e675f056c58554fc624d755488.jpg)

![](images/6837c16cf84054c12f196f061ab79f9d7efbe324db081e3299bd91922e77cc52.jpg)

The only way to reach this part of the area is to complete a specific event with the Great Serpent that will end with you standing on this ledge (see P.226 for more on this). After picking up the items in the cave you can either travel back to the nearest Idol, or if you want to get down the old-fashioned way, stand near the end of the broken bridge and jump out slightly towards the left so that you can grapple onto a branch. Grapple to the unmountable grapple point from there to land in the lake safely.

![](images/5d097e6ec1ffaf534e648a2c603cdd0ea4b57ccd83b4f4ca538a9245bf6cc91e.jpg)

![](images/b8ee2dbb4ae8e1cb2a24d0a2daebcd45828760ddeeb0e9d6c5ef1f3d57dbdef1.jpg)

# Sunken Valley Passage

![](images/cd118869d407bfb669250e56c5e611c6cfe1cff31987112f68dbd28510260121.jpg)

# Riven Cave

After narrowly escaping the jaws of death, this cave provides a tranquil rest area before continuing through the passage. The giant statues and multi-tiered platforms that line the walls of the passage provide plenty of opportunity for exploration, but one false jump and you'll find yourself plummeting into the poisonous swamps at the bottom.

# Item Legend

Snap Seed x2  
2 Mibu Balloon of Soul x1  
3 Dragon's Blood Droplet x1  
4 Bundled Jizo Statue x1  
7 Bulging Coin Purse x1  
8 Yashariku's Sugar x1  
9 Treasure Carp Scale x1  
10 Adamantine Scrap x1  
Snap Seed x3

![](images/c238396ce4e5f145bf6a6f1d8d1d6424b3dba4d6b265533a7fd5a2efa1410621.jpg)

The rocks here will provide some refuge from the serpent's on-slaught, so use the time to heal up and compose yourself if needed. Go through the narrow channel when you're ready, and make one final push for the cave just past the lakeshore, where you'll once again be out of the serpent's reach.

![](images/9fb4076458661ac08c04f263c389eefee1950e42d51834667fb09b3608022438.jpg)

# Ending Update: Return

If you've been following our order, you can acquire the first of two Snake Viscera items that are required to attain this ending. Return to Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo and use the Puppeteer Ninjutsu on the Assassin near the kite contraption, and then proceed through the room with the first Infested Seeker and climb the large tree in the courtyard. Grapple across to the kite from there, and then go through the cave until you're standing on a wooden beam protruding from the cliff. Look down from there and you'll see the Great Serpent below you; jump off and use a Plunging Deathblow on it to put an end to its reign of terror and obtain a Fresh Snake Viscera.

![](images/d719206bdfd7f9d238bc8580d40d075e6bb77279563cb94fe890fa1fa35ea19b.jpg)

The exit to the cave is high above you; to reach it you'll need to use the unmountable grapple point here to propel you upwards so that you can grapple up to the ledge and follow it back outside.

![](images/c695bacadafd5a07f131ad000f34240aad6a1712ab46f9116d39160561cc4d3e.jpg)

![](images/da925d07121bb77912e8ac992a24d406f48e1baec3c407b3a788dd55dcf4014d.jpg)

There are many points at which you can jump down from the upper part of the passage to the poison swamps below, but often you'll be taking a blind leap of faith. If you stand here and jump out directly over the small branch you can grapple onto a branch just above the ground at the bottom and save yourself from a terminal impact.

![](images/9409258eb918e9e0494463c44224da52ebbe3cb82ad9e24320a6778f053c62f9.jpg)

![](images/3b4ce283ed9cb8f946dbbefd861f8345016b536bafceb94f73a12d512fd4c28f.jpg)

Constantly switching between the upper and lower sections of the passage can lead to a lot of confusion, because the narrow ledges and multiple statues make it easy to get lost. A better approach is to clear out the upper section first, and then descend to the lower area afterwards.

![](images/231f5ff8e26cba70dc39fa775322f85d62bd7807bc26547e03e4361913a5ba04.jpg)

Grapple up to this ledge and slowly start walking along it while keeping your eyes trained on the cliff-side. You'll see a Valley Monkey hanging from a branch above the ledge when you round the corner—use a Shuriken to kill it before it can drop down and ambush you. Monkeys will be frequent enemies in this area, so it's a good idea to always have your Shuriken equipped.

![](images/037c5dc77cdf211c0ff8ca8b4eb1033067cc59757036487cbf5e74b09efc9ed3.jpg)

![](images/f049e515c0bcb542deeeac5fe4abd5d30fb39cc15f472abe1262a5bac191317d.jpg)

You can grapple across to the hand of the statue from here, and then use an unmountable grapple point to propel yourself towards another statue on the opposite side of the passage, but doing so puts you in the line of fire of a gun-wielding monkey. Instead, look down from here and use a Plunging Deathblow on the monkey directly below you.

![](images/0b0691aea981437a3b364cd60b25c5f7fb061ae50e20b9df40f18020acd51381.jpg)

![](images/b7b8c10c242af47492e092998e518f5826e2175fb97eb299cb1323f844661d4f.jpg)

Stay close to the statue so that the monkeys on the bridge ahead don't spot you, and then follow the path around until you can grapple up to this ledge. When you land, Backstab Deathblow the monkey directly in front of you.

![](images/3c3dd8b9d981ac79d1f6978b05b2264e743be678dc4576485ecc14d8f6cffcb0.jpg)

![](images/c74df7630915b75ca2b2b77046ed4214fa4b4038d9541d5323183266c38e8225.jpg)

![](images/86f739d988f06a9000af5ca5df9a973280099261071e12c9cc2bb443828fa9b9.jpg)

The next group of enemies along this side of the passage are all Nightjar Ninja, and they'll put up significantly more of a fight than the monkeys. One of them has direct line of sight over the area you'd need to grapple up to if you continued along this side, so it's better to cross over and take a different approach. Drop down here, and then after picking up the item, grapple over to the opposite side.

![](images/3283ceb04981cc0b904d554d504c98ea300dfcd6ad2bd47359a90ab06e476fe5.jpg)

Once you're on this side, grapple up to the large branch, and then jump across onto the collapsed statue.

![](images/7d429099c7bc924c933d0e2c0e1626bd41257d955298170f2ff7a5c47117b1b6.jpg)

![](images/a6be829a8f64a11cf1bd9ea405afbd56e6965441a1b36f5e9d079847753cfe21.jpg)

Continue along this side of the statue to remain hidden from the Nightjars, and then take a wide approach around the statue head on the ground, so that you can get behind the Nightjar standing on the other side of it without him seeing you. Take him out with a Backstab Deathblow, and then do the same to the other nearby Nightjar.

![](images/c7aba6c8b3530d87557baacebc7869faa2705abb29088983d428ddede93be4ec.jpg)

![](images/868e02bc12373074e1f2a9aa995420e602da45cda2732683b63a972d0de109f5.jpg)

Look down from here and you'll spot the final Nightjar standing near an item—use a Plunging Deathblow to finish him off quickly.

![](images/edb9bcd9472d1bba6ad847176ad49627f565031faaaca910ff994244c0478c3f.jpg)

Go to this ledge and you'll have a perfect vantage point over the extremely large group of monkeys on the platform below. One of those monkeys has some highly coveted Monkey Booze, but to get it you'll need to take them all out. By far the safest option is to sit on this ledge and use Shuriken to pick them off until you're out of Spirit Emblems. A method that uses considerably less emblems would be to drop down and use a Firecracker straight away to stun them all, during which time you can attack them freely. Stick to basic attacks to maximize your killing time while they're stunned, and just repeat the process until they're all dead.

![](images/20404b099997eb86bb0c8b1fea1cec533f4ab6b53cbd10b1069cb5aa015e1778.jpg)

To reach the item on the platform to the opposite side of the passage you'll need to stand here and grapple down to the large branch below, and then grapple across to the ledge the item is on. When you want to get back, simply retrace your steps.

![](images/c0afce60540240250ae791e5b92170a1c2373e87bc4cd4399794d78f3e646973.jpg)

![](images/20707b2363652c582b651a26c9cae54c4826785aa43d60beb376dbf9f51aad7c.jpg)

The easiest way to get across the passage and to the next Idol is to grapple across the arms of the statues here, and then jump onto the stone rope and run along until you can grapple to the platform that the Idol is on.

![](images/c765a57faab6408d7c01262067c11ec43ff4fe3400e40cb18ce8ab354f8c7566.jpg)

# Bodhisattva Valley

This Idol sits atop a ledge overlooking the slightly flooded cavern where the fountainhead waters are said to pool, and the Guardian Ape quenches his thirst. It is also the perfect place from which to launch your descent into the poisonous

![](images/d28cb138d71ac2ce547e7bd28c9fff17bb84a04600d6c73db2a5c4e161bb6f0f.jpg)

swamps in the lower part of the passage—make sure to have some Antidote Powders at the ready if you decide to venture down there.

![](images/71116be930e4f0f4846c6d46b8a7fa0b4fb175cacaa82dd16c89a792973a24e9.jpg)

# Faithful One

The wise old nun is sitting near the Idol, and once again if you talk to her she will speak in riddles about dried fruits. You can offer her some of the Divine Child's Rice again for further information, and she'll let you know that you'll need to make a monkey dance if you want to obtain the fruit...

From there, jump down towards the opposite side of the passage and grapple onto the tree there before dropping down to the ground below.

![](images/467536516a9c64a3441dc823a8488af8f7871f86878c45670d7f297723bff41b.jpg)

# Boss Battle

# Guardian Ape

7040

2280

![](images/8497c60b3558a78b50acc1a5ae733bd9d211e61dcb7c12b1f49f44a95dc981a6.jpg)

Living up to his name, the Guardian Ape is guarding the passage the leads to one of the items you require. The two phases of this fight are very different and you'll need to come equally prepared for both of them. The ape is extremely vulnerable to fire—when you inflict Burn on it, it will sit down and try to pat the flames out, giving you a few seconds to freely damage it. Similarly, if you use Firecrackers it will always try to use a slam attack afterwards, and since you'll know it's coming, you can evade accordingly and land a few hits while it recovers.

Make sure to have some Pacifying Agents for the second phase, because many of its attacks will inflict Terror build-up, including the very dangerous Terrifying Scream. If you need to get around the area quickly during either phase of the fight, there are numerous trees that you can use as unmountable grapple points. These can be destroyed by the ape, so try to keep him away from them to avoid losing valuable escape options.

![](images/77f6a9afe6843487dda5cab928a29816ae53abcb44d0f99e82c49991462c68ba.jpg)

# Time of Day Update

If you've been following the progression used in this guide, defeating the Guardian Ape will advance the time of day because it is the third main boss you've defeated. Enemies will become slightly more powerful during this time, and Vengeful Spirits will start appearing in some areas. Watch out for the glowing aura they give off while they materialize so that you aren't caught unaware. For more information on all the time of day changes, please turn to P.502.

# Prosthetic Tool Update

The Slender Finger that you acquire from the Guardian Ape can be taken to the Sculptor and turned into the Finger Whistle Prosthetic Tool. All Prosthetic Tools are available to you now, so if you don't already have them all, track down any that remain to unlock the "All the Prosthetic Tools" Achievement/Trophy. For a full list, turn to P.82

![](images/0be19b1c89b6683f420aad78307d50c6074070532c8997ef1e380679207167ce.jpg)

# Guardian Ape's Watering Hole

Upon defeating the Guardian Ape, the barrier to the cave will lift, and this Idol will become available. Once you have the item from the cave there won't be many reasons to use this Idol, but there is an event here later, and an item you can dive for with the Mibu Breathing Technique.

![](images/b8f58bb2f332f322235706e0503f401de70024019d9dee7bc6df9aac81bb6403.jpg)

All the way at the back of the cave is the prize you've been after: The Lotus of the Palace. This is one of the items required to recreate the fragrance for Lord Kuro, so you're one step closer to fulfilling his dream.

![](images/89669df0cfab858fbf5a9c2f17d9e05c230d775d18801b21924844cf0be249a4.jpg)

# Ending Update: Purification

Now that you have the Lotus of the Palace you can return to Kuro's Room and hear a lot of new dialogue from Kuro and Emma. Afterwards, eavesdrop on him to hear the required dialogue to continue events for this ending. Rest after hearing that dialogue, and then go up to the Lookout and speak with Emma. Accepting her offer to look for clues is as far as you can progress at this time.

![](images/bf551143b591c8b9e4f507577e5737a7e7bfe659ff1ce1802a9d451c31384275.jpg)

![](images/e5acb23882a375815ea53fc0be08e8570c28fb1459ba9f93069465edf4e1c5c4.jpg)

![](images/f64dcb47001e5bd8e42287e438f2bdc124d5d73d38ff06eccefb888ee28cee2c.jpg)

The statue opposite the large tree stump here provides you with an excellent start or end point for a safe route between the upper and lower parts of the passage. Grapple up to the hand of the statue, and then follow the series of grapple points along the cliff to the right and jump up to the ledge from the final branch.

There will be a monkey with its back to you on the next ledge from here, so use a Backstab Deathblow on it as soon as you jump up.

Grapple up to the next ledge from here, and after killing the monkey there you'll have a clear path to the upper section.

![](images/bf766781c741b6c23757614ab13bb9df943565181e7fb9789c8131fdb8b8991c.jpg)

![](images/37cf3f0232674f31d0787c79e3adebb9da9c0e5dc2a3868bed16edc8be99c366.jpg)

There's another large group of monkeys on the next land mass so you should take all precautions necessary to avoid things getting out of hand and spilling into the swamp. To start with, jump onto the pile of logs here and follow the grapple points until you land on a large branch overlooking the area with the monkeys. From this vantage point you can easily kill off all the small monkeys with Shuriken.

![](images/7db95c03bb2efe16902b461ddbc4b07569c30d94790a188698c37c1aff4255b9.jpg)

![](images/cd8f59f5d871b32c51f6ae85fb7eb19ed8f0a5104671865583dcd31adbc3c48c.jpg)

There is another monkey with a gun at the back of the area; if you decide to jump down and face the Elder Monkey, do so as close to this branch as possible. Another option is to grapple from the branch to the unmountable grapple point, so that you land in the swamp to the side of the landmass. From there you can walk through the swamp until you're behind the Elder Monkey, and then jump up and Backstab Deathblow it.

![](images/c68ff81d99373ca4b884c7415f7895356f5b0954f4dd6fc45f3a3bafb95ce7ae.jpg)

![](images/d8d340778f26870218ccd59bb3f64fe1ee8557189e251dc8d89a2bdd60b57e8c.jpg)

If you're reaching this point without yet acquiring the Puppeteer Ninjutsu, then the cave ahead will have little to offer you. With that Ninjutsu, however, you can obtain another item that is required for the Return ending, and create an alternate route into the Ashina Depths.

![](images/9114a2da0d7f2e315e91e15b69e02e227c1492af7669917e76da272cde0f947a.jpg)

![](images/235b4912d5f7f7b5cd73ed6330b02be7b72406738ba7beb17c34c4384c912669.jpg)

![](images/b6e0007e752bde2901d6fd8da299002a008503e080dd70ea11d643020d0bf158.jpg)

The giant body of a Great Serpent has contorted its way through the cave from this point, and will start to become an obstacle that you need to navigate around. You can get as close to it as you like and it will not react, if you hit it with your weapon, however, it will writhe around for a short while and the normally harmless steam rising from the vents will turn into a poisonous gas. Try to position yourself so that you don't accidentally hit the serpent during combat, but make sure to have Poison-curing items at the ready just in case.

![](images/2a0a3eeaf29894f33ebfa6c5ae825697ca9c9b8cfb88e57bf82869e72776d537.jpg)

# Toxic Memorial Mob

The amount of bodies that are claimed by the swamp and washed up on the shore here has proven to be too enticing for this member of the Memorial Mob to pass up, so he has set up a convenient shop for you. Talk to him and he will warn about the dangers that lie in the cave ahead, not out of concern for your safety, but because you may not be able to purchase more items from him in the future. While you're here, if you have the Sen for it, you may want to acquire the Green Mossy Gourd to keep the effects of poison build-up at bay without having to use all of your consumables.

![](images/75747da23ab5f1081a0fc6690d90c9acf70548429c43327988c2c7ac8afb6ba3.jpg)

![](images/8221b45721227b05ef9f6a5c2bf9d43e4802e8bf3bdf1062d226135b6be38061.jpg)

As soon as you drop down into the cave you'll notice that the air is thick with steam, making it hard to see; because of the number of pitfalls and enemy ambushes in the area, it's advised that you proceed slowly.

![](images/f478b5af6b89cceb16cd74910e83898f64fef4d9c59c6de9cb36b9ecb80bc693.jpg)

Below this ledge you'll see a group of Crawling Geckos on the ground, but what you won't see is the Rock Diver hidden in the wall next to them. This situation is commonplace in the cave, so any time you spot Geckos you should take them out from afar with Shuriken so that you don't have to fight them at the same time as the soldier. Once you've killed the Gecko below the ledge here, drop down and take on the Rock Diver. They will always use a thrust attack as soon as they appear, so be ready to counter it, and then launch into your own offense.

![](images/4d16ac9a6890a72247713ed215dd5119ad593fcbbb8a11b63834ced7e97885a3.jpg)

Use Shuriken to take out the Geckos beneath the nearby bridge, and then wall jump up to the ledge here. There are a lot of Geckos in this section of the cave, but do not worry about being conservative with your Shuriken to save Spirit Emblems for the Puppeteer Ninjutsu, because there are five of them right next to the enemy you're going to use the skill on. The serpent's body will block you going across the bridge, so for now, grapple across to the ledge directly ahead.

![](images/7a019fbb427b3423c408275fad99467faba6e5e498457cda8aacecb704012662.jpg)

Don't head straight for the items once you land on this ledge, otherwise you'll find yourself having to deal with two Rock Divers at the same time. Go forward slowly until the first one appears out of the column, and once that one is defeated, advance for the next item and the second diver will appear.

![](images/7d493c3c68c4833c6a440af3a5772dd22e8cbd6964a9d5200d52c4b57dd5a261.jpg)

Once you have all of the items here, go back to where you first landed on the ledge and you'll notice that you can grapple across to a section of the bridge on the opposite side of the serpent's body. From there you can jump across to the nearby ledge and get the item at the end.

![](images/c9db5e73930e2c2072655c989f0b5d37cff7b15e6ae9dd2871beedf6646d3a72.jpg)

When you reach this point you'll come face-to-face with the head of the serpent, and if you move beyond the column at the start of the bridge, it will strike. You're totally safe if you don't move beyond that point, however. Trying to run along the bridge will only lead to the serpent striking and either knocking you off into the bottomless chasm, or inflicting a large amount of damage. You'll need to remember the old Faithful One's words if you want to get past it.

![](images/cd3de89e9b2fb139998b5c23e94bd4294a220cb8953d7e76e8d7acdd8d022e81.jpg)

![](images/18ebe2ba8d8ead31b7f6c44cfea628048d7d273ab05b2e009cd3ada5d0c35dfc.jpg)

Drop down here and follow the ledges along until you can wall jump up to get behind the cowering monkey; Backstab Deathblow it, and then follow-up with the Puppeteer Ninjutsu. The monkey will start dancing and making a lot of noise once it's under the influence of the skill, and then it will jump across to a ledge high above the bottomless pit.

![](images/0384a9cc0aa8ca9713194c91735ecdc697473fbe30ae1add699669bb3649739b.jpg)

The serpent will become distracted by the monkey, so when you see its head shift focus, grapple across to the midpoint of the bridge, and then run quickly into the building on the other side.

![](images/a86c416bdd4f2fb79eec6ea70676d0d318cfcff1fbb98d36886bbf98dec341b3.jpg)

# Ending Update: Return

The Dried Serpent Viscera you can pick up here is the second of the viscera items that are required for the Divine Child of Rejuvenation's quest. If you've already progressed her quest to the point where you've handed over the Holy Chapters: Dragon Returns, you can now give her these items to progress further. Following our guide you would still be missing the Holy Chapter: Infested, which at this point would require the Mibu Breathing Technique. You acquire that in Ashina Depths, which is the next location we'll be visiting.

![](images/96d8bcb7cb3880bf4a8ebd3385634cc660be5245d4c083f4a8dd102e43296b1c.jpg)

Look up to the side of the building here and grapple up to the ledge above the cave. Follow the tunnel around until you get to the item at the end, and then turn around and look up to find another grapple point that you can use to reach Ashina Depths. The Poison Pool Idol will be directly ahead of you as soon as you enter the depths—regardless of which direction you choose to approach the enemies from, commune with it when starting your journey down into Ashina Depths.

# Ashina Depths

![](images/e7a76430f645324bc69c80cd134fabee6bd13a805de9c1a1bc17a546bd1c4fcb.jpg)

![](images/809d69f7c5583e64089442dbd29a6f3f7f48258f5de661d65c313edd158fbef5.jpg)

# Ashina Depths

Dropping down into the Ashina Depths from the bottomless hole in the Abandoned Dungeon is a one-way trip, so if you need to get back out, this Idol will be your primary option. You'll be greeted by different enemies in the Poison Pool depending on when you arrive here. This is something you'll need to keep in mind when planning your route, so remember this: arrive here before defeating the Guardian Ape in Sunken Valley Passage, and rifle-wielding Valley Clan members will have taken up positions around the pool. After defeating the Ape, however, stronger, cannon-wielding Valley Clan members will occupy the area. If you get here before defeating the

![](images/ae8405d96e43f76837fdc84a2fd2924a13eae886d7a90c0a87b5a0b7e6005314.jpg)

Ape, you're better off starting at this Idol; arrive here later, and it's best to start from the Poison Pool Idol.

![](images/ede48df38e37f8bd4f420ef1cfef8e07664541f226e3563acfef0866b8162987.jpg)

The crack shot Snake Eyes Shirahagi has a commanding view of the area from her position on the opposite side of the pool, and if she spots you, she'll immediately open fire with her powerful rifle. Her eyes are mostly trained on the lower levels of the swamp, however, so you do have some room to move around. If you're facing the rifle Valley Clan members, start by dropping down onto the ledge below here, and then drop down again onto the wooden platform below.

![](images/49f4dbcd06a31d4c88fae3a31530f24895d9aa30b47d97a1711fc6ff8f597c4d.jpg)

![](images/cfe143c0b54b2c132ae27683c2bf447238e0d381e30280e82e92070966a8fc43.jpg)

From here, sneak around behind the rifle-wielding Valley Clan member and use a Backstab Deathblow. The rifle Valley Clan member here is replaced with a cannon-wielding one after the Guardian Ape is defeated, and you can kill it in the same manner if you're starting from this side of the area. If you're starting from the Poison Pool, however, you won't have to worry about this enemy until after Shirahagi has been defeated. Drop down any further than this and Shirahagi will spot you instantly. Instead, use the unmountable grapple points to travel towards the Poison Pool Idol.

![](images/610dad58d99fcee9d95d246419f67531557e4fea831d52168d7c1cfdf34165fa.jpg)

![](images/592a29f93ebd8bfa1a5f65a5ee9841fdb06a7c587499e2eb5e4723f85ee30c67.jpg)

If you're facing the rifle Valley Clan members, the platform here will be totally clear and you can just grab the item and drop down to the Poison Pool Idol. If you're dealing with the cannon Valley Clan members, however, one will be stationed here, so it's best not to approach the ledge from the Ashina Depths Idol side. From the Poison Pool Idol, you can simply grapple up and use a Backstab Deathblow on the Valley Clan member for a quick, undetected kill. The enemy in the middle of the pool patrols around rather than standing still, so be careful not to stand in the open for too long or he may spot you. It's also possible to use the unmountable grapple points to get over to the platforms below the Ashina Depths Idol undetected from here. Doing so allows you to kill the enemy there and then come back to this point.

![](images/029491a14806c56c0b7a069859b088d363898b845fabf3768305df32e5a4b283.jpg)

![](images/55f2827b5e176fd864a8e954357c21b139420f1d0633974b053da2497c2e1bc6.jpg)

# Poison Pool

This Idol is where you'll end up if you drop down from the ledge in the Sunken Valley Passage. You can only access that ledge after making it past the Great Serpent in the cave. If you've managed that, it's likely that you've defeated the Guardian Ape in the Sunken Valley Passage, so you'll have the cannon-wielding Valley Clan members to deal with here. This Idol should also be your primary starting point for any

![](images/7b83e7fdde55db1aec3ac1da16aa028a41501c089edc6f0c046c3db6dcc2aabf.jpg)

attempts at defeating Shirahagi, because it allows you to approach her from a much more advantageous angle.

![](images/55469190b8c06934a2ca4dda330c635d8274b7e55c0d3b49cd4c84b369b044d5.jpg)

From the Poison Pool Idol, grapple up to the hand of the statue here, and then drop down into the swamp and start heading towards the land on the other side of the pool. If you're dealing with the rifle Valley Clan members then there will be two there, but if you angle your approach between them you can get behind the one on the right for a Backstab Deathblow. Killing him in that manner will ensure that the Scatter-shot Valley Clan member in the middle doesn't become alerted during the fight with the other nearby rifle Valley Clan member. If you're facing the cannon Valley Clan members, there are no enemies here, but the patrolling Valley Clan member in the middle can spot you, so head straight towards Shirahagi.

![](images/9b6727989666c6094da52af19e06aba86820d849f693dad8ea303b5962e937ca.jpg)

The deadly sniper Shirahagi must be defeated before you can continue further into the Ashina Depths. On the rifle-wielding Valley Clan member layout, make sure to take out the Valley Clan member on the platforms near the Ashina Depths Idol, because he has a clear line of sight down to this area and will begin shooting at you during the battle. You don't need to worry about the enemy there on the cannon layout, but you do need to be mindful of the patrolling enemy in the middle. Time the start of the fight for just as he starts to have his back to you, and then try to finish the fight before he circles back around. If it looks like you won't have Shirahagi dead in time, bring the fight either down into the tunnel or behind the statue, so that you can remain hidden from the patrolling enemy.

If you're approaching from the Poison Pool IDol side you can easily sneak around behind Shirahagi to start the fight with a Backstab Deathblow. Because of her time spent in the proximity of so much poison, Shirahagi has built up a strong resistance to it, so Sabimaru is not very effective against her. Hitting her twice with the Flame Vent, however, is a good option while she recovers from the Deathblow, and will put you in good stead to finish her off quickly.

![](images/fbbf0e661aabc0b5eacba55e062009b206c89659f8928aab68ea43500f1c8ff1.jpg)  
Ashina Depths

![](images/9af04a07b8d0546728fd401073392f70b4ac93517dfcc3a53b00267d59ec309c.jpg)
