![](images/b2e5fba3a5fdc94340ce3eb39f322148d46fe98047fbeff2a07c797e0ee832d1.jpg)

Once Shirahagi is down, regardless of which enemy layout you're on, time your approach out to the island here so that you can Backstab the final enemy, allowing you to gather up the items in safety.

![](images/bbd845b2764daa5e7f33dc49d121a0ef39d407a8c7b7a2453f22e7af22634dec.jpg)

The blood trail leading into the tunnel is an ominous sign—speak with the dying Valley Clan member leaning against the wall and you can get some clues as to what may have caused it. If you want to go directly to the source, continue along the tunnel. We recommend that you first rest at the Poison Pool Idol before venturing down there if you haven't done so already.

![](images/b863847122ee008f9d94a2d2bd36e307bdac4542ef480b18325619e293c5f74b.jpg)

![](images/153f31b5bcf576fe0f33d6d69462dcd07eac16a7221f2d60d276611688321668.jpg)

There is an alternate route that you can take, however, that leads to some very useful items; to begin that route, grapple up to the ledge here.

![](images/f75914cda7ac484ecaa6e73e57f852667c7b4f937b7ad9161e1bf6443fa0b75f.jpg)

![](images/bfc75fe7d8465346274d79389d87ec05b738bf7e44e185ad65d2472e04e4ed84.jpg)

After going past the first crawlspace in the tunnel, jump up to the ledge here, and then continue along and use a consecutive wall jump to reach a platform overlooking the poison pool. There you can grapple up to the head of the large statue to find a Prayer Bead.

![](images/6d25c614db1521aedc49f25935cf7b6fb10446d6324cd1cfe7c73d2dd3d18052.jpg)

![](images/6747c2606b2132efb3bfe45687dcd3ff9b4d3856fa087c8083918768fed3a64b.jpg)

The monkey here is fixated on the remains of another great ape, allowing you to sneak up behind it and use a Backstab Death-blow. After picking up the item, jump down to the cave below to continue.

![](images/4b2d34e3f0c8b1e6292be65a1125a2632c04e356a6e00d8914c01b9845148a72.jpg)

Boss Battle

# Guardian Ape (Couple)

5040

1687

5000

![](images/48582a2c40c741147611d29face02aaecc13f95a2d7f62f807cdc45b4604e059.jpg)

If you're reaching this area before having defeated the Guardian Ape in the Sunken Valley Passage, this cave will be empty, and you can freely run through it. After that initial encounter, however, the Guardian Ape will return here to his burrow and try to recover from his wounds. Since he's once again standing between you and your goal, you'll need to face him if you want to proceed. The Ape will behave in the same manner as he did during the second phase of your first encounter, so make sure to bring some Pacifying Agents with you to help prevent the Terror build-up.

After removing his first Deathblow Marker, the Ape will let out a gut-wrenching roar and his mate will come bounding into the arena, forcing you to contend with two giant apes. Try to split the apes up as best you can so that you don't have to deal with both of their attacks at the same time. Which ape you take down first should depend on how they are positioned and which one is the safest to attack. The brown ape has significantly less Vitality than the Guardian Ape, but if you kill the Guardian Ape first, his mate will just sit down in despair and disappear. For more, see P451.

![](images/38995aa63185e37f28785865f6ba26ec501b5374a1c8b3ae6dacf507685b07ce.jpg)

![](images/5e391b4aef25c2e667ddb26959e503a20a6dc4909dc3a43acca5495ba936d315.jpg)

# Guardian Ape's Burrow

This Idol will only appear after you defeat the Guardian Ape here, so you won't see it if you haven't defeated the Guardian Ape in Sunken Valley Passage yet. The primary reason for using this Idol will be to return to the cave to finish off the Guardian Ape if you do not have the Mortal Blade at the time of his defeat here. While you can rest here after finishing the Ape, if you travel away and have crafted the Finger Whistle, you'll lose access to the Idol, because a Shichiman

![](images/2269ec0eef5d1996f5fdb7c3ae0c87fdf632248ebbfe374f1a576b353633becd.jpg)

Warrior will take up residence in the cave; defeating him is the only way to gain access to the Idol once more.

# Finishing the Guardian Ape

When you defeat the Guardian Ape here its body will remain in the middle of the cave with the parasite still alive inside, trying to pull itself free. If you have the Mortal Blade you can perform another Finisher Deathblow on it to put an end to the parasite once and for all. In doing so you will be rewarded with the Bestowal Ninjutsu, which should be the final one you need to unlock the "All Ninjutsu Techniques" Achievement/Trophy.

![](images/2366926afc707964150a93dff974ba9f58107a2ac1fb193193fbc4373d901418.jpg)

![](images/217e6243df83ad0aecc6c6567f2e8cf55b802bca2a960ee061b6e1eb9440eff4.jpg)

If Genichiro Ashina was the first of the main bosses you defeated, be careful when reaching this area during the evening, because a pair of Vengeful Spirit Nightjar Ninja will have set up a trap for you. One Nightjar will appear at the other end of the platform below this ledge, and as soon as you drop down, a second will appear behind you. Take out the first one with Shuriken from the ledge so that you only have the second to deal with when you drop down.

![](images/f200b82fb36c80e5b73bdfc373e594c1fd643156d1cd8f310ac2b9000b6193b5.jpg)

# Hidden Forest

The Hidden Forest gets its name from the thick layer of fog that envelops the area ahead, and the trees are not the only things that it's hiding. Drop down from the safety of the tree tops and you'll need to contend with illusory enemies that appear as if out of nowhere. While you can defeat them, they will often keep reappearing after a short while. Your ears will serve you better than your eyes while you're in the fog, with the sounds of the illusory enemies giving away their location long before you can see them.

Not all of the illusory enemies will be hostile while you walk through the fog, but once you get close enough to find out, it will often be too late. If you attack an enemy that was not hostile, it and other nearby enemies will become hostile until you rest at an Idol, even when they reappear after being defeated.

![](images/c6f0dbf7e711177b4e3985ae8a87a4325e960c74dd3a267ecf2dba82549b0493.jpg)

Something must be causing the fog, and it would be wise to find out what before exploring the area fully.

![](images/87bb631ad0634c0c4b477045a90a9f7625bb8db84d23fecfa0864f77dcf161bc.jpg)

Groups of insects have taken up residence on various branches in the forest, and the light emanating from them is strong enough to penetrate even the thickest of fog; any time you're lost, look for those lights and you'll know a grapple point is near. Grapple from here out to the large branch directly ahead and follow it to the trunk of the tree before dropping down.

![](images/a2ab74ca57cb049509451a4aa6db4c1f5d510caaff9b4c5b0de2901b74286945.jpg)

![](images/61085716115083c97fad428c548cee0d5b5bbba00e79f932a21637326671b3c1.jpg)

Next to the tree you'll find a Gamefowl—you'll encounter many of them as you make your way through the forest, often along the branches you need to traverse. Rather than attacking them with your sword and risking falling, it's best to use Shuriken to deal with them from a safe distance.

![](images/63a98ad3355ad8b6fb31f1e0dec08505e9f673c0563c4b1ad6144123a15275b1.jpg)

If you want to explore the forest floor while the fog is still present, this is an excellent place to start from. Grapple down to the branch below you from here, and then when you drop down to the floor, you'll be right next to an Phantom Bandit that you can Backstab Deathblow. From there you can do the same to the other nearby Bandit, and then start making your way up the slope next to the cliff, using Backstab Deathblows on the Bandits as you come to them. Remember that Snap Seeds can be used to take out whole groups of these enemies instantly because they're illusions, but there are bosses coming up that those seeds will be useful for, so make sure you hang onto a few.

![](images/a7cede5ee9a30f47d6087cc1caa43fafab7710d5416b23dafb76160fe34d85f2.jpg)

![](images/3deb3faf9ccc885b78f3ce5bb53e155926c8ddf009b41a256b4bdbc8c4320788.jpg)

While you could fight the Headless straight away upon reaching this point, doing so while running the risk of dragging Phantom Bandits into the encounter will make the fight harder than it needs to be. A better option is to return once the fog has cleared so that you can move around freely. Regardless of how you approach this enemy (even from the ledge above), it will always be able to sense you coming so you won't be able to land any kind of Deathblow on it to start the fight.

That being said, the ledge above does still give you the best position to start the fight from. because you can drop down beside it to start attacking straight away. The Exiled Memorial Mob near Mibu Village also sells the Mottled Purple Gourd, which will allow you defend yourself against Terror build-up without having to use consumables.

![](images/bd7890394a4841861360446e74c4d1e1981852f27a8b2de68aef252b1aa19606.jpg)

![](images/6d2a360b90fd8546cffa0149f909734bf7dda6068ce043543b916b482656a94a.jpg)

![](images/f2a8ba2fb57ff0187c268b522303cce27efc321fe9c01bfc92fa2ed0fff37085.jpg)

The light from the insects will once again guide your way from here, so run along the branches they illuminate to reach the area with the Buddhist Monk.

![](images/79c3b250657bb19f24e17dec25dd1438d395d668a70f7e90a94f60f9f29258cf.jpg)

There's an alternate route here that you can take to reach the Forest of Mist Temple Master that will net you a couple of extra items along the way. Jump across to the ledge at the end of this branch, and then work your way up to the top of the levels and kill the Gamefowl there. From that position you can grapple across to the area behind him.

![](images/410301a80cb4686f24910b8b50fd71eef4d0bec9d25130fd007cbe69180e03b4.jpg)

![](images/0abb48549471f503f9f97225012a330e18522167492925ddfa746614fe9cd6d7.jpg)

# Forest of Mist Temple Master

Talking to this monk will reveal that the fog is being generated by someone in the nearby village, and he asks that you put an end to their schemes. Return to him after clearing the fog for some additional dialogue.

![](images/25bfa21a6cd54be0d0cdb216b3bdf4a2726be7c1dfd5bd37ff2582181ecdc85e.jpg)

The house that the kind monk spoke of is on the opposite side of this part of the forest, and until you clear the fog you won't be able to progress beyond the grounds of that house. As he also mentioned, the only way into the house is via a hole in the roof, so you're going to have navigate the forest floor to find a way up there. Most of the Phantom Bandits in this section are non-hostile. The main threat will come in form of Phantom Hounds that appear out of nowhere; listen for their bark, and then guard immediately until you locate them and use a Shuriken to finish them off quickly.

![](images/35d1a37f6b55c8b5d3c1ca8f91e3ac8879d82705f7c9104fd050c2641ef49144.jpg)

![](images/db46c4462b9e2261a9ea257475005317f6ed589951f663363257cc60461ef418.jpg)

The quickest route through the forest also happens to be the safest, because there are no hostile enemies along the way. Run forward to this point, and then follow the gully around to the left and continue straight until you reach the cliff. Head up the slope there until you can grapple up to the branch near the top and then jump across to the nearby ledge.

![](images/16de629e1613082707fd5fee6c4a4f8774dea99cb3500f16cceb2d5a911139a5.jpg)

![](images/975f0fd44525cb592f043c30ac11dcc0179cbc42996fd005066ecc9bd74ffd3d.jpg)

The trio of items near here are very enticing, but going anywhere near them will cause a group of illusory enemies to appear and ambush you. If you trigger the ambush, quickly move along the narrow gully—it will block the arrows that the archers above you fire off, and acts as a chokepoint for the enemies on the ground. Use Shuriken to kill the hounds quickly, and then turn your attention to the Bandits; only move around to deal with the archers once you've finished the other enemies.

![](images/bb9ec0d43336bebe26ddc208205ffa7b12d8d5fea635dcd4f75057a4fe2dbacc.jpg)

![](images/435e90027a6073fc05419e940d4762c00f072368f1d862bdadbd0618780f4b2c.jpg)

Before jumping to the ledge and continuing from this tree you can walk to the end of it and then shimmy along a wall to reach another ledge with an item on it. Return the same way once you have the item.

![](images/6325e9a5d1bb20f2c2dc83c5d24ca0b17b24d137b9c77ae4aae073f7d0fa97d7.jpg)

![](images/9cbda0a0ef3db1d8389cbc41c9848b07939de64601169314701169cbb63e8b0a.jpg)

The monkeys surrounding Tokujiro might have their vision impaired by the fog, but their keen sense of hearing will allow them to detect you from quite some distance. Walk out onto the branch here, however, and you can kill all of them with Shuriken without Tokujiro detecting you. Once they're down, use the unmountable grapple point to propel yourself over to the ledge behind him.

![](images/50f954e6d6680d469441ed76c328786e95c2d3594eb6cab72ffee9fff5c072cb.jpg)

![](images/c468b4e0896ebfb283dfe99666c1c452ce290e16a124718e50f85cdbb7427278.jpg)

Now that the monkeys are out of the way, if you choose to fight Tokujiro you can do so from this ledge—use a Plunging Deathblow on him to initiate combat. He uses a lot of Poison-based attacks, and often applies a coating of Poison to his weapon, so make sure you have some Antidotes handy, or use a Contact Medicine before the fight. The terrain here can make it difficult to judge the range of some of his attacks if you're higher than him on the slope, so try to stay at the same height or lower.

![](images/97f22dd31041f62d204d6df2ac81b0b75def6b61f79e62033edc0e1001510f73.jpg)

To reach the item on the narrow ledge you'll need to first jump out from here and grab onto the ledge. Shimmy along it until you can pull yourself up and grab the item, and then grapple up to the branch to continue.

![](images/dbe23023c18e8e64b26e3f43baf2c589a0f9a583f2fad25fb1d61743f786d898.jpg)

![](images/6695f83310922672c242a3af997c754f13c0420b9e1dbcccbdbad607769d5c3a.jpg)

The ledge you need to reach in order to access the roof of the house is around the cliff from here, so start by grappling down to the branch below this ledge. From there you can run along and grapple up to another branch, before grappling over to the ledge that leads towards the house.

![](images/865ec8a960403ecabc04f34eb6dbcddeadde55ca5688e1e4451e9cafac0a3971.jpg)  
Ashina Depths

![](images/fa9a8f28d22e8547533102e9f0a40e30997204187a8f6f8bc2865e2131c1f742.jpg)

![](images/1f223dae706b0bf0b8833913552aebc854f71fd2c56b789a592a1e947bee18f0.jpg)

To enter the house you'll need to grapple across to the branch in front of the ledge, and then run all the way along the branches until you can jump over to the lower section of the roof; follow it around to the front and go through the hole in the wall.

![](images/bf255b61688eea7e46133fe4e56dac0969624f68596a0d03ce602b2e1ad82fc9.jpg)

![](images/3e00aafb862975e079a1f66f9ec622fd1330a45ec7df267c1e400fa10e1a629c.jpg)

The source of the mysterious fog and the captivating music is revealed upon dropping down onto the rafters of the house—it is the Mist Noble below you. The only way to stop the enchantment is to kill the creature, so start off by using a Plunging Deathblow in it. While its ability to create fog and illusions may have been powerful, the creature is not particularly adept at combat; keep attacking it as soon as the deathblow is over and it will quickly fall, dispelling the illusion and clearing the fog.

![](images/e83beceb2bfcaec402e1821585bcd2af44bb312272ad324d566b2bc7af1b1ce5.jpg)

Now that the air is clear you can freely backtrack and pick up any items from within the forest, without fear of the illusory enemies. The illusion was also masking the way forward, so when you're ready to continue, go through the newly-revealed passage behind the house.

![](images/bacd9b50a4834853c9b59be4c7525c0a056c6b7d0df563c2653cf70d7054dfa0.jpg)

![](images/b9415587f66b0e41b94aba007876ffac44f48f1bdca7da98da990f91e4b0812c.jpg)

The way down towards the village starts at the ledge here, but be very careful if the Ashina Castle set of Vengeful Spirits are active, because the ledges and branches that are needed to safely descend will be occupied by a pair of Nightjar Ninja. The first Nightjar can be killed with your Shuriken from here, but to reach the next one you'll need to time your grapple between the branches so that you do not get hit by his attacks while in mid-air. After landing on the next branch, quickly drop down to the ledge and close in to finish off the Nightjar before continuing.

![](images/d0953f11e7f2a164f2d549bebae83cd698fbb4b9ef3d15c814087ab0d389d85e.jpg)

If you want to go straight to the next Idol, grapple across to the nearby branch, and then run along it and drop down from the ledge to land safely next to the Idol.

![](images/81bdbb790b293af3f79972acd88295681cce72cc014615ec2ba5889ca2802fdd.jpg)

![](images/73fe0218bdbc79a97d48eeb6341430d53bb2855cbc4ecfea95eff6f37355504e.jpg)

Look down from the corner of the ledge here and you'll be able to see four Hounds standing below you—from this vantage point you can take them all out safely with Shuriken. If you're detected by any of the hounds in this area and they bark, the Lone Shadow that's standing in the river will come to investigate, so it's important to take them out as quickly and quietly as possible.

![](images/c119d3ec6e232d43125e3b9a270df07bbc48fa2c977af8e238436c0b46ac0869.jpg)

![](images/0e4e5b21631c0d89dd3888faf98048d8dd799d5c8e23ca5802af270c73e98a5f.jpg)

Stand here and you'll be able to see the Lone Shadow below you, and another hound on the ledge to the side of him. Regardless of your method, if you kill the hound, the Lone Shadow will turn hostile immediately and you won't be able to deathblow him. Instead, use a Plunging Deathblow from here to kill the Lone Shadow, and then simply Shuriken the hound afterwards once you've made your way out of the ravine.

![](images/49ae38c9976ef4fc3ec87a9e2a1f2653a4b104ba365363a43428c41e820cccb3.jpg)

![](images/3bb17b745221c564fc05f0e742748f23ce9c0bb94462b7178078aaa456d6ea98.jpg)

# Mibu Village

The villagers of this once peaceful hamlet have become corrupted from drinking the fountainhead waters that flow through the area, and as such they have developed some unique characteristics. Kill one of the villagers and it will often rise out of the ground again after a short while; a process they are capable of repeating multiple times. When attempting to clear the village it's important to proceed slowly, and always

![](images/303f5f41c1f05af80404c55f6e5042ca4491f187c2cd6ece09cd2d2e76cef81b.jpg)

check to make sure no villagers are continuing to rise so that you don't end up caught between multiple groups of enemies.

# Exiled Memorial Mob

Hopefully you've been hoarding your Sen, because this member of the Memorial Mob has quite a few big ticket items that are sure to put a dent in your savings. If you're wanting to fight the Headless nearby, then the Mottled Purple Gourd would be a wise purchase, otherwise the upgrade materials and the Treasure Carp Scales should be top of your priority list.

![](images/1be974bdaaaf9f2166869502a2b3134fd2a12037ac1085854eb844c6cfdabc5d.jpg)

Here you will encounter your first group of Mibu Villagers, and while individually they do not pose much of a threat, their strength lies in their sheer numbers and ability to regenerate themselves. Take it slow and kill off the villagers as they appear, and only advance when you're sure no more are emerging from the ground.

![](images/3683e3d9f643811cb575eb9b5c102f9316353d25a7006641c2e060ec580a6b68.jpg)

![](images/7cb1eebf0785315f80ca74713c085d33c290763fb7deb8786d12fc51d78c46c8.jpg)

The next group of villagers is quite large, so if you're coming here early in the game you may want to use the tall grass along the cliff to sneak past them. They are also bunched up quite tightly, so if you fight them, attacks that can hit multiple targets can be very effective, especially ranged options such as the Gouging Top Shuriken. Keep a close eye out for the knife-wielding villagers, because they can run and grab you very quickly; prioritize taking those out first.

# Ashina Depths

![](images/fa4f5c9992adbce6ef150db34e9f164b1d8d2ac8d63959f7a9316580556964b9.jpg)

You'll encounter another new type of villager here, capable of throwing projectiles that inflict a large amount of Terror build-up and leave a lingering Terror cloud for a few seconds. Like the knifewielding villagers, these ones should also be a priority. Make sure to have Pacifying Agent or the Purple Mottled gourd in your Quick Items to get rid of any Terror build-up you incur during the fights.

![](images/6a8e4c3cb9074692409bf40aa04823fbb6ba30e602c8fe9c578c188c18089006.jpg)

![](images/b9d00a24daad52d9b7b3c57195ba04fafecd28e74d8d23a5d2494a2db5bc9f7f.jpg)

To gain access to this house, grapple up to the tree in front of it, and then jump across to the roof and drop down through the hole.

![](images/12678f94558da4192d84f7c2f4faadb3c849610951a4885278c374408fa92a63.jpg)

# Basket Wearer Shosuke

This cowardly villager was spared from the same fate as the others due to overindulging in alcohol, and now all he can do is hide. His knowledge of the village can prove extremely useful if you talk to him, however, especially regarding the village priest and an outcast known for burning a very potent resin.

![](images/1dbfc84b73ac8eae2787ec4c6c0efec04293a5877f083b29df323b46f62bfd77.jpg)

The outcast that Shosuke spoke of lives across the lake in a secluded part of the village, so if you want to investigate the resin, swim across the lake, and then grapple up to the dock on the other side. There are Man-eating Carp in the waters around the dock, but if you jump onto the boats fast enough you won't have to deal with them unless you want to.

![](images/0743da18dc8d2e907edf934951cc85bb4aea5c2c9a8cc32ef76c82acb184fa4d.jpg)

![](images/90e8875ed739b07ceff222336823e9f336002110a999d25e4421302e4b2ce3b3.jpg)

The Mibu Breathing Technique is acquired from defeating the boss of this area; as soon as you have it, return to the lake and dive beneath the surface to acquire the Prayer Bead from the chest at the bottom.

![](images/7539fbff0a6ec0a1429ae7d1d20e3ba3a25b135621fac2452df276d5da6d30c2.jpg)

# Dojun Update

While you're under the surface of the lake you'll encounter what at first appears to be a normal Treasure Carp, but closer inspection reveals that is has red eyes. If you kill this carp you'll get the Red Carp Eyes, an item that Dojun is extremely interested in.

![](images/87e45295fc3968d289099740cd68786b59656c169a2d584a28f35c46a9c1121b.jpg)

There are only a few villagers here initially—take them out before proceeding any further, because as soon as you jump onto the roof of the house ahead, a large group of them will emerge from underground and spring an ambush.

![](images/3cbe19fe45f76413cf8906d7e34aabe760fa6a42c5cd308ff8f9b56cd32d6081.jpg)

Dropping down to fight them all would be especially dangerous due to the narrow area and the presence of two Mibu Taro Troops, so your best option is to grapple up to the ledge here. From here you can wait until they all drop out of alert status, and then use a Plunging Deathblow on one of the Taro Troops to start the fight.

Alternatively, if you have the Vault Over Skill, using it after killing one of the villagers so that you can trigger the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu can be very effective here. Use the time to kill as many villagers as you can, without using any Deathblows, since they will only slow you down. Another option is to get behind one of the Taro Troops, Backstab Deathblow him, and then use the Puppeteer Ninjutsu to gain a powerful ally. Move up the hill during the fight to try and separate the enemies, and focus on taking out the villagers as they appear.

![](images/7d0c57cceb46a4ca7ba16605211195f9949c9f23c647210ad7322891470f7555.jpg)

![](images/e5b668c12bb9b87a374b0cfdac121a9255d8408118dd75bd13097cb5494d527d.jpg)

The villagers have learned over the years that passersby like to stop and look at the cherry blossom tree, and they've turned that to their advantage. In the area surrounding the tree you'll notice patches of cherry blossom petals on the ground—if you go anywhere near them, a villager will spring forth and grab onto you. You can avoid the attack by quickly moving out of the way, but if you're caught in it, you'll need to rapidly press attack, jump or dodge to break free. The safest approach for dealing with the villagers here is to stay well clear of the cherry blossom petals until all the villagers above ground have been killed, and then sprint over the petals to trigger the ambushes one at a time and kill those villagers.

![](images/09a2d007aa2d1e9408030cd3e0e20023dc08f7b6769ba06b3931ee5544feca25.jpg)

![](images/a4a8ecc2068ac838e81051d82d4765d58066c947830e2b9fa001d74a0a893d2d.jpg)

This trench next to the cherry blossom tree can be used to sneak past the villagers farming the land to the left, and the Taro Troop guarding the stairs leading up to the next section of the village.

![](images/132d4675f926e3cb0ba5c14e181ae6248c2a9f76448760692c1cc1f6caca58f7.jpg)

![](images/f92e8c2738c7bca0faff7fd56cddc7888312cb2f330a800960dc7077d9347e59.jpg)

All the villagers farming in this area are facing down the hill, so if you approach them head on, they'll spot you coming before you ever get close to them. By following that trench you can get to the side of them, and then grapple up to this point undetected. From here you can sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on the Mibu Taro Troop. This is the only enemy that could spot you once you're behind the others, so taking it out first will make dealing with the rest much easier.

![](images/4978b0376b857b8ee252d1ac93e2d88b3aa4a0902d755c01b71b85924d9afa37.jpg)

Use a wall jump to reach this ledge and you can follow it past all the enemies until you're behind them, then drop down and claim the sake. Now that the enemies have their backs to you, you can systematically work your way down the levels using Backstab Deathblows on them one at a time, or just grapple back up to the ledge again and make your way back that way.

![](images/5779d618a150198922e96e11dee907add2b21fdef1627c4cb76df1c75c56db31.jpg)

# Vengeful Spirits

If you're here during the evening, and Genichiro Ashina was the first main boss you defeated, a large group of Vengeful Spirit Nightjar Ninja will appear in the farming grounds when you enter the area. If you circled around behind the normal enemies initially, you will be behind the Nightjars when they appear and can Backstab Deathblow them along with the other enemies as you make your way down the levels.

![](images/32eec84894f9d16f1dd73ea67401e0c49dfa28a7311db0b2de1dffff854d1083.jpg)

With a sprinting jump from here you can cross the gap and land next to the house on the other side. You can then head around to the right and use a Backstab Deathblow on the villager there, and then use a Plunging Deathblow on the Taro Troop below.

![](images/a2a48fbd5f265dec280bc0013eb5f55bb2a360f1ef85d787b1175a0225d0ae81.jpg)

# Water Mill

After battling through the hordes of villagers, the warm glow of this Idol will be a welcome sight when you cross the bridge to reach it. It's also the final sanctuary before the priest's house, and the boss battle beyond it.

![](images/5cb31b3db8b4f4ccada6d40d71d75a4cc2ce82ed275c2d19f54788a5302e43ea.jpg)

# Jinzaemon Kumano

If you've been following Jinzaemon's quest, and didn't send him to the Abandoned Dungeon, you'll find him sitting along the path here, just past the Idol. The sound of the shamisen is closer than ever—it's being played by O'rin of the Water just up the hill. If you speak with Jinzaemon before defeating her, his quest will come to a peaceful end. Kill her before the Interior Ministry raids Ashina Castle, and before speaking with Jinzaemon, however, and he'll become enraged if you speak with him afterwards, and you'll have to fight him.

![](images/96cd5a2b65373e7f9c35f284034c9a24a66ec00088e076758a83173187f3d6b2.jpg)

Jump into the water from here and you can swim up the river and reach an item in a chest beneath the waterfall. There's also a Treasure Carp beneath the surface, worth remembering once you have the Mibu Breathing Technique. The bridge across the river also features some grapple points that you can use to reach the top of it, giving you the option to continue without having to face O'rin.

![](images/c581c5c5fa228166e43d4a10ec7e79b075346a274a8fb99a920398486bc0316f.jpg)

![](images/64976434889025a6b33607cb89470521ebd30e052a2b21de1467a159bb997332.jpg)

When you first start approaching O'rin you will hear her sobbing while strumming her samishen. When you get close to her you'll see that you can initiate a conversation, and it's then that you'll need to make a choice. Through the conversation you can learn some interesting information about her, but she will turn immediately hostile afterwards and you'll lose any advantage you may have otherwise had. While you can't start the fight with a Deathblow of any kind, you can attack her without talking to her to get a few easy hits in. If you simply try to run past her, she will not be happy that you ignored her and will turn hostile.

The Sabimaru Tool is the perfect thing to use during the fight, and especially as a pre-emptive attack before speaking with her, because it will mean you'll need less hits during the fight to inflict poison. Divine Confetti will also give you a significant damage boost against her, but you should only consider it if you're having trouble against her, due to how valuable it is against other enemies. Her slow Posture recovery speed means that breaking her Posture is usually the fastest way to victory, so focus on your deflects and using Combat Arts such as Ichimonji.

# Vengeful Spirits

A Vengeful Spirit Fencer will appear on the bridge here under the right conditions, so if you see him appear, quickly backtrack to where O'rin was and fight him there to avoid accidentally falling into the water during the fight.

![](images/784ead4b6a6a0d4700a5b23cb4c6d6e8f1e11d34dc4fd161023000db352e6312.jpg)

If you want to head straight to the boss and not deal with the head priest, grapple up to the branch here, and then run straight up the stairs to start the fight.

![](images/fa6ea5e4df17d514b7ce293783deab0444dbf407d0d368aa7526336a37a367d3.jpg)

You can still go and speak with the priest without having to face all of the enemies outside by sneaking along this side of the area, and going straight to the crawlspace beneath the house. When you're under the house, look up at the end of the crawlspace to find a Shinobi Shortcut that you can use to gain entry.

![](images/f095f6de655d4be439d1da15fae99f6d031dfd647a72324204e40aa5721fe93c.jpg)

![](images/02cf2a30ea39a9af6fd349ebf2b1107c0af4b1aa89becec2e1b025c43abafa85.jpg)

All the enemies here are fixated on what's going on in the village priest's house, allowing you to easily sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on the Taro Troop, since he poses the biggest threat. None of these enemies will emerge from the ground after you've defeated them, so take your time and pick off the villagers one by one. Once the area is clear, go up to the door of the house and eavesdrop on the priest to find out what he's up to, and then head into the crawlspace to get inside.

![](images/ea5367fd6c76ea97e67c5db917502101df4205c1c116773f9614e59d20390da3.jpg)

# Mibu Village Priest

Locked away inside his house you'll find the village priest obsessively drinking the local water without a care for anything else. No amount could ever quench his thirst, or lead him to the fabled palace that he one day dreams of reaching.

![](images/b8b45bfc9c9606aa38616cb7c53fac22f196e6bae70e7f898b4cd27f3b946baf.jpg)

Go through the hole in the side of the house and jump onto the collapsed stone that's serving as a makeshift bridge. From here you can turn around to face the house and find a grapple point that you can use to access the attic and the item hidden within it. Look up to the roof while you're in the attic and you'll find a hole that you can jump through to get onto the roof, where there's another item.

![](images/15c4763c347e4ceec8d5bb031e9a4b517cbe90ff39c210d128ad76e3078d07c8.jpg)

# Boss Battle

# Corrupted Monk (Illusion)

7904

2227

5500

![](images/068eb944bc6dcd0d7b3f8b936e3e1d549c1fcc56b19fff9c479015a1a0cff962.jpg)

The Corrupted Monk is the guardian of the wedding cave, and she will not let anyone gain access uninvited. Because she's an apparition, however, you can exploit a lot of their inherent weaknesses. Snap Seeds are especially effective against her, because not only will they cause a brief stun, but they'll also deplete  $10\%$  of her Vitality instantly. This can only be done three times, however, and due to the rarity of Snap Seeds you may want to only make use of them if you're having trouble defeating her.

Her attacks have a lot of range, but they are also quite slow and recover slowly—try to take advantage of that by using movement to avoid her attacks and land your own hits as she recovers. Shuriken can be quite effective for punishing missed attacks if you're too far away to close in, and Firecrackers can be used to stun her briefly up close, creating a window to attack. To find out exactly how to counter all of her attacks, turn to P458.

![](images/80096782e7cb6cd1c78852509e274d356b33312f8adfc0aefd1dc07e31a01a21.jpg)

![](images/65d085e3aff30dcd25517b1e892cc576d646947014c0ed2c230941c4b4882233.jpg)

# Wedding Cave Door

This Idol will appear after you have defeated the Corrupted Monk. You'll primarily use it to return to the cave once you've gathered all of the required ingredients to recreate the fountainhead aroma, and have spoken to Lord Kuro about them.

# Update: Story Quests

The Shelter Stone in the cave will be the final ingredient you need to recreate the fountainhead aroma if you've been following this guide. Before picking it up, make sure you've done everything you need to do in Ashina Castle. Specifically, anything involving Emma or Lord Kuro, because as soon as you pick up the stone you'll be unable to travel back to Kuro's Room, or most other places in the castle grounds until the current events there are resolved.

# Mibu Breathing Technique Update

Now that you have this technique you can dive beneath the surface in any body of water that's deep enough, where you'll often find some hidden treasures. Before going into the cave and progressing the story, you may want to return to previous locations and collect the items beneath the surface, to ensure you're as strong as possible for the upcoming battles. Of particular note is the Hidden Chapter: Infested if you didn't acquire it before finding out about the Mortal Blade. This item sits at the bottom of the lake near the Temple Grounds in Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo, and will let you progress events with the Divine Child. Look for dark blue areas on the maps to find other places where you can dive underwater.

![](images/fe92134b44f0ae1f8e34ba785fb8fc90f63c84b66d050b71ca0cab1b348fff26.jpg)

When you're ready to continue, head into the cave and pick up the Shelter Stone from the altar.

![](images/eba50fdec963532e9443b576cf4d50bf084b02177358721f84fc42fe38d4f653.jpg)

# Update: Story Quests

If the Shelter Stone is the final ingredient that you need to recreate the fountainhead aroma, picking it up will immediately set into motion a series of events. Your primary goal at this time is to get the ingredients back to Lord Kuro, but if you try to travel, you'll notice that you have lost access to all Idols in Ashina Castle except the Abandoned Dungeon Entrance; you have no choice but to travel there and begin your investigation.

![](images/28b3765f83c075a259ae3609dcb825749dac25180c7ac5a0abd224e2cd5f41a4.jpg)

The ingredients Lord Kuro needs have been secured, but Ashina Castle is under attack by the Interior Ministry. The person orchestrating the attack awaits at the top of the castle, where the Wolf's loyalties will be put to the test.

# Abandoned Dungeon Entrance

It only takes a few steps upon entering the castle grounds to realize that something is amiss. Forces loyal to the Interior Ministry have launched a raid on the castle in an attempt to locate Lord Kuro, and you are caught in the middle of it. Thankfully the raid is limited to the castle area, and Ashina Reservoir and Outskirts remain unchanged by the events taking place here. As you navigate the streets you'll find the ministry forces clashing with the Ashina soldiers, and you can often use those situations to your advantage by letting both sides weaken themselves before you engage them.

Ministry shinobi have also setup bamboo bridges that span many of the rooftops, opening new routes that you can take advantage of. There are several new items to find around the area, so it's worth taking the time to explore the grounds again; any items that you didn't pick up previously will also still be here. Many of the doors and windows you previously opened

![](images/d0dd884e9ea2f254c99e4660831ddeacf73cf2be5b54587bb33ba987a291683f.jpg)

have been sealed up, and to use any of the other Idols you'll first need to commune with them again.

![](images/410bca80db43acc0f8cf5e8b22563e606d9dbbf34f937621b67b78c60cb33f36.jpg)

After eavesdropping on the lone Ashina soldier near the doorway here, sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on him so he no longer needs to worry about when the next shift will arrive.

![](images/708f58eb89934e98119dbb2881023559662026a8d5e84956d2fdfaa389d31f51.jpg)

![](images/d0ffc52e3fb72c7c0ef2cd7bb34aa9c14fc7179b300642ac47388c95b3e2c787.jpg)

The Taro Troop and his pack of Hounds in the courtyard ahead are in a slightly different position now. If you want to take them on, hide here in the doorway and Shuriken the hounds, and then sneak around and use a Backstab Deathblow on the Taro Troop once his alert status has reset. You can also grapple up to the gate just past them and continue without fighting them.

![](images/014381cc4dd6da0e5cb98c2540138547eea7a3d734b071745e7d712eea050508.jpg)

![](images/540fa87cc55971eb39a6a63f8f30640d7d499c140d5f5cb628bd62fa2125c316.jpg)

From atop this gate you'll see a normally fearless Ashina Soldier fleeing for his life and hiding behind a wagon on the bridge; the only way to find out what has him so scared is to close in and investigate.

![](images/69bf783025c169f84568b3174e08e4693fdbe39317392b6d21e833da69b79640.jpg)

![](images/a51fcb8b93ab1f589446f9676f88164be27f5f934f623638ba8c1c4bacae3975.jpg)

Quickly cross the bridge and use a Backstab Deathblow on the cowering soldier; you'll want him out of the way while you're fighting the new enemy that's currently advancing on you through the doorway on the other side of the bridge. These Red Guard wield a pair of kodachi, and are not an enemy to be taken lightly. Face them much as you would a Samurai General, unless you have the Divine Abduction tool. This tool is extremely effective against the Red Guard, and can be used to instantly put them into a state from which you can Backstab Deathblow them, even after combat has been initiated.

![](images/cb4e9c097dc2499ecd90b77f1435a6a662c0a5a9f47a6779c8423109f537adfe.jpg)

![](images/e8ff0bbe98f059be8347466f6b669b31313c1d1a65ad8287a3a02ef0f3164333.jpg)

The bridge across the moat has been destroyed during the raid with no means of getting directly across to the main gate, you'll need to look for another option. Look down and you'll see one of the bamboo bridges that the ministry forces have installed; grapple down to that, and then jump into the moat. Use the Mibu Breathing Technique to dive beneath the surface so that you can follow the water channel beneath the streets to the rear section of the moat. There's also a Treasure Carp in these waters, so make sure to kill it while you're here.

![](images/333c3d89ac738a2360a23bc462587a3adabbfe16955d7fdce84ce8edae00e16c.jpg)

Once you reach this point you'll see a Lone Shadow standing on one of the bamboo bridges above the building to the right. If you grapple up to the roof and walk along it, the Lone Shadow will detect you immediately and launch into a diving kick that can be difficult to deflect—to easily evade the kick, grapple up to the bridge he was standing on as soon as you're detected. From there you can grapple up to the roof of the building above and wait until the Lone Shadow loses sight of you, and then use a Plunging Deathblow on him.

![](images/2980f59bd31841d8b96c44521d0be38e7d51495f4df454eeaf4ab1443fc0adca.jpg)

![](images/bd1027f9d506a93df01f212ff4db01a69b9f2579fa5fa1aa8d1a785e1e5fb368.jpg)

To proceed straight up to the roof of the main castle, grapple across the main street from here, and then proceed up the rooftops and use the bamboo bridge to take you straight up to the castle. The Lone Shadow standing on the castle roof will detect you as soon as you near the end of the bamboo bridge, so if you're taking that path, be ready to fight him. Following the route around to the side of the castle roof will make the fight against the Lone Shadow much easier, so we recommend taking that approach.

![](images/72b2d4858f71a721b0ab7db923d27b39bd49064ebd8d67fa247c8555d84524e0.jpg)

![](images/4857ee2ba1e969fd34a03948a255af13863a1980746e16072d389462b20fdd4c.jpg)

There's still a lot to explore before heading up to the castle; move to this point, and then crouch down once you reach the doorway. Ahead you'll see a Red Guard leaning around a wall just waiting to ambush the soldier around the corner; put an end to his plans by sneaking up and using a Backstab Deathblow on him, and then go round and take out the soldier yourself.

![](images/bb79bcd9035746d6894ad865288fbc4276494394bad76ae0de059e731b196251.jpg)

If you didn't acquire the Gatehouse Key before the raid started, you'll be able to pick it up from the body of a dead Ashina Soldier here.

# Ashina Castle

If you want to acquire some extra Skill EXP during the raid, this Idol presents you with an efficient means of doing so. After resting, you can go through the gate and Backstab Deathblow the nearby soldier. Then just hug the wall and

![](images/cf4334103fd52d2370eefa34feee8124287feff3099c3117ab62df02c7bc610c.jpg)

move to the corner near the Red Guard—wait for him to walk past, and then Backstab Deathblow him too. Simply rest again and repeat as often as you like.

![](images/22c2f56a35dc4f4392d1d3c3870c79898976c0fa38f7b2cc33fefa3a5fb4aee7.jpg)

Another Ashina Soldier will attempt to flee the Red Guard if you go up the main stars, which will lead to you having to face three of them in a row. The interior doors of the lower floor have been sealed again, so going up the stairs provides no real benefit, and you'll have a much easier time against those enemies by approaching them from behind later.

![](images/adb6258beeffc6f5b54689b57999cc71f55fd657fb428539d783cdb91685857d.jpg)

![](images/b2c4037fac4ded8498c638465b80f3654a14a130e34830b26d08ede5119740de.jpg)

Grapple up to the wall here, and the grapple straight up to the roof of the building ahead and run straight along it, above the enemies. From this vantage point you'll be able to witness another Red Guard ambush, this time on a pair of unsuspecting Ashina Soldiers. Wait for the battle to begin, and then use a Plunging Deathblow on the Red Guard before finishing off both soldiers.

![](images/a10cdfe36e72477252cdc1994f2d4a2a2ed78471d692777d7ef3f8a7e94a2d31.jpg)

![](images/b53d511c6e7de9c282fc8b71b7789731c1209966dda6cc1105858c5f8d9035e0.jpg)

Follow the series of grapple points up from the branch here, to the rooftop directly ahead, and then again to the next rooftop. There's an Assassin watching over this area from up high on the tall watch-tower, so if you don't want to get spotted, keep crouched and try to avoid moving around in the open.

![](images/73778ad05ee0d67b368c5b177e4d103a0bf62b489a40cafe4ba99fbe5f37f03c.jpg)

![](images/beb8f50f3b07d62299b45dbce0aa8c9da0167f4242ced766115951c005392faa.jpg)

From this vantage point you'll be able to see a group of Interior Ministry Assassins hanging off the edge of the roof below you, just waiting to spring an ambush. In true shinobi fashion, you can use their plan against them. Walk towards them along the rooftop you're on until they spring their trap, and then retreat back around the rooftop so that by the time one of them jumps up here, you're behind cover. Quietly move behind the Assassin and use a Backstab Deathblow once he turns around. Remain crouched, and then drop down from the corner of the roof between the two Assassins below and Deathblow them one at a time to finish the group off.

![](images/f0e726bc68834fa40e2dc315c8b76d23ff7d4bbadaf753dff9b37d4ddd2aef23.jpg)

![](images/6931bb2a78ede69054f02355649812ff3febb2ea1fbaf612b6e3099fdfc7ff8f.jpg)

Drop down onto this section of wall so that you're above the trio of Ashina Soldiers—use a Plunging Deathblow on the one in the straw cape, and then cut down the remaining two.

![](images/770b76b2d7a420dfa2d1a42c3ee157a8e5fa31bd9b03ade3b2b77ebe37bce196.jpg)

![](images/61e125a9eb4498ac8c3aae1a3c06fb454233590bcb93628ca593436208367b22.jpg)

Make your way back up to this rooftop, and then sprint jump off the corner so that you can grapple across to the tall watchtower. When you land there, grapple to the upper section and move around behind the assassin so that you can use a Backstab death-blow.

![](images/1f29244fcb71f8e7e18bf269a1e769f8c16793eb953ac2d48b488bbeda7d68ca.jpg)

To start taking out the remaining Assassins, drop down to this point on the lower rooftop tier, and from there you can use a Plunging Deathblow on the Assassin directly ahead of you. The Assassin on the roof will become alerted and investigate, so quickly go around the corner and pull yourself up to the rooftop he came from.

![](images/54a95eb09d2be65b2d1fbf4d6e54063861986371983173172442f264f9023e82.jpg)

From here you can use a Plunging Deathblow to kill the next Assassin. The final Assassin should start making his way back up to the roof he started on now, so jump up and grab onto the ledge to watch him while he moves back into position. When he has his back to you, pull yourself up and close in behind him for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/3d598e17e0bbb5211c4411922251a582e1d2517d4c6419bd045e24bf11b143c3.jpg)

# Ashina Castle (Interior Ministry Raid)

![](images/d9f7682c2d794a62f938f7a10be5e971058748dfc6f2b7db6cc2844d92fb6e3a.jpg)

![](images/fa94991a93caeab9e8e6c6c99c822be370d309ab996ee6ab376511455ceca2b7.jpg)

Starting your assault on the castle from here will put you in a much better position against the Lone Shadow standing guard over the bamboo bridge. Crouch and move along the rooftop until you can lock onto the Lone Shadow, and then use the Finger Whistle to get his attention. When he starts closing in, retreat back around the corner and hug the wall. Once he's within range, throw a Ceramic Shard at him to lure him to the corner for a Wall Hug Deathblow.

![](images/7c70a3a73ff88eabdb4de5bb7d93ed7c7cd1f326b8274d8b5b4b607b07d5866d.jpg)

![](images/6c6c4fd2469059458d7357355f69d2fda3a128dc79a9e1e7fb272e8136938ab3.jpg)

Crouch down when you start approaching this corner and keep advancing until the Hound just beyond it senses you and comes to investigate; use a Shuriken to kill it quickly as soon as it comes into view.

![](images/e1d14b77be822b09fbbd5ea150be6161eda8029329ace0520d18ce896dc0c883.jpg)

There are a lot of Lone Shadows in the area ahead, and if you get into open combat there's a high likelihood that you'll end up having to contend with multiple strong enemies at once. Through some efficient tool usage, however, you can make things significantly easier for yourself. Your first targets should be the two patrolling Lone Shadows just around the corner here; lock onto them one at a time and use the Finger Whistle to lure them in so that you can Wall Hug Deathblow them. The patrolling Lone Shadow on the adjacent rooftop also comes within range for you to lock onto him, so you can use the Finger Whistle to lure him in for a Wall Hug Deathblow as well.

![](images/1a0682b7babb4fe7af2b6dadb3abac2e37b54c70cc29c6430e70de155d02c113.jpg)

![](images/7bdee6036d98ed9142e382082d1b14b54413a04a6d42c2b6e87fd71743215a09.jpg)

With all of the patrolling Lone Shadows out of the way you can freely grapple across to this rooftop without risk.

![](images/9e6925a977e56a92e968610e187f11727589302694c038769334056c2748dc51.jpg)

Grapple to the upper section of the rooftop here so that you can see the remaining Lone Shadow standing on the next rooftop ahead of you. There are two Hounds on the lower section of on the building, and if you kill them now, the Lone Shadow will abandon his position to investigate, making things more difficult for you. A better option is to deal with the Lone Shadow first. Stay on the righthand side of the rooftop peak while you move along it, so that the hounds don't spot you, and then when you're close enough, jump up to the middle of the next rooftop and Backstab Deathblow the Lone Shadow.

![](images/31d3c9d479fb741b83ad42e9a7afa9cd49e91b383d2d2ea1a8e47956c81949b8.jpg)

![](images/e07753952f1b9878f841fdf33d1b63b9ac36729e02704edc3199c1dc2bd162a6.jpg)

Now that the Lone Shadows are dead and can no longer provide back-up, use Shuriken to finish off the hounds quickly.

![](images/3d4fe91c56846d363556e759b3d3332bb52ec17db7fb7ad7024c1ea0db54d659.jpg)

![](images/d1e570c31133f155de41863c0b84b6a934932d20aef1bd8c3a2e64b96844aa61.jpg)

From here you can proceed in a few different ways. The bamboo bridge leads straight up to the lookout area, where there's another boss encounter waiting for you. You can also use either of the lower roof tiers to access the Ashina Dojo area or the Upper Tower - Antechamber Idol. The final option is to explore the grounds to the rear of the castle. Going into the dojo area through the window puts you at a disadvantage against the enemies in there, so taking that route is not recommended.

Commune with the Antechamber Idol, regardless of whether you're going to face the boss or explore the grounds. For the boss it will give you a handy restart point, and if you explore the grounds it will let you get back inside the castle quickly when you're ready. Gathering up the available Prayer Beads in the area before facing the boss is a good idea, especially if they'll give you enough for another Vitality and Posture increase. Our route will continue exploring the grounds of the castle first, so if you want to pick things up from the Antechamber, turn to P.294, or for information on the boss encounter, go to P.296.

![](images/2982f0043f91311357b25cb3cb7ec6823816d518d28983a262b7b39ef9e44765.jpg)

If you have previously explored beneath the surface of the lake here, and killed the Underwater Headless, then there will be no new items or threats and you can swim around without fear.

![](images/3b899bd341744c0249ea1d25d86e92aff0d4dd3d2836e14e03810614eab23631.jpg)

Swim along the castle wall and you can get close enough to jump up and grab the ledge below the enemies here undetected. These are the same enemies that were previously on the bridge over the lake, so if you didn't eavesdrop on them before to get the information for Anayama, you can do so now. When you're ready to take them out, shimmy to the right of the tree, and then pull yourself up so that you're behind both enemies; use a Backstab Deathblow on the Samurai General, and then cut down the soldier. You can go through the open door and face the Chained Ogre inside now that you're here, but you can get a much more advantageous start to the fight by approaching it from the balcony near the Upper Tower - Antechamber Idol.

![](images/ba88412095d65f616e67524db269846b5cd5fc7b38b3a2781bb8e4b7ae777667.jpg)

Take a moment to eavesdrop on the Shinobi Hunter when you reach this point. Even though the castle is under siege, all he cares about is how he can earn more coin. Sadly, his earning days are likely over, since you can sneak along the wall to get behind him and use a Backstab Deathblow. The nearby soldier won't get alerted, so you can then do the same to him.

![](images/7d46e48c5e012c4695350d8960f1c74c1db0bf64551d6912beea49a662f29337.jpg)

# Old Grave

In an attempt to bolster the defense of this area, new enemies have taken up positions to try to repel invaders. There are no new items to be found here, but you can get some extra information if you don't mind fighting your way to it. If you're thinking of going down to the Great Serpent Shrine Idol and

![](images/12a15fa091bc914625915657bb4b5192550c03883c771a03b191839d2dcbb819.jpg)

facing the sub-boss there, it's recommended that you commune with this Idol first, so that you have a relatively close restart point.

# Update: Prosthetic Tools

If you have never been to this area and spoken with Blackhat Badger before, you can drop down through the hole in the roof of the house below the Idol to find the Iron Fortress item, which can be used by the Sculptor to make the Loaded Umbrella.

![](images/132b0db03134bd259bff2f1e881ec6b4db9ab83d7071ec29559a881115a2a774.jpg)

You can tackle this section much like when you were originally here, but the additional Nightjar Ninja mean that you'll have to make a few tweaks to your approach. Run forward to here and jump onto the wall so that you can see the Nightjar Ninja standing on the roof that Blackhat Badger was hiding in. Lock onto the Nightjar and use the Finger Whistle to lure him towards you, and then drop down and grab the edge of the wall so he doesn't spot you as he closes in. Use a Ledge Hang Deathblow on him when he's close enough.

![](images/47e5887555c27977420f6f300ee4ef38abe16ba8217fd5ec33ebc3cfd6844e87.jpg)

![](images/193645b402f7412e8e53f348a090a26739a28df2c141f94008ff97b91ba0524a.jpg)

Head over to this part of the wall and use another Ledge Hang Deathblow on the Nightjar perched upon it.

![](images/c1ff58affb9be5e941035c75e30c3288f4d6a5731290873e256ae2a449510310.jpg)

![](images/60fe64c87f5b8afe09911ae259e5891776201d00f88b067d2d70681725c91319.jpg)

Grapple across to the house, and then jump over to the watchtower and Backstab Deathblow the Valley Clan member standing there.

![](images/7fca9877dcebdb144f0cc10af67455bc9dd2aadf782ed340b046030af8a1c7fd.jpg)

![](images/ea9fd49a4be59866b15168661b4a47f095c49fa5818b1f900e89baa1da366553.jpg)

Drop down onto the wall below the watchtower, and then jump down towards the branch below and grapple across to it. Once you're on the branch, jump up and grab the wall so that you can shimmy around to nearby ledge, where you'll find another Nightjar Ninja to Backstab.

![](images/7f07ddea1cf215746e752d45d046567cf3a3116145e56bdd033b1576fca9f45b.jpg)

![](images/65ddc4db95c3c1e35bb3ff5e8695d7cd296483ace3dcb06a1ea1e12f8c5e6425.jpg)

Jump over to the roof of the house next to the ledge—from the other side of it you'll be able to use a Plunging Deathblow on the Nightjar Ninja crouched near the broken bridge. Turn to face the house and you'll see an assassin clinging to the ledge beside it; after eavesdropping on him, use a Shuriken to knock him down, and then finish him off.

![](images/d78d01fa9d106304cb904c195f44efcae584799cda77c7a1e7ffa114bfb61841.jpg)

![](images/de77fc38f78403ac250fc8b9df024451752b950053e9ea7b494c2aebd5852701.jpg)

Run around to the corner here and use a wall jump so that you can grab the ledge above you. Shimmy along the ledge until you can go no further, and from there you can angle your camera to allow you to grapple straight up to the back of the watchtower; Backstab Deathblow the Valley Clan member standing on the platform there.

![](images/956793e37b271b3d4fe973cd9ceef59664c52d86de9b31e9ec45cac84f14eaa2.jpg)

![](images/eaec4f4028dcb4cf9c70bf9a17b736d2b80b30c2eeac28627f26a140ae7ca5b7.jpg)

Drop down from the watchtower and make your way around the outskirts of the area, so that you can get behind the Nightjar Ninja here and use a Backstab Deathblow on him.

![](images/68492b231d382267a7b0cefca4bc0bc8d1bd420267655ef82f1ddccc1c1b50d3.jpg)

![](images/ebd55bd7b4cdc2d5dcb1d620353b2187d49613bea831d8882cea5884aaf02bbd.jpg)

With the Valley Clan member out of the way you can freely move around here, so run back towards the ledge that previously had a Nightjar on it, and grapple up to the corner of the wall above. When you land you'll be behind another Nightjar, so use a Backstab Deathblow on him straight away. Before the soldiers below you can react, use a Plunging Deathblow on one, and then cut down the other.

![](images/224eafeae0d9d53c2c3facbd884cb162cc774e83625006111d449aaf0eb2e27c.jpg)

![](images/7452aa3e853eac59a7fad15be8749810fea0a438145aa7dc079f799a62b9f135.jpg)

Walk through the first doorway here, but don't go through the second one and out onto the bridge. Look up to the roof of the building beside the bridge and you'll see a Lone Shadow standing there. As soon as you step out, he'll drop down and start engaging the Ashina forces on the other end of the bridge. While you can go out there and take advantage of the chaos to fight them all, there is also a much cleaner approach you can take.

![](images/58b5425638a67750430c582f24a7ba9d32235c1f24d8226bc4a4dba942511124.jpg)

![](images/ec00d5be8e3f216818a9194cdfcf5136eb7aa0f7caaa7dbef28d609d0f9c56f6.jpg)

Go back around to where the Samurai General whom you could eavesdrop on was standing, and drop into the water there so that you don't trigger the ambush on the bridge. Now that you have the Mibu Breathing Technique you can dive beneath the surface, and then jump out of the water to gain a lot of extra height. From the right position in the water you can use that jump to get high enough to allow you to grapple up to the roof that the Lone Shadow is standing on.

The required position to reach the grapple point is fairly strict, so if you're having trouble with it and still want to deny the Lone Shadow his ambush, consider going up to the roof of the main castle overlooking the lake and use a sprint jump towards this building and grapple across mid jump. Once you're on the roof, use a Backstab Deathblow on the Lone Shadow, and then a Plunging Deathblow on the Samurai General below.

![](images/6fa00e57e52b3cd2be3376543cad3aa88fdc2e1f93a606ac47c98bbed2ff180f.jpg)

![](images/5b50be4900586d395f82e40800a85a2a37d89047ead36e083cd4d08ef0295376.jpg)

The keen senses of the Hounds in this area will normally mean that they'll detect you once you start getting close to the building, so have your Shuriken at the ready to take them all out quickly.

![](images/abb5127236da8527d8ba12e360b9bd4a7cdcf1c42b8218d5335f4c03be19dad6.jpg)

Crouch down as you pass through the first building so that Masanaga doesn't spot you, and then eavesdrop to find out about the personal vendetta he's looking to resolve during the raid. If you were to enter the building you would get spotted straight away, but if you sneak around to the opposite side of the building you can get behind Masanaga and start the fight with a Backstab Deathblow.

The cramped confines of the building can make the fight more difficult, so the first thing you should do is head back outside to one of the more open areas and fight him there. Masanaga has a lot of Poison-based attacks, so make sure you have items equipped that can remove or help prevent that status.

![](images/971c1f47394dd3c531d2e0ebe9d93264db53c968a0c61da3abb2ac125af1fc9e.jpg)

# Great Serpent Shrine

![](images/61514eb46b9fa9451e3453cc97558eeba33330da1a749c6715beb663f335e3a6.jpg)

After defeating Masanaga, use this Idol to travel to the Upper Tower - Antechamber Idol so that you can start clearing the castle interior.

![](images/a9486fc39666e36576b2477f1632400908ab27aac0305cfd16ea64a0f9c1d1af.jpg)

# Upper Tower - Antechamber

Interior Ministry forces have made it all the way to the castle interior, and much like outside, there will be plenty of opportunities to have the chaos of battle work in your favor if you choose. Many of the interior doors remain open, so be mindful of sightlines that enemies may now have that they did not the first time you were in this area.

![](images/9374658ea15b18e7d2a913de8116b9f60a4b4c6ec0a758c503005b056f5ee050.jpg)

The same Fencer is patrolling this hallway. As before, approach him from behind by going through the opening here and use a Backstab Deathblow on him.

![](images/0df3046597d495721fa800c30493d376b30b1afc920b3dfdcad3461296eb0f80.jpg)

There is no better time to deal with the Chained Ogre than now, so before clearing out the remaining enemies on this floor, jump over the railing and grapple onto the beam below. You'll now be able to see the Ogre restrained to a pillar beneath you, so hang from the edge of the beam and shimmy yourself along it until you're directly above the Ogre. When you're in position, release the beam and use a Plunging Deathblow to start the fight. This Ogre doesn't have red eyes like the previous one you faced, so you're going to need to rely on more conventional attacks.

Thankfully, it's possible to enlist some extra help for this battle. While the Ogre is recovering from the Deathblow, run over and open the door leading back out to the front of the castle. Get the attention of the Red Guard standing in the room beyond the door—run back into the main room and they will follow. The Ogre and the Red Guard will usually start attacking each other, allowing you to stand back while they damage him for you. If you need to heal, go through the doorway leading to the rear of the castle, because the Ogre is too big to fit through it, allowing you to heal in safety. Once it has been defeated, travel back to the Upper Tower – Antechamber Idol to continue.

![](images/0d49f807de2bf03e241870cbcc3bd9c07c6d6b04649ed543b25685d4f45ddf62.jpg)

![](images/35cd1ed8928accacde0dd56c410d6c3a4c13c3621cfcdc01dd5f53bcaf8f9bee.jpg)

The Lone Shadow here has his eye trained on the doorway ahead, so from this side you can sneak up to him and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/7db93f9ec743a671e627f318336e0e70c3e7e823f83e0fce1acc462db63f4762.jpg)

Because this door is open now, you can simply run up, use a Shuriken to kill the Old Maid, and then go into the room and use a Backstab Deathblow on one of the soldiers before chopping down the other.

![](images/d24f87dc2f5a1cab7c029020ff2e1f195e04af1b957ea628ed37cfbd8c1e0435.jpg)

If you want to deal with the enemies in the room where the Fencers were drinking tea, this is the best place to start from. Grapple up into the hole and follow the passage around until you come to the hole above that room. From there you can see that a Lone Shadow preparing an ambush just outside the room on the balcony; throw a Ceramic Shard down at him to give his position away and have the Fencers attack him. Now you can either let them fight amongst themselves and finish off whoever remains, or look for an opportunity to drop down for a Backstab Deathblow, followed by the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu.

![](images/c19affc695abbb7f96b73b92582a688b49028cff6fd6d7d7c2be6035935aa27f.jpg)

![](images/c97a1d7c973faef9007aef3ff47836e308c3ef6532be1a5cc7ff0916e7dba507.jpg)

You can reach the next sub-boss by going up the stairs here to the dojo area, but it's worth continuing around this floor to Isshin's watchtower, because you can obtain an interesting bit of lore there.

![](images/1498e30d4d62d38a5db8408a0a2108147d00e73971f81b6cbdde9e031b2649bf.jpg)

The position of the two enemies here hasn't changed, so you can still run and Backstab Deathblow the first one, before dealing with the second. If you have Divine Abduction, it also works on these enemies, so you can use it for a quick victory.

![](images/6963ab77f2675fb10d2fc4d2a3add4b128206c09505f3ec6691283b310e8d88e.jpg)

The enemy here is a Lone Shadow standing with its back to you, but when you try to sneak up behind him, a Nightjar Ninja will come running from the room ahead and attack him. The Lone Shadow is the more dangerous of the two enemies, so try to get behind him during the fight and use a Backstab Deathblow, and then finish off the Nightjar Ninja. There is a way to ensure that you kill the Lone Shadow without having to worry about trying to get behind him during the fight—before the ambush is sprung, hug the wall at the top of the stairs and use the Finger Whistle to lure him in for a Wall Hug Deathblow.

![](images/d6aaa0b72605c07a790fc8ca25a28f9ef47e6d51556286d8e145ae01eee48dc6.jpg)

![](images/e74e4d65bc720a9e2a165abf180b2cb44d6af3c79aa21415be95bf394614a397.jpg)

Isshin is still recovering in his watchtower, and this time he's joined by Emma. You can talk to both of them to get some additional information, and can give Emma any unused Gourd Seeds that you have. After talking to them, go out onto the balcony and pick up the Black Scroll, an important lore item that gives you some clues as to the power of the blade that Genichiro wields. While you're on the balcony you can hug the wall to eavesdrop on Isshin and Emma to find out even more about both of those things. Once you've heard everything, retrace your steps and head up to the dojo area.

![](images/f34d25449cab824999766b241b1ee956242af9a3893524518f47548fa8b073f5.jpg)

![](images/c45576d72b86a6af98e171dfaa0c8a5097473f26a86c189d040713a7f0df05c9.jpg)

# Upper tower - Ashina Dojo

As before, this Idol should serve as your restart point for any attempts at facing the boss of this area, so make sure you take the time to commune with it. Before you can jump

![](images/b1e5c4c35bcd7819668a8a99759573657c514f059cce06b0448c1b002beacd11.jpg)

out of the window and head up to face the boss, however, you'll first have to clear the如何去 invaders.

# Choose Your Fate

When you first meet up with the Owl in the lookout, he'll attempt to reason with you rather than fight, and will ask you a question. We'll detail the repercussions of your choice here so that you can make an informed decision, so expect spoilers!

![](images/04105d66fd2456a54ea3440595360fb4706623a4d1c1f49b4eecf23d0b0a1621.jpg)

# Obey the Iron Code

If you choose to obey the iron code and side with the Owl, you will become locked onto a path that leads only to the Shura ending, and you'll immediately have to face Emma, the Gentle Blade and Isshin Ashina, one after the other.

![](images/ffc59b6ac71970411d83f05c53f2105d4e434d2a23ddc3eb29e67e4cbc2dd9f2.jpg)

These are tough battles, so it's best to prepare in advance. Head to P.481 for a full breakdown of these opponents. Once both bosses have been defeated you will acquire a Memory of the battle, and the text that unlocks the One Mind Skill that Isshin himself was using during the fight. Attaining this ending is the only means of acquiring that skill.

![](images/6449f273dd582dd0edf91022682519aa90f34fb307168efce0514d8af55e98d1.jpg)

# New Game+

After the credits you will have the option of moving straight to a second playthrough, or to reappear at the Dilapidated Temple and continue your current one. If you have any unfinished business or sub-bosses to kill in your current game, then you should decline the option to start the next playthrough and finish all of them up first. Many of your items, Skills and attributes will carry over to your next playthrough, so you should do as much as you can before moving on. You can start your second playthrough at any time from the menu at the Idol in the Dilapidated Temple.

![](images/034c41b157b306c2ddadc3db6c657943b0e4a9549a4f293d3cd2e98a21d805b2.jpg)

![](images/4c20a6afbe1395f1f53c4332a18a33480fd982553e89f8cd31a0d69314747ba0.jpg)

# Break the Iron Code

Choose to go against your father and you'll have to face him in combat, after which you'll be able to continue on towards any of the other three endings. The Owl may be aging, be he's not to be underestimated. Check out P.464 for full details on the battle. Because taking the Shura route will essentially bring the game to an end before you get to see the remaining areas, it's recommended that you save that ending for a subsequent playthrough and choose to stay loyal to Lord Kuro on your first playthrough.

![](images/72fad36ee9bda3e4e68a5e65abd6882506cf3f6e0786b397c4f034c6bc8109d6.jpg)

It turns out that the rumors about someone having stolen a branch from the everblossom tree were true, and it was none other than the Owl. Thankfully, he still had the Aromatic Branch in his possession when you defeated him, so you now have the final ingredient that was required for reconstructing the fountainhead aroma.

# Ending Update: Purification

Emma will again be standing just outside the lookout doorway, and if you've been keeping up with her quest, she will have some new information for you. Speak with her and she'll hand over Tomoe's Note, which details the required ingredients for a special purification ritual. One of them is the flower from an everblossom branch, but unfortunately the one you just obtained does not have any such flowers. It does, however, give Emma an idea about where one might be found. To continue the investigation, travel to the Old Grave Idol in Ashina Castle and speak with her at the gravesite.

Although nothing is gleaned at the gravesite, she thinks that the Sculptor may have an idea, so travel to the Dilapidated Temple and speak to her there. Emma is unusually dismissive when you talk to her, and the Sculptor merely informs you how drafty the old temple is. The main source of the draft is the large hole in the back wall, so walk around the outside of the temple until you reach it, then eavesdrop on their continuing conversation.

After hearing the news, it's easy to see why Emma was hesitant to say anything, but now that you know, you can confront her to find out what she is hiding. Emma will then hand over the Father's Bell Charm that she found on the Owl's body. As long as you have defeated Lady Butterfly in Hirata Estate, you can make an offering of this charm at the Buddha statue to access Hirata Estate (Revelations), where the investigation will continue.

![](images/9c62be285923341e155bb94cb27e006fadb5d0a9e638c3326ee368370adfba64.jpg)

No matter which of the two enemies in this room you attack first, the other will always detect you immediately after, so how you handle this fight will depend on which aspect you find more difficult. If you use a Gachiin's Sugar you can enter the room and get close enough to the Lone Shadow Vilehand to use a Backstab Deathblow on him, and while that does remove one of his Deathblow markers, it will also mean that you'll have to fight both enemies at the same time.

Alternatively, crouch down and quietly enter the room, then follow the wall around to the left to get behind the white hood Lone Shadow and use a Backstab Deathblow to finish him off for good. Taking this option will let you use a Ninjutsu Technique on him to empower yourself for the fight against the sub-boss. Puppeteer is not a bad option, but the results can be unpredictable; a much better option is Bestowal. The increased damage you can deal with that skill will make fighting the sub-boss significantly easier for its duration.

![](images/8e42cc221f0fec770848cbd330e7c81a3d59c0b23c2797d39d72bf7bc242dd06.jpg)

Once you've made all of your preparations, jump out of the window here and make your way up to the lookout to confront the Owl.

![](images/1b042f238d399556ae056685d30d2edee07e500d41d9d6c6e8cc5dd9dfdad55e.jpg)

If you follow your father's wishes, Emma will sense the Shura spirit building within you and step in to try stop you—Owl will leave it to you to defeat her. After Emma, you'll move straight onto fighting Isshin Ashina if you choose this path, so it's important to conserve your healing items and Spirit Emblems; play smart and conservative and try to avoid taking unnecessary risks. To that end, the Loaded Umbrella can be a very useful tool during these fights, because it will allow you to fully guard all attacks from both enemies, even those that would pierce your normal guard. During the fight with Isshin there will be fire on the floor, but it does not harm you so there's no need to try to avoid it. To find out how to counter Emma's skilled swordsmanship, turn to P.481, and to learn all of Isshin's tricks, turn to P.485.

The Owl does not take rejection lightly, and if you choose to remain loyal to Lord Kuro, you will have to fight him. As his name suggests, he is indeed a great shinobi, and as such he employs many of his own unique tools, and has ways to counter your attacks that other enemies do not. Using thrusts on him is all but pointless, due to the fact that he has a similar technique to the Mikiri Counter, and will use it if you give him the opportunity. Fire works well against him, so bringing some Oil and the Flame Vent into the fight will help you considerably. After you remove his first Deathblow Marker he will attempt to feign defeat only to spring a trap when you get close; quickly move away to avoid getting blinded in the smoke. If you want to find out about what other underhanded abilities the Owl can use, turn to P.464.

![](images/30a35fab6c55915f4d8ac1d3143b764b84f740d3fce20811e5ace14584d7efa7.jpg)

![](images/5f297bdd84410841adc3a089e8a71f1eaaff8b68f4dc7684cc4ea306d631894c.jpg)

Just like when you defeated Genichiro, this Idol will become available again after you attain victory.

![](images/adcc14887268721008e1a5fa1fd25a3175fb6b930ec9bf7059fd7de19d341df1.jpg)

# Update: Story Quests

Continue talking with Lord Kuro, and when prompted, place all of the ingredients in the incense burner to infuse your clothes with the fountainhead aroma. The clues seem to indicate that if you now return to the Wedding Cave in Ashina Depths, the sweet aroma will help you reach Fountainhead Palace. Once you're in the cave, enter the palanquin and your destination will be reached.

# Hirata Estate (Revelation)

The Father's Bell brings the Wolf back into the past once more, back to that same fateful night at the Hirata Estate. Events do not unfold in quite the same way this time, but the truth behind the mystery of the everblossom may finally be revealed.
