![](images/900b7d80315427e54c5ae4b3a20465b73ca3175b1b7425cbaca0c6dcc6fe6c8e.jpg)

# Area Update

The version of Hirata Estate that the Buddha has chosen to show you this time has many similarities to the previous version, but there are a few key differences to be aware of. You start on the path just outside of the estate grounds, and everything before that point in the area is exactly the same as it was before. If you have already picked up every item, then there is no need to retreat that ground. As you head into the estate grounds, however, nothing is as it was, and many new challenges await you.

# ①

The silhouetted outline of Lone Shadow Masanaga the Spear-Bearer will be the first thing you see as you enter the estate ground. Even though he may appear to be distracted, he will detect you the instant you walk through the gate. If you don't want to fight him (or just want to get straight to the Main Hall Idol), grapple up to the branch to the left as soon as you enter the area, and from there go to the top of the watchtower. Masanaga will never drop out of alert status while you're here, but you are totally safe and can either drop down to the street below and continue, or just use the time to heal up if needed. The branch you used to reach the watchtower may appear safe, but Masanaga can throw kunai that will hit you there, so it's best to also go to the watchtower roof when you're trying to recover.

By using a secret whistling technique, Masanaga can summon Hounds into the area that will fight alongside him, so any time you hear him whistle, pay attention to your surroundings and try to locate the hounds as soon as possible. Dealing with the hounds efficiently is one of the most important factors during this fight, because while individually their attacks don't do a lot of damage, if you get hit by one, you'll often get hit by the rest, or even Masanaga. Shuriken can be very effective against the hounds, and have the benefit of not requiring you to get close. An alternate approach, however, is to use Firecrackers to stun them, and then circle behind one to land a Backstab Deathblow into a Bestowal Ninjutsu. The extra damage from the Ninjutsu will make fighting Masanaga significantly easier.

![](images/bee02690dd009e3c326045fbfeb962dbce399a90f8a530facda7426bb09d08ca.jpg)

![](images/f31627ee9b3abc53dc1d63b4ce5308cbb46e28f614028609199183fb26635f9f.jpg)

There is no approach from this side that will let you get the drop on the enemies on the street here, but with some expert tool usage you can still turn it into a manageable situation. Your first targets should be the two archers, so either use Shuriken to take them out from distance, or close in quickly and use normal attacks. Divine Abduction will make short work of the two Taro Troops if you have enough Spirit Emblems; if you don't, try to lure them one at a time to where you fought Masanaga, so that you don't have to contend with both at the same time on the narrow street.

![](images/80d2b8feedfab035fcd788ba83bfe9ef81aad9c2e8d0ce24cb67d2ea2a13c51e.jpg)

![](images/c430dfc5a504678cf440364a43970e8273ec47931daa218b1167f32d538b7937.jpg)

# Hirata Estate - Main Hall

After the tough couple of opening engagements, you can finally re-supply at this Idol. After resting, you'll also be behind a lot of the enemies you just fought your way past, which means you can easily sneak up on them for some Backstab Deathblows and a lot of easy Skill EXP.

![](images/6b084256ba62cea24e21cd8f280ad0308448cf03ad9e953ef643a9e27d1dc361.jpg)

The newly-exposed opening here will allow you to cut straight through the building, rather than going around it and fighting the enemies there.

![](images/e5a06170a9b3aba4f9b54a72083c9fd1715d9af9c9fbe89b35b951d6efe4faa3.jpg)

![](images/45261d99ee1d30276d03e642eeecb61eed72469280ac392ba5a3d8029570dff5.jpg)

Approach the Bandit archer and use a Backstab Deathblow on him, since he's facing the other way. Continue down the path slowly, and try to angle the camera so that you can see around the corner to keep an eye on the patrolling Taro Troop. Keep your distance, and then when you see him start to walk away from you, sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/cbd02acae1a7c7f9282b0d26140a094cc28ef3c54d2e1972b39f80585aa7440b.jpg)

![](images/5c8fca5bb93ae0c71b6c66f28a31b8458b62fad610128830d8fb62c0fab5390c.jpg)

While it would be simple enough to run towards the group of Bandits ahead and take them on, doing so causes the Lone Shadows up on the rooftops to spot you and join in the fight, making it considerably more dangerous. With a single Gachiin's Sugar, however, you can make fighting even the Lone Shadows relatively simple. Consume the sugar here, and then crouch down and follow the walls of the buildings around until you can access the crawlspace beneath the walkway—follow that along to sneak past the enemies undetected.

![](images/6e7022b9a1748222bc36b141fb4c63853848552f92c6c7fbc6cc709dc7f038b1.jpg)

![](images/8c4317f647116291ab50c5bd79f9cf3baac99d91e861513077d79057b13e72fa.jpg)

# Item Legend

1 Fulminated Mercury x1  
2 Mibu Balloon of Wealth x2  
3 Adamantite Scrap x1  
4 Light Coin Purse x1  
5 Ashina Sake x1  
6 Fistful of Ash x1  
7 Adamantite Scrap x1  
8 Gokan's Sugar x2

![](images/1555f1e345f4b75138fe1ece8ed6c07081d24365b8bc2ed9a4542c1848bc5aa4.jpg)  
Hirata Estate (Revelation)

![](images/2d6ce5c92804b410e6f10d2929214b08a76261fde4c9ae15fc33296b7d29c402.jpg)

Once you reach this point, exit the crawlspace and go onto the walkway here. You'll find a protruding section of wall that you can wall jump off to be able to grab the edge of the roof above. Don't pull yourself up, because there is a patrolling Lone Shadow up above; lock onto him and throw a Ceramic Shard at him to lure him to the edge for a Ledge Hang Deathblow. The two remaining Lone Shadows further along the roof are too close to each other for the second one not to hear it if you Backstab Deathblow the first. Instead, lock onto the first one while you're still hanging from the ledge, and then use the Finger Whistle to lure him in for a Ledge Hang Deathblow. Then you can pull yourself up and Backstab Deathblow the remaining Lone Shadow before jumping down and taking on the Bandits.

![](images/f8fa940359b6117a7f430a39dc1d6104c9b5e51a4b202e348b341de1f5f95ec6.jpg)

![](images/740bcd50af14d90ce68914265d2ce0599e9550567ea3339d47ed775db38977ce.jpg)

Juzou the Drunkard is back for a rematch, and this time he has some slightly stronger friends with him as back-up. Eavesdrop on the pair from here, but don't approach them directly because now more than ever it's important to take out the surrounding enemies first.

![](images/acd6f788714fb00d3ec480271fc3fe52cfb7bc7c9d17fa22e910a1a8bacbdb47.jpg)

From here you'll be able to spot the Bandit on the walkway outside of the building ahead; crouch down and take a wide approach around him so that you can get close enough for a Backstab Death-blow.

![](images/b33df6f418ab8378bf42f481b28841d3591624a3237a7a7623db0c173f4ee3bc.jpg)

![](images/000a2174595b1d00f90a92928ae8d4dceb65f44ab1dc8d224b3a0965ef4551d4.jpg)

There are four more Bandits inside the house, and since you should be trying to conserve emblems for the fight with Juzou, you'll need to take them out in a more conventional manner. Quickly enter the building and Backstab Deathblow one of the ones sitting down to reduce their numbers slightly, before killing he rest in open combat.

![](images/f6b1b665fe6d98d4c775c87c38d4824e9c723b13baf2fede83b9fc88c5120d78.jpg)

![](images/2ffb23ef431f165aa63e2009d773aff364168b51dd2ceaf2c798455dfe978474.jpg)

The best thing that you can do to make the fight against Juzou easier is to remove the Lone Shadow, and you can do just that from here. Drop down out of the building and crouch behind the rock so that the archer doesn't spot you. Position yourself so that you can lock onto the Lone Shadow, and then use the Finger Whistle. As soon as you do that, quickly go back inside the building and hug the wall so that you can watch him approach. Once he's far enough away form Juzou, throw a Ceramic Shard at him to bring him over to the wall for a Wall Hug Deathblow.

![](images/c4a07364d147cf9dd9f1277bf55a64baec7382953511e3c1d1624b006af945dc.jpg)

![](images/b13ddea4fa545970b3faf3a773305215a40926f1af21901897fef45d410af2c2.jpg)

Juzou will become alerted to your presence as soon as you kill the Lone Shadow and will start making his way towards you to investigate; while he is closing in on the house, sneak along the walkway to this area. If you're fast and sneaky enough juzou will not catch sight of you and will drop out of alert.

Backstab Deathblow the still unaware Bandit archer near here, and then run over and take out the final archer on the other side of the courtyard. Juzou will start going along the walkway that you used and eventually return to his start position; make sure you stay hidden by going down to the pond area, and then circling back around to the house where you killed the Bandit group.

![](images/a85f377528a187bca12f51ca82c71c28962b754ffbea200b00b4dcdbe4093ad3.jpg)  
Juzou the Drunkard  
Shura Samurai P409

![](images/8ce366d52cc1f1fb45aedfddb59c57f5c41ac2eb49880c0f1ad8b42932981b17.jpg)  
Hirata Estate (Revelation)

![](images/b2c0552ad0d6db2526235be7d3888218304680a8617b87c169b10abfc14e4d52.jpg)  
Owl (Father)  
Hirata Estate - Hidden Temple

Hirata Audience Chamber

It's now time to face Juzou himself, and since he has his back to you, and there's no Lone Shadow looking in this direction, you can sneak up behind him and start the fight with a Backstab Deathblow. As in the previous encounter with Juzou, he has a lot of Poison-based attacks, so you may want to have some Antidotes among your quick items. Fistfuls of Ash and Firecrackers can also be very effective for stunning him so that you can get behind him and get some hits in before he recovers.

Juzou likes to drink from his sake gourd and use the Sake Spit attack if you keep your distance—you can use that to your advantage and close in quickly when you see this begin, and use your own slower Combat Arts or tools. Ichimonji can be very effective with this strategy, especially if you use the Flame Vent to Burn him and impede his Posture recovery first.

![](images/83c9330fd2a7a29bf21af27367529bab58e38c5e822664d497a16393b09fbbf0.jpg)

![](images/91433403960bda1d102990ad4ae88613e9c1ecbc44e8f98407ee34952f062450.jpg)

The Shinobi Hunter patrolling this hallway is significantly more dangerous than the Bandits that were here last time, but if you hug the corner of the wall here, you can wait for him to walk away, and then just sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on him.

![](images/b27304e71dc4586366e70d84e90e3212851586db00d9b0b32f39f97e5715a61f.jpg)

![](images/b56f9337f4ea69301d77640b17d1468f36c4f025ef31366a50f6bbdacfd44943.jpg)

If you have some Spirit Emblems left, stand in the doorway and use Shuriken to take out the two Bandits in the room ahead, which will allow you to take out the other Shinobi Hunter without interference.

![](images/167632cfa10a91e540f1d1d2219a4e92d05190f0dec0272cd9d1c8f176b47b4d.jpg)

![](images/afeb91a8ee5d26ea11fa7b9249f9903b2f841c8f748c4f7fcd6d14c0f76172f5.jpg)

# Hirata Audience Chamber

One of the toughest boss battles that you'll have to overcome awaits you in the hidden temple, so use this Idol to make any preparations that you can—you're going to need every ounce of strength you can muster.

![](images/141d8c27bb96873ad20872600561258947306822f3c3ee757b406acc63f983a5.jpg)

![](images/a690dab1a40271faa50341172ddd2e05f1533736e90556250e1b86ecf7087d3b.jpg)

When you last faced your father he was but a mere shadow of his former self; now you must face him in his prime. As with the previous encounter, avoid using thrusts unless you're sure he's recovering from an attack or else he will Mikiri Counter it. Make sure he's fully committed to using attacks such as his slow overhead slam, because if you dodge too early, he'll cancel it and counter you with a slash. Pay close attention when he uses his gunpowder flash because he'll often follow that up with a Shadowfall; watch for the danger symbol, and if you see it, use a Mikiri Counter.

During the second phase of the fight he will summon a spectral owl and use vastly different attacks. Occasionally he'll disappear during this phase, but if you watch the movement of the spectral owl you can see where he'll reappear, allowing you to get into position to deflect his ambush attack. He has many, many other tricks up his sleeve, so if you want a more comprehensive overview, turn to P.468.

![](images/29001f583cdd1a2e07871869a666744118d68e99597d8f9c5b4cb8dcdb7f493b.jpg)

![](images/761fe80d407d8462bdfb14e214afb6c723ecc469c4661d34cf293fb3e27e0262.jpg)

# Hirata Estate - Hidden Temple

![](images/298884b8e3ae7e074c3a272ae28688d428f07420442e3034cb19498bf6037df8.jpg)

This Idol will appear in the temple once you have defeated the Owl for the last time, which saves having to run all the way back to the previous Idol after what may have been a closely contested battle.

# Ending Update: Purification

The Aromatic Flower that you received for defeating the Owl is the key item you require to attain this ending, so return to Emma in the Dilapidated Temple to let her know that you've secured it. While you're there you can go around to the back of the building and eavesdrop on her and the Sculptor again for some additional dialogue. There are no other specific preparations to make for this ending.

![](images/bba1f73f6b86b443e012234cf0a82340a5cc07a665f3757045bdd7a840b80833.jpg)

The Wolf finally reaches the source of the fountainhead waters where the fabled Divine Dragon is said to reside. The waters here have a long history of enticing people with the prospect of immortality, but the promise may not be what it seems.

![](images/2a7101a236ab96910aa11672924346b223330477872432053f8780fa1914e3e7.jpg)

![](images/630a99c608d67d774bf61bc7ed129e6357452bc1e250983366d7f2e60f10b850.jpg)

Time of day will advance to night upon setting foot in this area, so be mindful of the enemy stat increase when traveling to other areas. To continue, run down the large rope towards the cliff; as long as you don't jump or sprint you won't fall off.

![](images/7853faf592e5a395d366a712dbbc56012b5ac5634c40c87d02436cd210007b92.jpg)

![](images/d57e209e14334b5f97f46688bdd04723c6c1b00118c53964cf80990fd418808f.jpg)

# Fountainhead Palace

Be sure to rest at the idol as soon as you reach this area, because if you go through the nearby gate and start to cross the picturesque bridge, an extremely angry and vengeful Corrupted Monk will drop down looking for a fight.

# Ending Update: Return

Successfully recreating the fountainhead aroma was the condition for causing the doors of the Inner Sanctum to open once again. If you haven't already been back there, return and speak to the Divine Child to learn about what has transpired since the last time you met. At the end of the conversation she'll give you the Frozen Tears, which is the key item required to attain this ending. With it, you can play through the remainder of the game until you have to make the final choice. The Divine Child can also make an improved version of Rice called Fine Snow now, so make sure to visit her any time you need some.

# Boss Battle

# Corrupted Monk

7665

2520

![](images/25ad5072c3caf0c2725201f1f9a19347dc4e3c0e4a3a26ad38a83277bd914e21.jpg)

While you have bested her illusory form in Ashina Depths, in her true form the Corrupted Monk is significantly more dangerous. The first thing you'll notice upon walking onto the bridge is that there are trees that you can grapple onto—the tree at Position A is especially important. The branch there gives you a vantage point to land a deathblow when she summons her clones during Phase 2.

When she first appears she's vulnerable for a few seconds, so quickly get some hits in. The first phase of the fight is similar to when you fought her illusory form—remember to take advantage of her long recovery time to land powerful Combat Arts.

After removing her first Deathblow Marker, she'll vanish and the area will fill with mist, then illusory versions of her will appear out of thin air to attack you; use that tree branch to cause her to reappear at the center of the bridge and take her out with a plunging deathblow from above. During the third phase of the battle she'll gain a lot of new attacks, including some that inflict Terror buildup, so make sure to have some Pacifying Agent equipped to your Quick Items. For more tactics, turn to P.461.

![](images/aa2d0cfa15d771feeec72575f44b02d6980a1f388a85d30c70161a7159748380.jpg)

# Update: Merchants

The Dragon Tally Board that you acquire when you defeat the Corrupted Monk will expand the inventories of every merchant to include an extra set of consumable items. Among them are highly-coveted items like Divine Confetti and Snap Seeds, so make sure you stock up on them now that they're available.

![](images/b10b71cab97fce781d837fc5e39d2746bbacea602fc3440ee7b31669bb53da15.jpg)

# Vermillion Bridge

Few have bested the Corrupted Monk and made it to the other side of the picturesque bridge, so savor your victory by communing with this Idol and preparing for the trip down into the palace. You'll be facing a lot of Okami Warriors down there, so you may want to have Sabimaru equipped to take advantage of its Poison against them.

![](images/b9b97880e3839b65de9eb773b7a63cd01b23c31f621fa684f297629a9137f24f.jpg)

Walk towards the edge of the cliff just past the Idol; you'll be able to see the entire palace grounds, set around the edges of a massive lake that feeds into a giant waterfall. Your goal is to reach the other side of the lake, but there are many steps you must take first. Look along the cliff to the right and you'll find a pair of grapple points that you can use to begin your descent. Once you land on the second platform, jump down to reach the ground below.

![](images/2f7f053a948fd5045816b406a509b36a3987c8941045627434c045497c08b162.jpg)

![](images/3e1e6e2f757b64777cfe11dba67b8b57c18d7debf1fb7fd37d769bc5821cbbfe.jpg)

Knowing that you need to reach the other side of the lake, your first instinct will be to just dive in and start swimming across, but things are never as simple as they appear. Standing atop the Great Sahara Tree on the opposite side of the lake is Okami Leader Shizu, and any time you enter deep water, she'll fire an extremely damaging and difficult-to-avoid lightning shot at you. Until you've defeated her, it's best to stick to the shallows.

![](images/d1d3c9b2a76b8ead63204aa54daaeb56f148452aad581d095a1fa91e902124b3.jpg)

![](images/3aa778c73cce44fb57eda3cc106478d028b389d6810d940a385cc2af055215ed.jpg)

The path leading along the edge of the waterfall from here will allow to avoid a significant number of enemies in the area. You'll still be detected by a few as you sprint past them, but you can get far enough and break line of sight and not engage in direct combat. When you reach the corner at the opposite end of the waterfall you'll only have to best a few Palace Hounds to be able to reach the next Idol. By taking that route, however, you will be missing out on a lot of Skill EXP and items.

![](images/95aec6fbee45c0d6ddf16adeb747f1e91a544f940191283bc7a584fddd557651.jpg)

From within this building you'll hear the same mysterious fluteplaying that you first encountered with the Mist Noble of Ashina Depths—while the creatures playing the music are similar, its effects are quite different. As soon as a Palace Noble spots you, they will start using their enchanted flute to literally sap the life out of your body, eventually leading to you becoming Enfeebled once the status abnormality fully takes hold.

![](images/fba91143aed33254a4183e8a2b20cd02753249b2a854a4a5fefef06d0f9bd641.jpg)

Your actions and mobility are severely impaired while you're under the effect of this status, and since there is no consumable to reverse it, your only option is to either wait it out, or try to kill a noble and recover your life essence. Getting afflicted by this status will often lead to death, so although the nobles are frail (you can likely kill them in a single basic attack if you've been upgrading your attack power), you should not underestimate how dangerous they can be. Use the folding screen or side of the building for cover as you approach, because there's a noble patrolling back and forth inside; wait for it to start moving away, and then close in for a Deathblow.

![](images/85d2bdfc986b1f08ea742d4085176759421e9a26533bb329550c87fe796f4a2a.jpg)

Continue through the room towards the small bridge on the opposite side, and crouch down once you reach it. In the next room there are two more nobles: one to the left in plain sight, and one behind a screen to the right. From this position the one to the left has its back to you, so sneak up on it and use a Backstab Deathblow. The second one is facing towards the middle of the room behind the screen, so if you sneak through the small gap between the screen and the wall you can get behind it for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/50732e64d31aa8bebbd2d24c27a9e652630f71ec3f89829b6c2f3ad495f1c38d.jpg)

The gap between the two shallow sections of water here is just small enough that you can make it across with a sprint jump to get the item on the other side. It can be quite risky, because if you jump too early, you'll end up in the lake and have to contend with the incoming lightning. If you're in doubt, wait until later to get this item.

![](images/85214ae4b1d7809a08b370a226b7149eb9e02ddb51d161952c97a637b9f04a34.jpg)

There are six Okami Warriors along with a Palace Noble in and around this building, and only a carefully orchestrated plan will prevent you from getting into open combat with all of them. Two warriors patrol back and forth outside the building on the waterfall side, with three more stationed up on the roof, providing cover from above. The final one is standing on the middle roof tier, around the corner on the far side of the building; if you attempt to run along the middle tier of the roof she'll emerge to ambush you.

Start your assault by grappling up to this rooftop, and then to the roof of the main building. Crouch down when you're on the roof if you walk along the crest of it, you can sneak up on both warriors facing the waterfall and use Backstab Deathblows on them. Once they're down, go over to the other side of the roof and do the same to the warrior facing the lake.

![](images/e11b77288b34080f68589875bdd9013f9ceced239df935a2de87ff6239fbdf23.jpg)

Use a ledge hang from the upper roof here, so that you can drop down and grab onto the middle tier below you. You'll be behind the warrior on this level when you land, so use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/a6aad28b19b6b84590fe58133ac9687de792004d534b252520c7b5c9266b33bb.jpg)

![](images/9f5a532d348243b0bc18bc290ad86ad4c91532e5d89c9004c1a412f0d7869d60.jpg)

Continue around the roof and you'll be able to grapple across to the tree branch here. From this position you can watch the two warriors patrolling along the area below; wait for them to start walking in different directions, and then drop down from the tree and Backstab Deathblow them, one after the other. Only the noble remains now, so run inside the building and finish it off quickly so that you can get the item it was watching over.

![](images/cef7bc68726d82a6ede26d08516ebb138dc3747d02fb9e564bca8e8bc48be6ff.jpg)

Now you can face the warrior on the bridge here without worrying about the archers on the roof of the building. Have Sabimaru at the ready, and then close in quickly to hit her with it before she can mount an offense. The ensuing stun from the Poison will give you enough time to finish her off.

![](images/34236469f80b733fad817755d03c2c1262a30d0029b1d110e232ae23f39deddf.jpg)

A group of Palace Hounds patrol the flooded courtyard ahead of the wall here; they can use a powerful, long-range lightning bolt, making them a serious threat. Taking these enemies out as soon as possible is the key to victory. From your position on the wall, use Shuriken to kill off the entire group below.

![](images/17de27ec25a3141355dcd5cfdb435b5990bfd10e31f0d74f724868dfeb9daf5b.jpg)

Wait just outside the building here until you see the patrolling hound come into view, and then use Shuriken to kill all three hounds before running around the corner and cutting down the noble.

![](images/6ac68406bd8beca11939c74fb596264b9472580edb01604e58959894a5a23634.jpg)

Grapple up to the tree near the buildings in the courtyard, and then jump from the branch onto the rooftop here. Move towards the rooftop of the adjacent building while crouched, because there are two more Okami Warriors positioned there. Go over the peak of the roof and use a Backstab Deathblow on that warrior first, since she has her back to you. The other warrior from around the corner will come to investigate, so move back slightly and drop down behind her so that you can Backstab Deathblow her as well.

![](images/e2d8d389b8e0608de54d40fb39d003dec41c7d9fde3bdd99dd3ae212e29e7e1e.jpg)

![](images/0530f78d459d65ea821489023ed8e4e945624da4deada03c2491151030108c30.jpg)

The corner of the rooftop here will provide an excellent position from which to Shuriken the group of hounds near the item below.

![](images/f15206a955cfb7fc19a746a5546b63bd503be78c4a9b8adfc0dbc76d7a6695ba.jpg)

Move to this corner now, so that you can Shuriken the two hounds near the tree. Two more hounds will emerge from within the building you're standing on to investigate—give them a taste of your Shuriken. With the courtyard now clear, you can collect the items in safety before heading to the nearby Idol to replenish your supplies.

![](images/fb848afe61f57ad85ad5363844ac356efc8fd899c8466a6a8f86c09bc1896bf8.jpg)

![](images/0f7c96b5919a0ca42b9826869f1abd4344e7bc0b11a44f179d932208c565f512.jpg)

# Mibu Manor

The manor grounds are where most of the Palace Nobility reside; you'll need to keep your ears peeled for the sounds of their flutes and always be on the lookout for them if you don't want to be reduced to a frail, walking stick-wielding former shinobi.

# 4

A Palace Noble patrols the hallway around the corner here, but if you hug the wall and wait, it will eventually get close enough for you to use a Wall Hug Deathblow. The side of the hallway is exposed to a part of the manor where another noble is standing, looking straight into the hallway. You can crouch down and use the low wall for cover to sneak past undetected, but a better option is to use a couple of Shuriken to finish the noble off quickly, so that you don't have to worry about it later.

![](images/818bba9ab0b5e8c27f43524733fa835129dcfbf3c54b01d392fea4e7707879c5.jpg)

# 5

Many nobles have a direct line of sight into this building; hitting any of them with Shuriken is unreliable due to the railings on the bridges they stand on. Your best option is to use the screens in the middle of the room here for cover and sneak past them for now.

# 6

Stay close to the side of the building while you approach the opening here, because there's a noble on the bridge ahead that alternates between looking into the building, and facing away. Wait for it to be facing away, and then close in for a Backstab Deathblow.

# 7

Make your way around to this point, but remain crouched while doing so to ensure that you're not spotted by the meditating warrior in the building as you walk past. There's another noble in a hallway looking directly at that warrior, so getting into open combat with it is ill-advised. Once you're in this hallway you can sneak around behind the warrior for a Backstab Deathblow. As soon as she's down, use Shuriken to kill the noble.

![](images/f0565bcb535a432daedaaddcff7a066b87e93f5253140b62ef185c45fb8cdb86.jpg)

When you reach this point, a pair of Okami Warriors and a Palace Noble will start walking towards you along the hallway ahead—quickly grapple up to the hole in the ceiling so that they don't spot you. Wait for them to walk past the hole, and then drop down and hug the corner of the wall. Use the Finger Whistle from there to lure one of the warriors to you for a Wall Hug Deathblow. If you try to follow the remaining enemies there's a good chance that an Okami Warrior on the roof of the adjacent building will spot you, so instead, grapple back up to the hole in the ceiling.

![](images/296b8d660809d007af6f12857794218a88348b81adc2595906305304084643f9.jpg)

![](images/26aed530b7487fd55ed212cdc90721ee153c86841be071823e2bf64025d85efd.jpg)

Move along the attic until you're near this hole, and when you see the patrolling enemies walk past, drop down behind them and use a Backstab Deathblow on the remaining warrior before cutting down the noble.

![](images/bec6d5afc9ed85f169222f3b2a159a152875a8bdea920c1f32d67a49b755d094.jpg)

When the patrolling enemies are out of the way, follow the hallway around to here and proceed into the room and take out the noble in the middle. You can also use Shuriken to pick off the noble on the bridge in the middle of the courtyard by moving to the side of the room to get a good angle.

![](images/1d289496cf886d424ead2fb0c09bbc5280cd79994d3ae8c9f0e2ed500d4df25d.jpg)

![](images/746ef2e8eeafa1fd664a4830ede525928ced3bb2966e1baa298d3417585ee09e.jpg)

The noble directly ahead of you this point presents itself as a prime target for a Backstab Deathblow, but if you attempt to do that, one of the Okami Warriors in the building next to it will become alerted and emerge to attack you. Use Shuriken to kill the noble from here, however, and you can avoid that situation.

![](images/2e16dcb48bcf9a14faf42b66ddc503780f4c3edc430b8bd7475c03db72ab8366.jpg)

When you get near the building you'll have a good enough angle to use Shuriken to take out the noble on the other bridge in the middle of the courtyard.

![](images/d282cbf364b631c81c0c1dfe2ce148fa1714ca47610b347ff6a46b63da08e1ca.jpg)

The enemies in this room are positioned in such a way that makes it difficult to pick them off one at a time, so speed is your best option here. If you enter the room quickly, you can use Sabimaru to stun the warrior that's sitting down to the left, and then finish her off before the other warrior closes in. The noble in this room is a red-robed one that poses little threat, so focus on taking out the other warrior first. When they're both dead, kill the noble.

![](images/31899dce1247d3888690be6cbdd9b03859c3d627732b6dd5c82a85c8d348a915.jpg)

![](images/895359c7cc146c627cd94beed6ad93f47fe536c0f9c8076868f59c8398e70b2e.jpg)

The Okami Warrior around the corner from here is significantly more dangerous than the warriors you've previously encountered, especially with the threat of the two nearby Palace Nobles. If you walk past this point, the warrior will spot you and you'll have to contend with all three enemies at once. The warriors are still weak to the Blue Rust Poison of Sabimaru (although it will take a full combo to inflict it), so if you fight her, make sure to use it.

To pick her off stealthily, hug the corner of the wall here, so that you can lock onto the warrior and use the Finger Whistle to lure her towards you. When you see her start to move, leave the wall and go back around the building so that she doesn't spot you when she gets close. Hug the corner of that wall, and then once she's within range, use a Ceramic Shard to lure her for a Wall Hug Deathblow.

![](images/d4fc0576afbffc84ef27ad22ac09a6a647904ee2387673e4533eafd15b887d47.jpg)

![](images/8f48ce6286ded97672960e171950fc3203210e041134e35bb80e4b3601ae4c18.jpg)

With the warrior out of the way you can simply run and attack the noble here, and then use Shuriken to kill the one through the nearby gate, thus clearing the path to the next Idol.

# Fountainhead Palace

![](images/3fcda72be81519a9894ca033aab49ebc4007592efbac4e5bcc4af0011dc302c6.jpg)

![](images/88d0ea4aed318e6c55e67c09c23fca74b3de3c1054a9360ffa28d333add6fb5e.jpg)

a Bull of the Palace

# Item Legend

15

17

19

20

21

22

23

Treasure Carp Scale x1

24

25

Treasure Carp Scale x1

27

![](images/822717c1259cf32ef7b6b74210f0368b59843fd6b3bed68544a27601378b2505.jpg)

When all of the enemies have been killed, drop into the water beneath the hole in the floorboards here, and follow the underwater passage until you can emerge inside the nearby building. In here you'll find a number of key items, including the Water of the Palace.

![](images/56d8d12905958f6ca7efce414bc74a289b3d061b03d6576b1e965d7adff3d632.jpg)

# Mibu Village Priest

Take the Water of the Palace to the priest and he'll give you some Dragonspring Sake in return. Rest at an Idol, and then return to the priest again to find him transformed into a Palace Noble; kill him and he will drop five Treasure Carp Scales.

![](images/0dcc5440ccf5d0affb53326ea46309d9e6262c84e6791b138c26fb521aefdc01.jpg)

# Flower Viewing Stage

Take but a single step out onto the bridge near this idol and the Great Colored Carp—defender of the fountainhead waters—will leap out of the lake and destroy it. Right now it doesn't pose a threat to you, but you'll eventually have to confront it. Crossing the now-broken bridge is the way to

![](images/dc514d9e5016a774764a00b6536904d07fd68219032b45b645a40bc68e64f200.jpg)

continue, but there are still things in the manor grounds that are worth going back for, including another Prayer Bead.

![](images/f50728e68eb022bee9ba9013f7aabe013fe9c905d327f09ca54f36dbf7142064.jpg)

You can run around the outside of the manor grounds from here to get straight to the Sahara Bull of the Palace, but doing so would make that encounter more difficult, due to the Okami Warriors on the rooftops along the way. It's better to grapple up to the rooftops from here to start working your way around and take them out first.

![](images/a89e6384a375ee68769402782b369a2f2eac3e42cec4c23f29439cac5bc767d4.jpg)

When you reach the peak of the roof here you'll see the first warrior standing on the roof of the building ahead, looking down over the path around the manor. If you stay as far to the left as possible and remain crouched, you can sneak along the rooftop to get behind her and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/96eb4b6fbf750651c45ec116a6bf5dbbb5aac39f1e7d59a79d0a6c0aa5d179d2.jpg)

![](images/55e3fffee8787f0359f4d8d5497bd2318d6c344584ec51e303c9bbc43daacb33.jpg)

The other warrior on this rooftop is being watched over by a warrior on the roof of an adjacent building, so you can't Deathblow her without getting detected. Go back down to the left side of the rooftops, however, and you can sneak all the way along them to get behind the warrior on the adjacent building and Backstab Deathblow her.

![](images/c7124fabc09a48583bbfce96dd68552bb510ea59cac0437d0261a90fb265aa1c.jpg)

![](images/bdc5a975096f4fb72d2e881cbda1e39f1438311a437a73b92e0c46d0b0ab5997.jpg)

Below you you'll hear the bull as it patrols along the area outside the manor. If you try to Backstab Deathblow the remaining warrior, the bull is likely to spot you—keep an eye on it as it moves, and once it's further along its patrol route, close in and Backstab Deathblow the warrior.

![](images/1dbe49d089d48267805d4ba821996a747a62485c1f55dd3ceb7853d86aec0680.jpg)

While it will be tempting to try a Plunging Deathblow on the bull, it will just shrug off the attempt and leave you in a much worse position from which to begin the fight. The easiest way to deal with the bull is to reduce just enough vitality to slow its Posture regeneration, and then focus on breaking its Posture. Drop down near the bull, and as soon as you land, throw a Firecracker to stun it. During the stun, move around to its head and try to land a few blows; thrusts or similar high damage attacks are best.

You'll need to wait a short while before the bull is susceptible to Firecrackers again, so focus on evading or deflecting its attacks and looking for small attack windows during that time. There's an unmountable grapple point protruding from the cliff in this area, which can help with evading the bull's charges.

![](images/b829553dc59963aabe872d0111496b139405b2b62fd0c44e7cc8f17e82a733ba.jpg)

![](images/0eb6338e87770766ef75808907a13cb65ffef949d9f103a58b69f4b0e06d033e.jpg)

![](images/65631eb1bcd5b14de4a0e24b85c7573adb5023d9f73ff31b926e8d4b660c4bfd.jpg)

While the nobles spend most of their time lounging in the manor, most of the Okami Warriors spend their time on the viewing stages here, where they show off their skills for each other. The stages themselves are multi-tiered, with warriors occupying many of the small interconnecting sections. Because the warriors on the higher levels at the back of the area have excellent lines of sight over the ones on the lower levels at the front, a direct assault will soon see you having to fend off large numbers of enemies at once. If you want to avoid that outcome, it's recommended that you work your way around to the back and start taking those enemies out first.

![](images/72b72c76cb1b20c1446281288f9fff47c0dbdfb71e0bb12f49c90a2209b34010.jpg)

Although the raised stages provide the enemies with many advantages, they do also present some weaknesses that you can take advantage of, especially if you want to get through the area as quickly as possible. From here you can run along the edge of the waterfall and get underneath most of the stages to make it to the base of the Great Sahara Tree without having to fight anyone. Then you just need to take on a few hounds to reach the cliffs at the back, which is where you need to go in order to get to the top of the tree. This route is also ideal for reaching the Shichimen Warrior quickly on subsequent attempts.

![](images/31ff07c3071cfc9d8314e0b48cb748c897ea6714aae17987f4d1a913e3df73eb.jpg)

The Okami Warrior standing on a rock above a waterfall directly ahead of this point should be your first target. Begin your approach by dropping down onto the broken bridge to the left, and then working your way around the outskirts of the building ahead.

![](images/ba849e1dd0b3773787169b844f51442eb86db0407bc4ebc1e50a9075457541ef.jpg)

Grapple up to the branch protruding from the cliff near here, and then again up to the ledge near the warrior. Crouch down when you land, and then work your way around the warrior so that you can use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/d4370649eb2db2aa282e939da39a1c82108ad0e54996d36781c64133cade366e.jpg)

![](images/1438c991f78feeb703ea2cfa73b87b45ca0479f43574f3bf58010858cefa8ecf.jpg)

When the previous warrior has been killed you'll be able to see your next target standing on the roof of the building ahead of you; stay as far to the right as you can, and then jump over to the roof and sneak around behind the warrior for a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/fe367104fe4c66c6ce80a8c35da3c3f78570ff9b500d02b84bc7bdd9a10b2ede.jpg)

Run upstream until you reach this point and you can use a branch to grapple up to the walkway above. There will be two warriors directly ahead of you: an archer first, and then a katana-wielder. The katana warrior is the bigger threat, so crouch down and move around behind her to use a Backstab Deathblow, then quickly cut down the archer.

![](images/684a3d471a19b7749c4c2ea4ae8bb9286b7548de42b20e6f549b3c84b5c0a69f.jpg)

![](images/6b27c579cc9da0927d567454f67393498659dbff85fb2bd194dfe81d83bbb00a.jpg)

Proceed down the stairs from the walkway and you'll come to a stage with two kemari-wielding warriors with their backs to you; Backstab Deathblow the one on the left first, and then do the same to the other. If you try and backstab them in the other order, the one on the left will see you kill the one on the right because of the angle they're standing at. The ensuing fight will then normally get the attention of two more patrolling warriors below, so if that happens, retreat out of the area until they return to their normal route.

![](images/ef2538f88d4848fca346b56b5433640401eeb06aa725835926975991f29a10f7.jpg)

Jump over the railing, so that you land on the roof below the stage, and make your way along it to this point. From here you can watch the two warriors patrolling along the path below. When they start walking away from you, drop down behind them and Backstab Deathblow the first one, and then quickly hit the other with Sabimaru to stun it and follow up with normal attacks. Try to keep the fight in the corner of the path, so that none of the other nearby warriors hear anything.

![](images/856809735a62a86dccc8dac8d12030f89d16f55e038165ff486beef8ac47d9b4.jpg)

![](images/ea3b94d70c40af421317d8692f8db2e87bddc9c657ca55d172cb591e8e8e0fa9.jpg)

It can be tempting to try to take on the warriors that are out at the front of the stage, kicking the kemari ball around. If you do, however, the other warriors on the higher stage to the side will spot you and attack, so it's best to leave them alone for now.

![](images/699cf553d26b62767e0da15e735bc23bbbedb6ee96dfccfd8ec11d4e7efea35f.jpg)

There are two lightning halberd Okami Warriors just beyond the top of these stairs, and if you look to the right along the stage you'll see that there's also an Okami Warrior patrolling very close to the top of the stairs. The two halberd warriors should be your primary targets—remain crouched and wait until the patrolling warrior is far enough away and has his back to you, and then go up the stairs. Sneak around behind the warriors and use a Backstab Deathblow on the first one, and then follow-up with the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu. While the smoke is blinding the second warrior, go around behind her and use another Backstab Deathblow. We recommend finishing off the remaining warriors on the stages, but if you want to skip them, turn the page and continue from Point 7.

![](images/2d9949befcf878b9f3d33e6650d363e1503578a97ea14aca00b207ec85db2c4a.jpg)

Now that the warriors are out of the way, head back down the stairs. Crouch there until the patrolling warrior makes her way back around, so that you can sneak up behind her and use a Backstab Deathblow.

![](images/710ab3ae539a5b0795720162a12f5b4be86dbebe81d7b9a52ad64d6d8e1caee8.jpg)

Continue along this side of the stage so that you can sneak past the kemari-wielding warrior and use a Backstab Deathblow on the katana one just past her. The kemari-using warrior should be unaware of your presence still; jump over the railing and crouch down so that you can close in for a Backstab Deathblow. As long as you crouch again instantly and move backwards, the warriors on the lower adjacent stage should not detect you.

![](images/eea1c7a842c84e10e689ae88d626ecd277d047148c4684127309bda138edf9d0.jpg)

![](images/64948b3a9105840fe9fa43a2873a97592131a8d112e4afd305ec0877f83c13d0.jpg)

Make your way back down the staircase and continue along the path until you can grapple up to this rooftop. Follow the rooftop along to the end and you'll be able to grapple across to a branch overlooking the two remaining warriors; use a Plunging Deathblow on the katana warrior that's sitting down, and then finish off the other one with normal attacks.

![](images/e5a2aaaf5622c20aba3d020d49c328a8757b96205e30dc8b124e88a4b1b5195a.jpg)

A pair of Palace Hounds are hiding under the smaller waterfall in this area, so have some Shuriken at the ready to take them out quickly if you come here for the item.

![](images/69282b609d6f840647e082bc6d515a1764f4141e8f5c7ece4064218f417be0e8.jpg)

# Fountainhead Palace

![](images/cca4fee00273100e81ab8a1d8158112c000241bbe802d96411693d3d38192739.jpg)

![](images/0ca3366752b4b92f85c8ec98aa137b65bc6d92826e2681ab7e039f7dc79557e3.jpg)

More Palace Hounds patrol beneath this waterfall, so if you're heading to the Shichimen Warrior, make sure to take the hounds out first, so you don't have to worry about them during that fight.

![](images/a475deb5e0acf6d305493c79b0c9c2d9b6183ed8b846ed8ad9063d211b77c476.jpg)

You can easily get above the Shichimen Warrior by climbing up the ledges to here, but as usual, you won't be able to start the encounter against them with any kind of Deathblow because they'll sense you coming. The perch here does, however, provide you with a good vantage point from which to prepare for the battle. Divine Confetti and Pacifying Agent are a must for this battle, so make sure to apply them before you drop down. The Malcontent upgrade for the Finger Whistle, and Phoenix's Lilac Umbrella upgrade for the Loaded Umbrella will make the fight significantly easier.

Start attacking as soon as you land, and when the Shichimen Warrior tries to retaliate, use Malcontent to stun it so that you can keep up your onslaught. Eventually it will teleport away and try to use its spirit beam attack, and it will generally appear quite some distance away towards the Great Sahara Tree. The narrow ravine can make it difficult to avoid the beam while you close in, so if you're in doubt, activate Phoenix's Lilac Umbrella to negate the damage. Your reward for defeating this Shichimen Warrior is an extremely rare Lapis Lazuli, making the effort worthwhile.

![](images/840852544b6e854516b2aa16277e383ebef6041263bae9561f9bdf435d24f1d7.jpg)

![](images/8860522faa330c13f88bc91c8cd2dfb44e438e5e28d64890baa392ca32bf90d9.jpg)

To start heading towards the Great Sahara Tree, grapple up to the roof of the small shrine from here. Follow the series of grapple points and ledges from there to reach the top of the large staircase.

![](images/3e3195127bf3b35c05ddc6fd89b7ca71269ee117fff3e0337617aeb36f127141.jpg)

![](images/237c444685eca12c2f8b00e790c533787e21a153a235f64ee361450dc85f0d65.jpg)

The door of the building at the top of the stairs does not open from this side, so your only option is to head down the stairs. When you're near the bottom of the stairs, an Okami Warrior will come running out of the room ahead; retreat up the stairs and let her come to you, because an archer warrior will also step out from the room, and fighting both at the same time can be problematic. Use Sabimaru and normal attacks to quickly deal with the approaching warrior, and then sprint down and take out the archer.

![](images/188bb12f6ee8dcda00ef953332aba228ced9b08e85d18b00aa3f1f605f619739.jpg)

There are two more archer warriors underneath the walkway here, so jump over the railing and take them both out quickly to ensure that they don't get dragged into the upcoming battle.

![](images/abd0d9e96993690d1a29fac6cb53270af46deba4c5975ba575540799a6e0c8c1.jpg)

![](images/57e3c8493b12a70126c1e93d9e398e511428858e6a666d6960a0e2cb08a6f9a1.jpg)

Crouch and make your way around to the railing here to get a view of the final obstacle you must overcome before finally taking out the enemy that has been denying you access to the lake all this time. a lightning katana Okami Warrior, along with four normal warriors are situated in the middle of the stage ahead, but with the right planning and tools you can overcome even those unfavorable odds.

Jump over the railing here and crouch again straight away so that the warrior doesn't spot you; advance a few steps to get a bit closer, and then sprint towards the closest warrior and use a Backstab Deathblow on her. Follow that up with the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu to blind them all and give you time to check their positions. The lightning katana warrior should be caught in the smoke as well, and since she is the biggest threat, locate her and get behind her for a Backstab Deathblow. Do that quickly enough and you'll be able to use Sabimaru on the remaining warriors while they're still blinded, after which you can pick them off one at a time

![](images/0730d168bcbad7a2cb69521cec97aee20a317f5a5e73e58f52eff58320c89bd7.jpg)

![](images/e103bcbd0ba9dcb6665dcafd603117fd8ffa0692dd371de042d6b28fc8aff145.jpg)

![](images/43cdc39280c2223e066480905e99a23169fa73cf8802b63c36475dd1c6b3189c.jpg)

# Great Sahara

Depending on how you want to proceed, you may or may not want to rest at this Idol. With all of the warriors in the area defeated, going back to explore the rest of the area is a very simple affair. If you decide to grapple over and face Shizu you'll need to do some backtracking and kill a couple of enemies again if you wish to explore those same areas. You've

![](images/b91caad76bd7c382e2b924469f230feebd1162dec43cf54b66525496ff1d13da.jpg)

come so far, and Shizu is so close that we recommend facing her, and then exploring the Near Pot Noble area before going into the lake.

![](images/a7265a630fd0852662ee16fbdc9e13ca738cbb5587f22531d40d18e580a6add9.jpg)

Grapple across to the Great Sahara Tree and start closing in Shizu to begin the fight. While you're running in she will use her Lightning Mari Kick attack—be ready to jump into the air when you see her kick the kemari, so that you can use a Lightning Reversal on it. If the reversal hits her, she'll be stunned, allowing you to get close and use a full Sabimaru combo to Poison her. Now her Posture will only require a few hits to break, after which you can finally put an end to her reign of terror and make the lake safe to swim in.

There are a lot of valuable items sitting on the lake bed and Treasure Carp swimming through its waters, but the murky depths can get disorientating if you swim about aimlessly. Remember, though, that while there's no need to surface for air, doing so can help with reorientation, so it's worthwhile doing periodically. If you want to enter the lake straight away, this is the perfect place to jump in. To pick up the route from there, skip to Point 1 on the next page.

![](images/929bdb6a73f42190d7f2a8d1fb46a7443a4f28c7cd1c74fd9ebaf280715317da.jpg)

![](images/0230f56533f673b4f0d9779003cd921beaa55e467c126c3332913748353134d5.jpg)

# Old Palace Maid

On the roof of the half-submerged building not far from the Feeding Grounds you'll find one of the Old Palace Maids. She has duties to fulfil within the palace, but the door at the top of the large staircase that leads there is closed, so she asks that you open it for her and gives you a hint as to how to get there.

![](images/b314e575d4461464f2614d7c1f47aadc24cc9ace02db553423308c893ada3db1.jpg)

To reach the Near Pot Noble area, you'll need to get back to the top of the large staircase, and the easiest way to do that is to drop down from the top of the tree here. Follow the river upstream, killing the hounds along the way, and then climb and grapple your way back up to the stairs.

![](images/2482e8c6df458c714e37002814754851144815e9691b12f116bcafba0bf67223.jpg)

When you've made it back to this point, look back up towards the staircase and you'll discover a grapple point that you can use to reach the rooftop of the bridge you ran beneath. From there you can head left to the Near Pot Noble area. Going to the right will let you look down over the Feeding Grounds area, but the jump is too far to make from here and you'll need to access it via another route later.

![](images/f2186755d8f011960d11c8c52cda0e8de24fbbc3ea53eabfe4c865ee01d96d76.jpg)

Grapple up to this rooftop, and from here you'll be able to grapple across to a cave filled with extremely rare Albino Geckos. These beasts are similar to their green counterparts and can be killed in the exact same manner. Instead of a poisonous fluid, the liquid spewed by this variant creates a cloud that will constantly damage you as long as you're inside it—if a few of them spit at you, the damage will accumulate fast. Use Shuriken to take them out quickly, before they can start attacking. If you do find yourself taking a lot of damage, use the Bloodsmoke Ninjutsu on one of them, because a reaction between their toxin and the Ninjutsu will result in a cloud of healing smoke that you can use.

![](images/aa33e48ff1b95665e00609d90e757a9d6236a0e453c5cb81bb8d5c220349614d.jpg)

# Near Pot Noble

![](images/ac4dd8c76d344237487ee2739d3080d9af95309162798995fc127ba9cce2ed02.jpg)

As the name implies, the primary use for this Idol is to allow you quick travel back to the Pot Noble, who has situated himself nearby.

![](images/6171e98898ef3143a1d718ed7df9c1b39107e9d0a8217b091bf055a0aa62de85.jpg)

# Pot Noble Koremori

Similar to the Pot Noble found in Hirata Estate, Koremori will trade Treasure Carp Scales for rare items. There are a lot of scales to be had within the waters of the lake, so if you don't have enough to buy anything, make sure to return once you've acquired more. If you have acquired the other two mask pieces, Koremori sells the final piece that you need to complete the mask, which in turn gives you an item that lets you convert Skill

![](images/4ebc72f5acf5ee5424b86884d98045125ff8389dfbbcc6f9795ad17974ea898a.jpg)

Points directly into Attack Power. He also sells two Lapis Lazuli, which is just enough to fully upgrade one Prosthetic Tool.

![](images/848ff99e433c153b6a8e3afc66bca90d239cfd87fa793fdd99dd77c2612dfc7c.jpg)

Once your business with Koremori has concluded, grapple up to this house and make your way back through the cave, or venture into the lake by diving in from here.

![](images/b9c8fbce4ab6a8adfa0856f258131df7c1969958ee41dfd4d5ad6c4c23bb2995.jpg)

![](images/464edbece2f4ff75baa4bc469b8229ea911240e967ffbf039f9daf916decde66.jpg)

# Fountainhead Palace

![](images/ef8b19cae450ef2a5b6efa2f7b244ecc3f9dfc0a44310c1be689a942b999e761.jpg)

![](images/be704454f19ddd7339fc0bd30af62fc56ab29069ea27272cde9e7df6602f6f3b.jpg)

Defending the deepest part of the lake, where the most precious items can be found, is an Underwater Headless, and this time it also has an illusory ally with it. As with other underwater battles, the only items you can use during the fight are gourds, so it's highly recommended that you have the Mottled Purple Gourd before attempting to face these enemies.

Although you won't be able to make use of the full duration, it's still worth going up to the rooftop of one of the buildings on the surface and using a Divine Confetti before you face them. The illusory Headless should be your first target, since it has significantly less health than the normal one, and cutting down the amount of projectiles you need to evade will make the fight significantly easier overall.

![](images/21013218097e44fd8f7d2731cebd9c12d8fd762cce37469e30038543dd4848a0.jpg)

![](images/748f30a8f5fa259314292dc90c88a87b8b7d4994c5706c60f82ab610ee471a7c.jpg)

The underwater cave entrance the Old Palace Maid spoke of starts here, and it's also the domain of the Great Colored Carp. The carp is extremely aggressive and territorial, and will attack you on sight; you'll get a warning sign signaling an incoming attack, but only a very well timed dodge to the side will let you avoid taking a lot of damage from this massive beast. Getting through the cave in one piece will require some precision timing.

Near the entrance of the cave you'll find some plants that you can hide in, and then if you look along the walls of the cave, you'll see sections of a broken bridge that you can swim through. Those bridge sections can be used to obscure you from the carp's sight, but if you swim out from one recklessly and it spots you, it will crash into the bridge section and destroy it, making subsequent trips more difficult.

Your goal is to reach the back of the cave, where there's a gap in a building that you can swim through. You'll need to time your movements from the entrance, and between sections of the bridge, so that you only move when the carp is facing away.

![](images/c3209b1b617d2c0acdf8f630650b3c87e6ce6fc181199ccc1e5f5e2a7dccc01f.jpg)

When you've made it to this point, swim through the opening in the building, and then up to the surface on the other side.

# Fountainhead Palace

![](images/deddc675c57d4cc3a116cc171d49fba09457669a26d0b8b668f4aa0c6c91f608.jpg)  
Item Legend

38 Bundled Jizo Statue x1  
44 Ungo's Sugar x2  
45 Ako's Sugar x2  
46 Heavy Coin Purse x1  
Gourd Seed x1

![](images/08fc6a6569c74bfbc1db6f4bed82c5dad37e267dcaa12b8a6818b093680299d7.jpg)

You'll emerge at the bottom of a picturesque ravine with no enemies around, so all you need to do is grapple up the series of branches along the cliffside to reach the Idol at the top.

![](images/8b3342cdf3d50431df96c7611507ecfa5fd525712a8c212134e03ef57a8b41ec.jpg)

# Palace Grounds

The winding path leading up the waterfall in this area is the last thing you need to ascend in order to reach the Divine Realm, and continue your search for the fabled dragon's tears.

![](images/4b014301469fd65edbd702c22d46474191f7ff0d469eaa13555277ee3f6c07ca.jpg)

![](images/e94d9d86373ca5eeba06544ff8877aa0da3631dad1c9c41bff3053180d44e484.jpg)

The interior of this building is filled with red-robed Palace Nobles, but they are all preoccupied with consuming the remains of deceased Okami Warriors; take advantage of their gluttony by cutting them down quickly.

![](images/093149ecb6da8f03263eabc6b88944e99c72bdd74c800ba380bb9649fbd763af.jpg)

The Gourd Seed found here should be the final one you need to upgrade the Healing Gourd capacity to its maximum. Make sure you take it to Emma as soon as possible so that you can start making use of the extra sip.

![](images/3a253231b3785ee7805eb41bfcee259a8aae24c2e68c69cb0b13d3e3fbe471a9.jpg)

# Old Palace Maids Update

The door in this building leads back out to the large staircase—this the same one that the maid on the roof of the house in the lake asked you to open for her. If you open it, and then rest at the nearby idol, you'll find that she's killed all of the nobles in the building and you'll never have to deal with them again. Talk to her to complete her quest.

![](images/1bc89f738a91a33e552d1d12f21d53c999f84a922398e937a0b29abc96aab8e5.jpg)

Now that you're through the building, if you turn around and look back at it you'll find a grapple point that you can use to access the roof; this is the start of the route that leads to the Feeding Grounds, so skip to Point 6 if you want to continue towards the boss. Run to the opposite end of the roof and grapple out to the branch protruding from the cliff, and then jump and grapple down to the roof of the broken bridge section. Crouch down when you land to avoid being spotted by an Okami Warrior on an adjacent rooftop. The only way to reach her is to grapple from this rooftop across to the one she's on, during which time she'll detect you. After grappling across you can use parts of the building for cover—when the warrior is between shots, close in and hit her with Sabimaru before finishing her off with basic attacks.

![](images/758a3ceaaf42cc5a1047f138a531bc1329c43efaffceb61c05a9e52128887fc2.jpg)

The only enemies on the upper levels of the area are Palace Hounds, so pick them off with Shuriken while you collect the items, and then make your way down to this point. The enemy ahead on the bridge is an Okami Warrior, so you'll need to be a bit more cautious; thankfully she has her back to you while doing a spot of fishing, so you can sneak up and use a Backstab Deathblow on her. Once she's been defeated, go back to the start of the bridge and jump across to the Feeding Grounds area.

![](images/c6926fc6aa5ca810394a1b1f61dcd578cb4f635965a3987ee1f0c0cf035ceb7e.jpg)

# Feeding Grounds

The feeding grounds are where the palace nobles have fed the Great Colored Carp over the years, and it is thanks to all of the Precious Bait that it has grown to such a massive size. Between the Master's Chamberlain and the carp there are a

![](images/e655793a6c43dd80f650998ec3ef5a37401eb5d684c9cd7eb43d9096dd51c9d1.jpg)

lot of possible interactions in this area, and the Idol here will make traveling back a much simpler affair.

![](images/74db4ce54b821697484bb05b5190e39e527b663be0dcd82d6f1a85dfb7dde11f.jpg)

![](images/f64aeef34098ef955046bb7d45641d2b96f5bc32a435b722417c24cb307e4ff6.jpg)

# Master's Chamberlain

Do not attack the peaceful caretaker when you reach this area, or he will become hostile after two or three hits and you'll need to fight him rather than follow his quest. All he wants to do is feed the Great Colored Carp, and if you talk to him, he'll tell you that you'll first need to ring the nearby bell.

Upon doing so the carp will swim to the surface and you'll have the option to give it some bait, if you have any. Under normal circumstances, the carp is extremely hostile if you try to swim through the underwater cave towards the palace, making it a very dangerous trip. If you feed it Precious Bait, not only will the chamberlain reward you with Treasure Carp Scales (four in total if you feed it twice), but the Great Colored Carp will become docile and will not attack you at all if you try to swim past it.

Spend enough Treasure Carp Scales with either of the Pot Noble merchants, and they'll reward you with the Truly Precious Bait item; feed that to the carp it will poison and kill it after you rest at an Idol. Its corpse will end up at the Guardian Ape's Watering Hole in Sunken Valley Passage. Travel there and you can acquire the Great White Whisker, which you can give to the chamberlain to bring his quest to an end.

You can find plenty of Precious Bait along the bottom of the lake, and you can take advantage of them to get past the carp if you don't want to poison it with the Truly Precious Bait. Using the Truly Precious Bait will lead to more Lapis Lazuli, however, so it is ultimately the most rewarding option. The Treasure Carp Scales you would have obtained from the chamberlain

![](images/524e750f218eb48fa3da957df40e099044d3d11d9505ee6edeb52e6b1d912445.jpg)

will appear where he rests, so you can still get them after poisoning the carp.

![](images/3be27e81121eb5e3850a08a7ce1aff20f15018de49e071a1db9bf6432357ab35.jpg)

To reach the upper section of the waterfall you'll need to grapple onto the branch directly ahead of you when you exit the building, and then grapple to the higher branches of the nearby trees to reach the path above the waterfall.

![](images/88378f930616feb84e4a3ae266ce0a12423fd94d9c79f5ac478542ba4a678a71.jpg)

![](images/8f091dfb44aa8ff2dada956bcf1d926d0a6379895cb2233c15bb6fcb46a400f7.jpg)

# Fountainhead Palace

![](images/dc45762b392ebf4bbb9828b1a9959a061cccacea5bcb97ec4057b04bdbfa809e.jpg)

# Item Legend

![](images/2b0ffe499d267ac27f9c05499bd710555a52c0c256c5ba4ca8896fce50e34bc6.jpg)

Mibu Balloon of Soul x3

![](images/f73adee50743b558ebe0d97abb80c32094cf5959d4477b3aabefec50e469c27d.jpg)

Dragon's Blood Droplet x1

![](images/145a1fe7ff67a56354bbd898f417ec64b88a1dfdb34e109f86f651cbf4b98b7e.jpg)

The only enemies in the middle section of the waterfall are some Albino Geckos; if you want to clear them out before picking up the item, use normal attacks so that you can conserve your Spirit Emblems for an upcoming fight.

![](images/881b241cbd66f0f869fd742d6b40d778111d5d5937a93f7e2d3ee6ae2cd2be00.jpg)

The lighting that strikes the ground once you reach this point is there to warn you of the dangers that lay ahead, and that danger comes in the form of three lighting-weapon wielding Okami Warriors. If you run straight up the path you will end up in combat with all three of them, and while it is possible to sprint past them and make it to the Idol, attempting that is more dangerous than taking them on, providing that you use the right tactics.

![](images/3cf40595b2dcef37d11cdb688b726f4ad95640536028737f3419afb1867f1e49.jpg)

After passing beneath the second torii gate you'll be able to jump onto a ledge to the right of the path—when you do so, make sure to stay close to the wall. One of the Okami Warriors patrols along the ledge above this one, and if you move too far away from the wall she'll spot you. Adjust your camera so that you can see and lock onto her, and then use the Finger Whistle to lure her down to the ledge you're on. When you see her land, attack her with Sabimaru until she's Poisoned, and then break her Posture with basic attacks to finish her off.

![](images/0c6266ac4a93adcc2b28de31f857e3a26e9f5f30d3c69a5551cf1d5415f05134.jpg)

![](images/d2db80f6a3079ebf9ab690172175c00282fbcc55e883633b4839ebdb9e6ffa55.jpg)

Grapple up to this ledge once it's clear, and from here you can lure the halberd-wielding Okami Warrior to you with the Finger Whistle. As soon as you use it, crouch down and stay close to the cliff face beneath the stairs, so that she doesn't see you while she closes in. Depending on the angle she takes, you can often Backstab Deathblow her when she jumps down from the stairs; if not, use Sabimaru and basic attacks again to finish her off quickly. Try to position yourself so that the fight stays on the ledge, because if it spills out onto the stairs there's a good chance the other Okami Warrior will spot you.

![](images/10f2c3130d34fb6de7c9a8e2cc6ae1ab01f9871c36c36d078658846d0431304a.jpg)

![](images/595e75e5749065fcdf65c127a9473f65b23b97a30208d276ff8e6b8fe22b8c7d.jpg)

The final warrior has a katana, and you can either lure her onto the ledge like the previous one so that you can get an early advantage, or simply run over and start attacking her openly with Sabimaru. She was the final obstacle blocking your way up the stairs, so continue to the next Idol.

![](images/5d8e24c1bfd61da482f421ec59c1c915217874b5422ef78af166f611f3c1d553.jpg)

# Sanctuary

This is the final respite before you enter the divine realm, so make sure you've made any and all preparations you feel necessary. You should also be careful if you want to head back down the stairs to explore, because if you've rested, the Okami Warriors will be able to spot you very easily.

# Endings and Quests Updates

Once you enter the divine realm you will progress the story once more, and new events will transpire. Due to those events, you'll be unable to make any more progress towards many of the quests from various characters; if you have unfinished business with any of them, make sure you take care of it now, before proceeding any further. This is especially true if you're trying to attain either the Purification or the Return ending—both of these require you to obtain their key items before you enter the divine realm. Make sure that you have everything that you need for your desired ending by checking out P.536.

![](images/abfed1b9a5816979e89cd098219f5df3487e39097a394ca34fe4f567515abca5.jpg)

When all of your preparations are complete, make your way to the top of the stairs and pray in side the shrine to be transported to the divine realm, where you must face its guardian.

Boss Battle

# Old Dragons of the Tree (White)

960

450

![](images/ff7d95212a10b1d84c7ad08fd6ae5d8a2f85391572bdad4ba76de76ab33d9cda.jpg)

The white Old Dragons that you face in this encounter move very slowly, and their only attack is a Noxious Cough that leaves lingering clouds of Poison behind. On their own they are not much of a threat, but as the fight progresses, more and more of them will appear, along with a black-colored variant that is capable of using rudimentary attacks. The Vitality gauge in this case acts as a collective pool for the white-colored Old Dragons, and each time you defeat one of them it will deplete a little. Repeat until it's all gone.

The primary threat here is Poison, so make sure you have Antidote Powders ready. Contact Medicine can also be useful due to how long it lasts. Attacks with a large area of effect or those that are Fire-based can also be very effective at taking down groups of them. Only a single Old Dragon will be present at the start, so run over and start attacking it until you can finish it with a Deathblow.

Gradually more and more will appear and you'll start to hear them chanting, at which point gnarled roots will emerge from the ground. You can grapple up to the top of the root, and from there perform a special Plunging Deathblow on the white-colored Old Dragons—this causes an area-of-effect slash, capable of killing multiple dragons at a time. Keep evading the black-colored Old Dragons and looking for opportunities to take out the white-colored ones until enough have been defeated to trigger a cutscene.

# Boss Battle

# Divine Dragon

10800

1800

12000

![](images/3928220e18ba3e726ae69b21f12b9a40acf9fb84613edaed7552093f8f5a0f80.jpg)

You start this fight looking directly at the Divine Dragon, with nothing between you but a few gnarled branches protruding from the ground. The dragon's primary attacks are shockwave projectiles either in the form of a vertical one that you can evade by running to the side, or a horizontal sweeping one that you have to jump. Lightning will periodically strike one of the gnarled branches, making the tip of it glow—this is what you need to watch for.

You can only damage the dragon with Lightning Reversals, so once you spot an illuminated branch, run and grapple to it. Make sure you lock onto the dragon while you get blasted into the air, and fire the Lightning Reversal at it before you land. Repeat this pattern until it has around  $30\%$  Vitality left, and it'll use a barrage of attacks that you'll need to evade, after which more branches will appear and you'll need to perform one final Lightning Reversal to stun the creature. While it is incapacitated, sprint towards it and run up its sword until you're close enough to perform a Finisher Deathblow.

# Story Update

You'll automatically be returned to Kuro's Room in Ashina Castle after defeating the dragon and obtaining the Divine Dragon Tears, but it appears that the castle is under renewed siege and Lord Kuro was forced to flee.

# Ashina Castle (Central Forces raid)

With the castle under siege and pitched battles taking places across the grounds, the chaos of war has fully arrived in Ashina. The Central Forces have bolstered their assault by rebuilding the bridge between the castle and its outskirts, creating a path that the Wolf may take advantage of.

![](images/650b4c4049fbba9d18d214a28396435a3a589bd55c7b7d073e3e233a05a93bb1.jpg)

![](images/7c590715bdf221564db80fe177a0fac8bc38dfb452c2535316f80cd248ab68e5.jpg)

![](images/2990670641ef851d110547aba9e79aaa7e3f75755a8b7bb50360e150e2ce9f83.jpg)
